jobs.title: Sesonghjelp søkes til Nille Metro Lørenskog
jobs.description:
Er du en sosial person som elsker å yte god service? Har du lyst på en jobb der du kan vise frem dine salgsevner og hjelpe kunder i butikken? Da har vi den perfekte stillingen for deg! Vi søker etter en butikkselger som vil være med på å spre glede og gi positive kundemøter i vår butikk.

Du vil få mange varierte arbeidsoppgaver, som kundebehandling, fylle på varer, kassebetjening og vaske litt innimellom.

Perioden fra oktober og frem til nyttår er den travleste i Nille, og vi søker deg som kan jobbe i denne hektiske og morsomme tiden. Antall timer i stillingen vil variere etter behov. Du må kunne jobbe både dagtid, kvelder og helger.

Vi tilbyr deg god opplæring og et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø. Vi ser etter deg som har en glimrende serviceinnstilling, er blid, pliktoppfyllende og trives med folk.

Du må ha fylt 18 år og du må være god i norsk, muntlig og skriftlig.

Er du den vi leter etter? Da håper vi at du sender inn din søknad via søknadsskjemaet som er knyttet til annonsen. Vi ber deg også merke deg at det meste av kommunikasjonen angående stillingen vil foregå per e-post, så sjekk innboksen din ofte! 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nille ble etablert i 1966, og åpnet den første butikken i 1981. I dag er vi et av Norges mest kjente merkenavn med rundt 290 butikker og 1,6 millioner medlemmer i kundeklubben. Nille er en norskeid kjede med en stolt og lang historie som har gitt oss en unik posisjon hos våre kunder. Nille er en inspirerende og moderne butikk, med bredde av produkter til glade festdager og gode hverdager i alle sesonger med verdi for pengene. jobs.title: Fauske asylmottak trenger ny vaktmester!
jobs.description:
Fauske asylmottak har behov for en vaktmester i 100% stilling. Vi søker en positiv og pliktoppfyllende person som bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø her hos oss.

Hva vi ser etter

Asylmottaket er et levende miljø i kontinuerlig endring, og vi vektlegger personlig egnethet høyt.

  • Du har en åpen, tolerant og respektfull holdning til mennesker fra ulike kulturer og bakgrunner.

  • Du er psykisk robust, tålmodig og opptrer som en rolig og trygg voksenperson i en tidvis uforutsigbar hverdag.

  • Du jobber strukturert og selvstendig med dine egne oppgaver, men samarbeider også godt på tvers av yrkesgrupper.

  • Du er nevenyttig og liker å løse nye utfordringer.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Typiske vaktmesteroppgaver på et asylmottak:

  • Innvendig vedlikehold: Skifte lyspærer, smøre låser, utbedre mindre feil og mangler, samt kontrollere tekniske anlegg.

  • Utvendig vedlikehold: Klippe hekk, holde utearealer i orden og ta seg av snømåking og strøing om vinteren.

  • HMS og brannsikkerhet: Kontrollere røykvarslere, brannslukkingsapparater og nødlys.

  • Tilsyn og fellesarealer: Sjekke tilstand på dører, vinduer, tak og fellesrom.

  • Klargjøring av rom: Sørge for at boenheter er i forsvarlig stand, møblert og vasket når nye beboere flytter inn eller ut.

  • Brannvern og HMS: Gjennomføre regelmessige kontroller av røykvarslere, slukkeutstyr, rømningsveier og nødlys, samt delta i brannøvelser.

  • Teknisk drift og avvik: Følge opp internkontroller, foreta enkle reparasjoner, utbedre slitasje og koordinere eksterne håndverkere ved større feil.

  • Sosialt samspill: Bistå det øvrige mottakspersonalet i hverdagen, bidra til å løse praktiske utfordringer for beboerne, og fange opp eventuelle behov eller slitasje på bygningsmassen.

Vi tilbyr

Er du en nevenyttig person som trives med folk, og som ønsker en meningsfull arbeidshverdag? Da er det kanskje akkurat deg vi leter etter!

Vi søker nå en allsidig og trygg vaktmester i 100% fast stilling til vårt asylmottak. Hos oss blir du en sentral brikke i å skape et trygt, fungerende og trivelig midlertidig hjem for våre beboere. Rollen kombinerer tradisjonell eiendomsdrift med verdifullt sosialt miljøarbeid i et flerkulturelt miljø.

Vi kan tilby et levende og dynamisk arbeidsmiljø med kolleger og beboere fra hele verden, der ingen dager er like. Du vil få en unik mulighet til å gjøre en reell og positiv forskjell for mennesker i en sårbar livssituasjon. Du vil ha muligheten til å forme egen arbeidshverdag, samt jobbe selvstendig og sammen med andre mottaksansatte.

Lønn etter avtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mottaksdrift Nor AS er et privat norsk selskap som jobber som driftsoperatør for asylmottak på oppdrag fra Utlendingsdirektoratet ( UDI**)**.

Selskapet ble stiftet i 2015. De har ansvaret for den daglige driften, administrasjonen, miljøarbeidet og vedlikeholdet ved Fauske asylmottak og Vensmoen asylmottak.

Avdelingsleder videregående: Solveig Kimo Løvås tlf.: 412 20 762 / e-post: solveig.lovas@oya.vgs.no

jobs.title: Vil du bli lærer ved Veståsen barneskole i Gjerdrum?
jobs.description:
Veståsen barneskole har ambisjoner på vegne av elevene våre og vi vil ha deg med på reisen vår! Har du erfaring, eller er du nyutdannet? Du er velkommen til å bli med på reisen.

Da to av våre faste ansatte skal ut i permisjon, søker vi lærere til to vikariater i 100 % stilling med mulighet for forlengelse. Det ene vikariatet er i perioden fra 16.11.2026 til 01.09.2027, og det andre er i perioden fra 01.01.2027 til 30.06.2027.

Veståsen skole ligger perfekt til i naturskjønne omgivelser, med flotte utearealer som innbyr til uteskole og gode rammer for tverrfaglig arbeid. Skolen er en 1-7 skole, og er per i dag to-parallell. Alle elevene får hver sin PC, og dette bidrar til at skolens profesjonsfaglige digitalkompetanse utvikles i tråd med nye læreplaner. Vi har ca. 300 lekne elever og 40 ansatte som samarbeider godt i team. På Veståsen skole er vi inkluderende, kunnskapsrike, kulturbevisste, nysgjerrige, engasjerte og rause. 

Kommunen er i vekst, og det satses på systematisk og helhetlig skoleutvikling i tråd med felles strategi for skolene i Gjerdrum. Kommunen har en enhetlig oppvekststrategi for hele laget rundt barnet, og et kommunalt mestringsteam bistår skolene i oppfølgingen av elevens faglige og sosiale utvikling.

Skolen har høyt fokus på arbeid med grunnleggende ferdigheter, og jobber systematisk med elevenes læring og utvikling. Hos oss skal hver elev følges opp systematisk både faglig og sosialt, og alle kontaktlærere har avsatt tid til individuell oppfølging av elevene. Skolens visjon er "Vekst og utvikling for hele mennesket".

Gjerdrum kommune har som mål å være en av de fremste kommunene innen faglig utvikling og læringsmiljø i Akershus, og vi håper du være med på en del av reisen!

Vi søker både deg som har erfaring, og deg som er ny i yrket, og som er engasjert og lærevillig. Skolen er opptatt av kvaliteten på lærernes undervisning, og at elevenes læringsarbeid er skolens kjerneoppgave. Som lærer hos oss vil du få en nøkkelrolle i å bidra til elevenes faglige og sosiale utvikling. Vikariatet i perioden fra 16.11.26 til 01.09.27 er på småtrinnet, mens vikariatet fra 01.01.27 til 30.06.27 er på mellomtrinnet. Begge vikariatene innehar kontaktlærerrolle, men kan tilpasses etter erfaring og ønske.

Våre ledige stillinger:
Ett vikariat 100 % stilling fra 16. november 2026 til 1. september 2027 
Ett vikariat 100 % stilling fra 1. januar 2027 til 30. juni 2027

Vennligst oppgi i søknaden hvilken stilling du søker på.

Vil du utgjøre en forskjell for elevene, samtidig som du får mulighet til å utvikle deg selv? Da er Veståsen skole stedet å være!  

Dine arbeidsoppgaver

  • arbeide i tråd med kommunens handlingsplaner og skolens virksomhetsplan
  • planlegging og gjennomføring av undervisning i tråd med gjeldene læreplaner i klasser, gruppe og enkeltvis
  • systematisk samarbeid med kolleger og ledelse om elevenes læring og utvikling, og aktiv deltagelse i skolens utviklingsarbeid
  • samarbeid med teamet om analyse av resultater, utarbeidelse og oppfølging av tiltaksplaner på trinn-, gruppe- og individnivå for best mulig tilpasset opplæring og for å sikre elevenes læring og utvikling, i samarbeid med ledelsen
  • delta i utarbeidelse av IOP og følge opp elever med vedtak om individuell tilrettelagt opplæring
  • arbeide i henhold til skolens satsningsområder som for tiden er inkluderende undervisning og læringsmiljø, i tillegg til å ha fokus på grunnleggende lese-, skrive- og regneferdigheter
  • samarbeid med relevante eksterne samarbeidspartnere
  • skape trygge og gode læringsarenaer der alle våre elever er inkludert faglig og sosialt
  • oppfølging av elever for å sikre god faglig og sosial utvikling, og et trygt, godt og inkluderende læringsmiljø
  • skole-hjem samarbeid
  • kontaktlæreransvar kan tillegges stillingene

Dine kvalifikasjoner
Du må ha:

  • godkjent undervisningskompetanse for barnetrinnet etter opplæringsloven § 17-3 og 17-4 for de to faste stillingene
  • minimum 30 studiepoeng i minst ett av basisfagene, norsk, engelsk, matematikk. Det er derfor viktig at du dokumenterer fagene du har (med antall studiepoeng). 
  • god kompetanse i grunnleggende lese-, skrive- og regneopplæring 
  • gode skriftlige og muntlige kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk
  • kompetanse i intensiv opplæring, jf. opplæringsloven §11-3 
  • kompetanse og ha innsikt i opplæringsloven kapittel 3 og 11
  • kompetanse innen klasseledelse og kunne være kontaktlærer
  • for et av de utlyste vikariatene må du ha kompetanse innen tilpasset opplæring og individuell tilrettelegging i opplæringslovens kapittel 11 
  • gyldig og tilfredsstillende politiattest i henhold til opplæringsloven. Politiattest må fremvises før tiltredelse. 

Det er ønskelig at du har:

  • for en stilling er det ønskelig med spesifikk kompetanse innen begynneropplæring og tidlig innsats (§11-3), særlig knyttet til lese- og skriveopplæring da en av stillingene er tiltenkt å jobbe med tidlig innsats i begynneropplæringen
  • kompetanse innen grunnleggende norskopplæring og intensiv opplæring i lesing, skriving og regning
  • erfaring med læring i teknologirike omgivelser, og at du er opptatt av god digital læringsledelse for å bidra til at den profesjonsfaglige digitalkompetanse utvikles i tråd med nye læreplaner

Dine egenskaper
Vi søker etter deg som:

  • viser lojalitet til skolens felles standarder og rutiner og bidrar til en godt arbeidsmiljø
  • har et raust og varmt hjerte for alle elever og tenker inkludering i alt du gjør
  • har evne til å skape gode relasjoner og veilede elever
  • er en tydelig og trygg klasseleder, med gode strukturer og rutiner
  • benytter systematisk underveisvurdering og har undervisning med høy elevaktivitet og elevmedvirkning
  • kan vurdere elevenes læringsutbytte, og bruker dette aktivt i opplæringen for å fremme elevenes læringsutbytte (VFL)
  • kan samarbeide og tenke helhetlig rundt elevers oppvekst- og læringsmiljø og vektlegger et godt skole-hjem samarbeid
  • liker utfordringer, er løsningsorientert og viser stor arbeidslyst
  • er engasjert, liker utviklingsarbeid og har godt humør

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt. 

Vi tilbyr 

Vi tilbyr deg jobb i et positivt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø, der vi samarbeider på tvers av trinn og fag for å utvikle skolens profesjonsfaglig felleskap. Hos oss er vi opptatt av å realisere intensjonen med læreplanene, slik at elevene våre opplever skolen som helhetlig og relevant.

  • veiledning og oppfølging av nyutdannede
  • funksjonelle og romslige undervisningslokaler
  • et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og dyktige kolleger
  • engasjert og positivt FAU
  • lønn i tråd med dine kvalifikasjoner og ansiennitet med innplassering i KS` tariffavtale kapittel 4
  • kontaktlærertillegg fra kr. 32.000 - 50.000 pr. år (avhengig av antall elever)
  • gode lån, pensjons- og forsikringsordninger i Statens Pensjonskasse
  • gratis parkering og kort vei til offentlig kommunikasjon

Din søknad
Søknad registreres elektronisk i Easycruit ved å klikke på "Søk her". Du må fylle ut feltene «Utdannelse» og «Arbeidserfaring» og laste opp søknadsbrev, CV, relevante vitnemål og eventuelle attester. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at vi ikke tar imot søknader pr. e-post eller papirsøknader. 

Inkludering
Vi ønsker et arbeidsmiljø preget av mangfold og inkludering, og at våre ansatte skal gjenspeile befolkningen. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn. Vi legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdet dersom du har behov for det og så langt det lar seg gjøre innenfor stillingens oppgaver og krav.

Offentlighet
Gjerdrum kommune praktiserer meroffentlighet ved tilsetninger og det vil bli satt opp en offentlig søkerliste etter søknadsfristens utløp. Søker kan be om å ikke bli oppført på søkerlisten og må gi en saklig begrunnelse, jf. offentlighetsloven § 25. Dersom det etter vår vurdering ikke foreligger særskilt grunn for å bli unntatt offentlighet, vil opplysninger om søker bli offentliggjort på søkerlisten. Søkeren blir i disse tilfellene orientert og får muligheten til eventuelt å trekke søknaden sin før offentliggjøring, jf. offentlighetsloven § 25.

Vi ønsker ikke kontakt med annonseselgere.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sektor oppvekst skal ha et helhetlig grep om barn og unges oppvekst, innbyggerens utvikling og mestring også ut over virksomhetenes tilbud. Flerfaglig samarbeid, fellesskap, samhandling, og tidlig innsats er førende i tråd med aktiv medvirkning, forskning og erfaring. Vi er sammen om å gi tilpassede tjenester av god kvalitet. Vi ønsker oss flere trygge, modige, rause, robuste, innovative, faglige sterke og godt samhandlende medarbeidere som ønsker å bidra inn i sektor oppvekst. Bli med på laget i en kommune i sterk vekst! Gjerdrum kommune, sentralt plassert mellom Oslo og Gardermoen, er en liten perle på Romerike. Med drøyt 7 500 innbyggere er vi en attraktiv bokommune med et levende lokalmiljø og unike muligheter for friluftsliv. Her finner du alt fra turstier, skiløyper og fiskevann til et bredt kultur- og idrettstilbud. Vårt kommunesenter, Ask, byr på et koselig miljø med det du behøver av butikker, restauranter og spennende spesialforretninger. Vi søker nå framtidsrettede, rause, entusiastiske og modige ledere og medarbeidere som vil være med på å forme fremtiden for våre innbyggere. Det betyr at vi trenger ledere og medarbeidere som søker ny kompetanse, finner innovative løsninger, har god vurderingsevne og jobber godt sammen internt og eksternt. I Gjerdrum tenker vi helhet, ser muligheter og handler sammen. Er du klar for å gjøre en forskjell? Les mer og søk på vår hjemmeside!

jobs.title: Project Manager  & Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

Location

This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich , the role will be based remotely or hybrid from Germany or Austria
As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month, these visits are financially supported by BLP.

Your Mission

As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you’ll operate at the intersection of business and tech — leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You’ll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the implementation journey end-to-end — from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

  • Translate complexity into clarity — design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

  • Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers’ unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

  • Be the client’s trusted partner — anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp’s automation.

  • Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

  • Feed the product loop — translate feedback into long-term improvements to continuously evolve our platform.


What We’re Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Managing Ambiguity – You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

What You Bring

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

  • Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

  • Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus

  • Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.


Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a self-financed, independent company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.


Ready to build the future of ERP automation?
Join us — and own your impact.

Stellenbeschreibung

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
🏆 What's the opportunity?

Air freight carries less than 1% of world trade by volume and more than a third of it by value, around $22.7 billion of goods every single day. It's how a vaccine reaches a clinic before it spoils, how a semiconductor arrives before the production line stops, and how a retailer restocks a continent away in three days instead of five weeks. When speed is the whole point, freight flies.

Somebody has to price it, book it and move it, and that work is still done largely by hand, in inboxes and spreadsheets.

For eight years we've been building the data infrastructure underneath it: direct integrations with 75 airlines, the top ten ocean carriers and dozens of GSAs, used every day by 30,000 freight forwarders across 172 countries to hold their rates, price their business and book their freight.

In 2026 we acquired Cargofive, and cargo.one now spans air and ocean, the two modes that carry international trade. That foundation is what makes the next part possible.

In March 2026 we launched the industry's first AI-native operating system for multimodal freight:one workspace where freight teams and AI agents work side by side across rate management, procurement, quoting, booking and support. Crane Worldwide and Yusen Logistics are rolling it out across their global operations.

AI-led engineering is how we build. Engineers write specs and acceptance criteria, agents do much of the implementation, and the engineer owns the architecture, the review and what ships.

We're backed by Index Ventures, Bessemer, Creandum, Point Nine, Next47 and Lufthansa Cargo, which has been an investor in us since 2018.

🚀 What makes this role different

This is an engineering management job for a team where agents do much of the implementation. That changes the job.

When producing code gets cheaper and faster, the bottleneck moves. Throughput depends more on how well engineers define the problem, direct the agents, review what comes back and tell a plausible answer from a correct one.

You'll lead our engineers: what they ship, how good it is, how fast they move, whether the people are growing, and how quickly the team gets better at working AI-led. A lot of what engineering managers know about pacing, estimating, reviewing and measuring a team was calibrated for a different bottleneck. Working out what good looks like now is part of this job.

Today, engineers direct agents on their own work. That's where we are, but it's not the end state. We're building toward fleets of agents that work on their own inside guardrails and harnesses we design, while engineers move up to setting direction, reviewing what comes back, and owning what ships. Part of your job is helping the team get there while keeping the quality bar high.

This is also a player-coach role. You'll stay close enough to the code to keep your judgment sharp and your technical credibility current, while the engineers you lead and what they deliver remain the focus.

🧭 What we're looking for — the part that isn't negotiable

You get more from growing people than from being the smartest person in the room. You've watched someone you managed become better than you at something and enjoyed it. You run real one-to-ones, not status meetings. You give hard feedback early and kindly, and you've done the hard version more than once.

You think in systems. Teams are systems too. You can see why delivery is slipping without needing someone to tell you, and you fix the process rather than working harder inside a broken one.

You're excited about the business. You want to know what your engineers' work is worth and what it does for the customer paying us. You can explain that to them so their work has a point beyond the issue they're closing.

You work at eye level with Product. You co-own what gets built and when, push back on the brief, and don't treat "Product decides, Engineering delivers" as a healthy way to work.

You want to be in the room with customers. Freight forwarders and airlines, directly. You'd rather hear the problem first-hand, and you take your engineers with you.

English is your working language, at close to native fluency. You write and speak it the way you think in it. Almost everything a manager does in a remote-first company is language: the feedback that has to land precisely, the written decision that stops a debate, the difficult conversation where the wrong word costs you trust.

You'll also need:

  • Experience managing engineers: hiring them, growing them, running performance honestly and shipping on a predictable cadence.

  • A backend engineering background, strong architecture instincts and enough technical currency that your engineers respect your technical opinion.

  • A delivery track record. Specific things that shipped, on a schedule you can describe, and an honest account of what slipped and why.

  • Experience building a team, not only running one. You know how to assess for potential, close a candidate and set someone up so their first ninety days work.

  • Genuine engagement with AI-led engineering. You don't need to be an expert, but you can't manage engineers working this way from the outside. You need to use the tools yourself and want to get good at them.

  • Judgment, and the nerve to use it. You'll make calls with incomplete information and own them out loud.

  • Low ego. You take feedback from your own engineers and change your mind in public.

Nice to have: experience with our stack of Python 3, Flask, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery and Kubernetes on GCP; Vue.js; managing a distributed team across several countries; or introducing a new way of working to a team that didn't ask for one.

🎬 A snapshot of what you'll be doing

  • Own delivery. What ships, how good it is and whether the commitments you make hold.

  • Grow the people. One-to-ones that are worth the hour, honest performance conversations, career paths that mean something, and knowing what each person wants next.

  • Hire. You'll own the hiring bar and run your own loops. We hire senior engineers on judgement and character rather than AI experience, and teach them the workflow. You'll be central to making that work.

  • Partner with Product as an equal. Shape the roadmap, negotiate scope and protect engineers from churn that isn't worth it.

  • Raise the team's AI capability. Help engineers use agents better today, spread what works, remove friction, and help evolve our setup toward autonomous agent fleets with the right guardrails and harnesses in place.

  • Stay technical, roughly a day a week. Reviews, a well-chosen piece of work, enough to keep your hands and judgement in.

  • Go to the users. Sit with freight forwarders and airlines, and take your engineers with you.

🤖 What you'd be working with

We're honest about where we are: Everything below is real and running today, but some of it is young, adoption is uneven across our five teams, and the next stage doesn't exist yet. You'd help build it, not inherit it.

How we work AI-led:

  • Work starts from a spec: Tickets and specs are drafted with agent help, against our agreed templates. Once a spec meets the bar, engineers pick it up, refine it, and own the design and architecture decisions; only then do agents start implementing.

  • Conventions for how agents get context, how work runs in parallel, and how the results come back together safely.

  • AI review on every merge request in CI, and a human review standard built for telling a plausible answer from a correct one.

What we've built to make that work:

  • Our shared AI engineering practice: spec templates, a directory of reusable AI skills, agent harnesses and review conventions for giving agents context, running work in parallel and bringing the results back together safely.

  • A Slack-triggered agent (Timber) that takes a Jira ticket and delivers a merge request, currently handling all bugs and small, well-scoped tickets and built on our RAG context layer and a memory layer.

  • A triage agent that protects the team's focus: it routes incoming questions, tickets and reports from other internal teams to the right engineering team and does the first level of triage itself; answering directly, creating a bug ticket, or escalating to a human.

The furthest edge of this is our AI team's production work, the bar the rest of the practice is being pulled toward, and closing that gap across the department is part of your job:

  • AI doing commercial work in production. In June 2026, Saudia Cargo went live with an AI worker our engineers built. It handles inbound rate requests around the clock and returns a quote in seconds, cutting turnaround time by 68% with 89% first-time accuracy.

  • An LLM pipeline turning airlines' free-text email replies into structured, bookable quotes.

❤️ How we work

  • Feedback is constant and direct, in both directions. You'll get it in your first week and you're expected to give it.

  • Remote-first, which means we write things down.

  • You take ownership, and you back your opinions with data.

  • Given the ambitious option and the easy one, you take the ambitious one.

  • Diverse, and playful about it.

✨ What we offer

  • Equity in cargo.one. This role is equity-eligible.

  • Company-provided Claude Code and the other AI tools the work requires.

  • A one-time €650 home office budget, plus your choice of MacBook or Dell laptop, delivered before day one.

  • Co-working access through our partner Desana.

  • 24 paid vacation days on top of your country's public holidays, plus special leave.

  • Two company-wide offsites a year, plus team trips.

  • Permanent full-time employment. In Germany, a contract with cargo.one. In Portugal, a contract with our subsidiary Cargo Five. Elsewhere in our approved hiring countries, through our partner Remote.com.

🌍 Where you'll work

We're remote across our approved hiring countries in the European timezone band, so the engineering team overlaps for most of the working day.

We currently hire in:

Armenia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Georgia, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Malta, Moldova, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Ukraine and the United Kingdom.

We meet in person regularly, including twice a year as a full company.

We can currently support visa processes in Germany only.

We hire for talent. If you don't tick every box but think you'd be a great match, reach out anyway. We'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Applied AI
jobs.description:
About Nomos

Europe pays more than twice as much for electricity as the US or Asia. To reach competitive price levels, Europe has to lean on solar and deliver the flexibility that makes this feasible. Nomos is building a full-stack power company to unlock that flexibility by connecting millions of homes to Europe’s energy markets.

At Nomos, we care about our craft and take full responsibility for what we build. We hire for spikes, not an absence of weaknesses, and look for exceptional ability backed by a record of achievement. This has brought together IMO and IOI medalists, former founders and Olympic athletes in a team whose individual strengths reinforce one another.

 

What you’ll do

We’re building an energy company from first principles. That means rethinking the operational work behind it: which processes we need, how they run, and what agents can take on. You’ll build the AI systems that let Nomos serve more customers without scaling manual work at the same rate.

  • Work directly with customers and internal teams to understand their workflows and find where AI can make the biggest difference.

  • Build agents and integrations that handle real operational work, from customer onboarding to communication with energy market participants.

  • Own what you ship: design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.

 

Exciting challenges

  • Rethink how an energy company operates. Building from scratch gives us the freedom to question processes that established suppliers take for granted. You’ll decide how software, agents, and people work together and turn that into systems the company depends on every day.

  • Put the newest AI capabilities to work in production. Nomos is built around AI. You’ll have access to new models and tools as they become available, with generous spending limits to experiment. The engineering challenge is making them dependable at scale: testing behaviour, handling exceptions, and knowing when a person needs to step in.

 

Who you are

  • You’ve shipped and operated production software. You understand how systems fit together, how they fail, and how to keep them working as usage grows.

  • You have hands-on experience building with AI. You can connect models to tools and data, evaluate their behaviour, and make sound decisions about where agents are useful.

  • You move quickly and care about the details. You turn an ambiguous problem into working software, test it properly, and stay responsible for it after launch.

 

References

jobs.description:
About the team

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks to link an account. The goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

As the founding backend engineer, you'll set the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control. You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with the team's engineering manager and a small founding group that will grow around you, but you'll be the one setting the technical direction. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk.

What you'll do

You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. You're setting the technical defaults a growing team will inherit, so the early decisions matter.

Day to day, that looks like:

  • Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production

  • Running what you build. You'll be on-call for your own work from early on, before there's a dedicated platform to lean on, which means owning the infrastructure, CI, deployment, and observability behind it

  • Working on top of external platforms you can't change, and being straight about which risks are yours to manage and which aren't

  • Partnering closely with the internal teams whose services you depend on: asking clearly, agreeing on interfaces, and finding ways to keep moving instead of waiting around to be unblocked

We'd also expect you to have opinions about where this should go, and to write them down. A lot of what shapes the team's direction starts as a doc.

  • Solid backend and systems instincts. You can reason about deployment topology, multi-tenancy, and data movement, and you're comfortable owning architectural tradeoffs you'll have to live with later

  • You've worked with modern auth protocols, service principals, and identity federation, and you know how to get it right across a trust boundary

  • You've built on someone else's platform and know what that's actually like: incomplete docs, unintended breaking changes, etc.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

- Kunden-Onboarding: Du übernimmst die vollständige Einarbeitung (Onboarding) neuer Kunden – sowohl Unternehmen als auch Steuerberaterkanzleien – in die Pennylane-Plattform. Du stellst sicher, dass sie schnell den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus unserer Lösung ziehen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

 
 

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Kanzlei-Umfeld oder alternativ im SaaS- oder Fintech-Bereich.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Steuerberater oder Studium im Finance-Bereich

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

jobs.title: Product Designer - Germany (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Möchtest du das Leben von Millionen Unternehmer in Europa verändern?

Du möchtest echten Impact haben und die Zukunft von Finanzen und Buchhaltung in Europa mitgestalten? Du fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl, das auf Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und Geschwindigkeit setzt? Und unsere Design-Prinzipien entsprechen deiner Vorstellung von großartigen Nutzererlebnissen?

Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein – und du genau die richtige Person für diese Rolle.

Unsere Vision

Wir bauen das beliebteste Financial Operating System für kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen in Europa.

Unser Ziel ist es, Unternehmer von zeitaufwendigen Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu entlasten und ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu den wichtigsten Finanzinformationen zu geben, damit sie bessere Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen treffen können.

Gleichzeitig unterstützen wir Steuerkanzleien dabei, weniger Zeit für repetitive Aufgaben aufzuwenden und sich stärker auf die Beratung und Betreuung ihrer Mandant zu konzentrieren.

Bereits heute nutzen mehr als 1.000.000 kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen sowie über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien Pennylane in Frankreich.

Über uns

Pennylane gehört zu den am schnellsten wachsenden FinTechs in Frankreich – und bald auch in Deutschland.

In nur fünf Jahren haben wir:

  • uns als innovative Accounting- und Finanzplattform für Unternehmen und Steuerkanzleien etabliert,

  • insgesamt 150 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – unter anderem von Sequoia, dem renommierten Silicon-Valley-Investor hinter Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe und PayPal,

  • unser Team von 7 Gründer auf über 1.100 Pennylaners ausgebaut,

  • eine internationale Unternehmenskultur mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten geschaffen,

  • eine starke Remote-First-Kultur etabliert, in der bereits rund 30 % unserer Mitarbeitenden von überall in Europa arbeiten,

  • das Vertrauen tausender Kund und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

Heute gelten wir mit einer Glassdoor-Bewertung von 4,6/5 als einer der attraktivsten Arbeitgeber Europas.

Pennylane Deutschland

Innerhalb von nur 1,5 Jahren ist unser Deutschland-Team von einer einzelnen Squad auf über 40 Mitarbeitende in den Bereichen Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success und Marketing gewachsen.

Unser Ziel ist es, Pennylane als festen Bestandteil des deutschen Marktes zu etablieren. Gemeinsam mit innovativen Steuerberater und Unternehmen entwickeln wir unser Produkt für die Anforderungen des deutschen Marktes weiter und verändern nachhaltig die Art und Weise, wie Buchhaltung und Finanzen in Deutschland funktionieren.

Als eigenständiger Markt profitieren wir von der Unterstützung unserer französischen Teams und genießen gleichzeitig große Freiheiten bei der Gestaltung unserer Ziele, Strukturen, Prozesse und Produkte.

Design bei Pennylane

Design steht im Zentrum unserer Mission. Unser Anspruch ist es, Nutzer ein nahtloses, zugängliches und begeisterndes Produkterlebnis zu bieten.

Unser Design-Team besteht aus über 40 Product Designer, die in interdisziplinären Squads eng mit Product und Engineering zusammenarbeiten.

Autonomie, Vertrauen und Transparenz bilden das Fundament unserer Unternehmenskultur und prägen den Arbeitsalltag unserer Designer.

Bei Pennylane beschränkt sich Design nicht auf die Gestaltung von Interfaces. Designer begleiten den gesamten Prozess – von der Definition des Problems über Research und Testing bis hin zur Umsetzung der Lösung.

Deine Rolle

Wir suchen eine Product Designer mit fundierter Erfahrung im B2B-Produktdesign, um die Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts in Deutschland aktiv mitzugestalten.

Wenn du gerne reale Nutzerprobleme löst, in einem kollaborativen Umfeld arbeitest und ein echtes Interesse daran hast, Nutzerverhalten und Geschäftsziele zu verstehen, wirst du bei Pennylane viele Gleichgesinnte finden.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du verstehst sowohl Nutzerbedürfnisse als auch Business-Anforderungen und kannst Erkenntnisse aus User Research, Marktanalysen und Daten in pragmatische Lösungen übersetzen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit komplexen digitalen Produkten und Systemen, beispielsweise mit mehreren Modulen, umfangreichen Funktionen oder komplexen Datenstrukturen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Entwickler, Product Manager und weiteren Stakeholdern wie Sales oder Support zusammen und kannst technische Rahmenbedingungen sowie Business-Ziele in deine Arbeit integrieren.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, hinterfragst bestehende Annahmen konstruktiv und kannst deine Lösungsansätze überzeugend vertreten.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. User Interviews werden regelmäßig auf Deutsch durchgeführt.

Was dich bei Pennylane erwartet

Innerhalb des ersten Monats

  • Du lernst unser Unternehmen, unsere Teams und unsere Vision während des Onboardings kennen.

  • Du erhältst einen tiefen Einblick in unser Produkt sowie die Welt der Buchhaltung und Finanzen.

  • Du machst dich mit unserer Product- und Design-Organisation, unseren Methoden und unserer Kultur vertraut.

  • Du lernst die Menschen kennen, mit denen du täglich zusammenarbeiten wirst – sowohl innerhalb des Deutschland-Teams als auch im internationalen Umfeld.

Innerhalb der ersten drei Monate

  • Du führst Discovery-Workshops und User Research durch und analysierst Daten, Nutzerfeedback und Business-Anforderungen.

  • Gemeinsam mit deinem Product Manager verantwortest du die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung deines Produktbereichs.

  • Du entwickelst Lösungen in der passenden Detailtiefe – von ersten Konzepten bis hin zu High-Fidelity-Prototypen.

  • Du bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv ins Team ein, gibst Feedback an Kolleg und arbeitest an bereichsübergreifenden Themen mit.

Innerhalb der ersten sechs Monate

  • Du unterstützt aktiv beim Ausbau unseres Teams und wirkst im Recruiting-Prozess mit.

  • Du beobachtest aktuelle UX- und UI-Trends und bringst Best Practices aus der internationalen Tech-Welt ein.

Und darüber hinaus

Sowohl unser Design-Team als auch unsere Aktivitäten in Deutschland werden weiter wachsen.

Das bedeutet für dich:

  • Möglichkeiten, neue Designer einzustellen, zu coachen und perspektivisch zu führen.

  • Mehr Verantwortung für strategische Projekte.

  • Die Chance, Prozesse, Tools und Best Practices aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Arbeite aus unserem Büro im Herzen Berlins, aus unserem Standort in Hamburg, aus unseren Büros in Paris oder aus jedem WeWork-Standort in Europa.

  • Bei einem Full-Remote-Vertrag erhältst du ein Budget für dein Home Office sowie einen monatlichen Zuschuss für Coworking-Spaces.

  • Zusätzlich zu 25 Urlaubstagen erhältst du jährlich zwischen 8 und 13 weitere freie Tage.

  • Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch zu verbessern oder eine neue Sprache zu lernen.

  • Modernste Apple-Hardware für deinen Arbeitsalltag.

  • Eine lebendige Community mit gemeinsamen Sportaktivitäten wie Fußball, Laufen oder Klettern.

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events, After-Work-Abende und unsere beliebten Rooftop-Drinks in Berlin.

  • Ein jährliches Company Offsite – zuletzt waren wir gemeinsam im Center Parcs und hatten eine großartige Zeit.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Portfolio Review

  2. Erstgespräch mit Sonia oder Barbara (Technical Recruiting) – 30 Minuten

  3. Interview mit zwei Mitgliedern unseres Design-Teams – 45 bis 60 Minuten

  4. Take-Home Assessment inklusive Präsentation und Review mit zwei weiteren Designer – 60 Minuten

  5. Finales Gespräch mit unserem Chief Product Officer und dem Head of Product Germany – 60 Minuten

Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit

Bei Pennylane fördern wir Vielfalt in all ihren Formen und schaffen ein inklusives, wertschätzendes und erfüllendes Arbeitsumfeld – sowohl im Büro als auch remote.

Wir bieten allen Bewerber die gleichen Chancen – unabhängig von Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, Alter oder Behinderung.

jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer, Robot control (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About TACTILIA:

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role:

As a (Senior) Software Engineer, Robot Control at TACTILIA Robotics, you will help design and build the software that turns our robotic hardware into a reliable, scalable product.

You will work across embedded, control, and application software, taking ownership of complex technical problems and helping shape the architecture as the platform evolves. You will work closely with the CTO and engineering team, with the autonomy to make important technical decisions and see them through to working systems.

This is a hands-on role. You will move between architecture, implementation, and the lab, solving the challenges that arise when software meets real hardware

What you will do:

  • Set the architecture. Embedded, control, and application layers — modular and reusable across product variants, not a one-off for a single prototype.

  • Write the control loops that can't miss a beat. Deterministic firmware on the embedded target: hardware abstraction, sensor/actuator integration, fault handling, hard real-time constraints. No room for "usually works."

  • Turn commands into grasps. Position, torque, force impedance and admittance control, coordinated multi-finger motion, and handle all different states to make the grasp stable and reliable

  • Build the simulation before hardware pays the price Simulation models for control development, regression testing, and sim-to-real validation — most iteration should happen before anyone touches a real hand.

  • Ship SDKs people actually want to integrate. ROS 2, fieldbuses, and customer-facing interfaces — documented and version-stable, not tribal knowledge.

  • Make the sensor data mean something. Build the pipeline for tactile, position, and force data; build models for slip detection and contact-state estimation; turn field telemetry into the next product iteration.

  • Get ahead of the Cyber Resilience Act. Security by design, SBOM, vulnerability handling, a real update path — well before the December 2027 deadline, including the technical documentation for conformity assessment.

  • Build tooling like it's product, not plumbing. CI/CD, automated and simulation-based regression tests, logging and diagnostics you'd actually want to debug with at 2am.

  • Work across the whole team. Tight loop with Electronics, Mechanics, and Application —spec input, customer integration support, the works.

What you bring:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field.

  • 5–10 years building embedded, robotics, or control software, ideally including at least one product that reached series production or product maturity

  • Strong modern C++ and Python with a deep understanding of real-time behaviour, concurrency, memory and resource constraints

  • Solid hands-on experience with robot control: closed-loop control, state estimation, filtering, motion coordination, force/impedance control, or related areas.

  • You have architected software for a product, not a prototype someone else productionized later

  • Simulation-based development (Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MuJoCo, or similar)

  • Comfortable with Linux, Git, CI/CD, automated testing

  • A strong hardware mindset: you enjoy bringing up systems, debugging on real robots, and getting to the bottom of problems with a scope, logic analyzer, debugger, or whatever tool gets the job done

  • Fluent English; German is a plus, not a requirement

Bonus:

  • Dexterous manipulation, grasp planning, or robotic hands

  • Tactile sensing and contact-rich manipulation

jobs.description:
Head of Product (f/m/d)

About TACTILIA:

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of Schunk, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the product, roadmap, and development process that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard robotics questions become real product decisions: how do we turn customer needs into a highly capable robotic hand that is reliable, manufacturable, and ready to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As Head of Product at TACTILIA, you will be the operational backbone of our product development. You will turn customer requirements into a robust roadmap — and the roadmap into a product that reaches the customer on time, on budget and at production quality.

You will lead through structure, clarity and commitment rather than hierarchy, and report to the CTO. You will work across product development, engineering and customer needs, keeping priorities aligned as TACTILIA moves from development towards production and scale.

What you will do

  • Own the product roadmap. Turn customer and market needs into clear product priorities and continuously balance customer value, engineering effort, technical risk, and time-to-market.

  • Turn requirements into product decisions. Work with Applications and customers to translate needs into clear, testable specifications, maintaining traceability from RFQ through validation.

  • Orchestrate product development. Coordinate Mechatronics, Software, Electronics, Systems Engineering and Applications across milestones, dependencies and interfaces, resolving conflicting priorities when needed.

  • Drive the product to production. Own development milestones, gate reviews, budget, unit cost and quality through to production readiness, while helping establish a scalable product development process.

  • Make the hard trade-offs. Bring together customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, quality and schedule to make pragmatic decisions and keep development moving.

  • Stay close to customers. Support the CTO in technical customer discussions, feasibility assessments, RFQs, trade fairs and partner conversations, bringing market feedback back into the product.

  • Build the organisation around the product. Identify gaps in capacity, skills and ownership across engineering, translate them into concrete hiring needs, and make pragmatic make-or-buy decisions.

  • Build for the real world. Work with engineering and operations to ensure the product is not only technically capable, but manufacturable, testable, reliable and ready to scale.

What you bring

  • A degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a comparable technical field.

YOUR MISSION

 

A software engineer today uses Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest.

 

We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers, with real revenue and customers who tell us when we are slow.

 

The problems are open ones. Getting an agent to reason usefully about geometry, making 3D search work on real customer part libraries, and figuring out what the interface even looks like when an engineer asks why a bracket failed. There is research to borrow from and very little product to copy.

 

Senior or staff level depending on experience.

 

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 

You will own large problems end to end, across the stack. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but here is what the last two years have actually involved.

 

  • A multi-agent orchestration SDK, built from scratch. Nothing off the shelf handled what we needed: long-horizon execution that runs for hours and survives restarts.

  • CAD conversion as a real pipeline. It used to be manual and brittle. Turning it into production infrastructure meant writing a Python wrapper around a C++ SDK and making it reliable enough to sit under everything else.

  • Migrating the application off Electron and Webpack onto SSR React with Vite. That architecture is what the whole product now sits on.

 

What is coming:

 

  • 3D-to-3D search across real customer part libraries, not benchmark datasets

  • Constraint solvers and optimization, and getting an agent to use one sensibly

  • Agents that hold a useful model of a physical object, which is still an open problem

We work in Python and TypeScript, with multi-agent orchestration and AI integrations across several providers.

  • Your CV reads as a set of problems, not a stack

jobs.title: Founding Legal Engineer
jobs.description:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.


About the role

You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice.

Working directly with Grubel’s founding team, you will shape our research, development, and product: Translate complex legal processes into agentic workflows, evaluate our systems for legal soundness and utility, and work with customers to set our product and engineering standards. You need not write code, but you’re passionate about understanding our technology deeply. Working in a fast-moving team at the intersection of AI research, legal practice, and technology excites you.

What you’ll work on

  • Designing realistic tasks, datasets, and evaluation rubrics for training and evaluation of our legal AI systems

  • Translating complex legal processes into agentic workflows together with our researchers and engineers

  • Evaluating system outputs for legal accuracy, usefulness, and failure modes

  • Supporting customer discovery, demonstrations, and go-to-market initiatives

You may be a good fit if
