jobs.description:
Helsestasjon for kjønn og seksualitet (HKS) søker erfaringskonsulent og/eller terapeuter som kan organisere og gjennomføre deler av HKS sitt gruppetilbud. Vi gjennomfører gruppesamlinger ca annenhver uke på ettermiddag/kveldstid, med et omfang på ca 3-4 timer per gang. Man lønnes på timebasis basert på faktisk arbeidede timer. Stillingen er avhengig av prosjektfinansiering.

Vi ser etter trygge og engasjerte terapeuter og/eller erfaringskonsulenter som ønsker å bidra til å skape et trygt og bekreftende miljø. Vi har særlig behov for leder for grupper til transfeminine for øyeblikket. Vi legger vekt på å skape gode sosiale møteplasser, der personer med kjønnsinkongruens får utveksle erfaringer, og får en møteplass med stor takhøyde og rom for å være seg selv. Gruppeleders oppgave er å ivareta, støtte og styre gruppene og skape et trygt rom der deltakerne kan få positive erfaringer. Det er rom for å sette eget preg på gruppene. Vi ønsker at du som søker har en særlig interesse for og erfaring med å jobbe i miljøer med kjønns- og seksualitetsmangfold. Erfaring med gruppeledelse er en fordel. Du blir del  av et team med andre gruppeledere.

HKS består av et tverrfaglig team med spesialkompetanse innen sexologisk rådgivning. Fagteamet er satt sammen av helsesykepleiere, familieterapeut, vernepleier, psykologer, lege og endokrinolog. Sammen møter vi barn og unge opp til 30 år med ulike behov knyttet til kjønnsidentitet, seksualitet og minoritetsstress. Vi tilbyr samtaler, korttidsterapi, gruppetilbud, samt støtte til foreldre og nettverk. Som lavterskeltilbud er vi opptatt av å møte mennesker der de er, med faglig trygghet, åpenhet og fleksibilitet.

Les mer om oss på www.hksoslo.no

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)

Du kennst den Unterschied zwischen einer geschalteten Anzeige und einer funktionierenden Recruiting-Strategie? Und du willst nicht nur eine Position im Haus besetzen, sondern die Personalgewinnung ganzer Unternehmen verantworten? Dann lies weiter.

Im klassischen Inhouse-Recruiting arbeitest du an den Stellen, die dir zugewiesen werden, mit dem Budget, das jemand anderes verhandelt hat. Bei uns läuft es umgekehrt: Du entscheidest, welche Unternehmen du gewinnst, wie ihre Recruiting-Strategie aussieht und über welche Kanäle die Besetzung läuft. Beratung, Umsetzung und Ergebnis liegen in einer Hand – deiner.

Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung im Zentrum von Bielefeld. Wir machen Arbeitgeber sichtbar und liefern ihnen planbar passende Bewerbungen – über datengetriebene Kampagnen statt Zufallstreffer. Fachkräftemangel und demografische Entwicklung lassen diesen Markt jedes Jahr weiter wachsen.

Deine Verantwortung

Strategie und Beratung

  • Du analysierst, warum die Personalgewinnung eines Unternehmens nicht liefert – Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Kanäle, Prozessgeschwindigkeit.

  • Daraus entwickelst du eine belastbare Recruiting-Strategie und stellst sie den Entscheidern vor.

  • Du gewinnst neue Kunden aktiv: über Telefon, Direktansprache und Empfehlungen.

Kampagnen und Besetzung

  • Du planst Recruiting-Kampagnen, steuerst sie über die Laufzeit und justierst anhand der Zahlen nach.

  • Du prüfst eingehende Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche zur Vorauswahl und gestaltest eine Candidate Experience, die im Gedächtnis bleibt.

  • Bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung bleibt das Projekt in deiner Hand.

Daten und Weiterentwicklung

  • Du arbeitest sauber im CRM, kennst deine Kennzahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

  • Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung schärfst du unsere Methodik weiter.

Dein Profil

  • Recruiting-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Zielgruppenansprache, Kanalauswahl und Prozessgestaltung zusammenwirken – ob aus Agentur, Personaldienstleistung oder Inhouse.

  • Beratungsstärke: Du triffst mit deinen Fragen den Kern, denkst in Lösungen und erklärst sie so, dass Entscheider mitgehen.

  • Vertriebsbereitschaft: Neue Kunden zu gewinnen gehört für dich dazu und schreckt dich nicht ab.

  • Zahlenaffinität: Du liest Kampagnendaten, erkennst Muster und handelst danach.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du steuerst dich selbst, hältst nach Rückschlägen Kurs und misst dich an Ergebnissen.

  • Zum Hintergrund: Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg – wir schauen auf Können und Antrieb, nicht auf den Titel. Erfahrung im Recruiting ist willkommen, aber nichts, was wir dir nicht beibringen könnten.

Unser Angebot

  • Vergütung ohne Obergrenze: Fixgehalt als sichere Basis, dazu eine Provision, die nicht gedeckelt ist.

  • Unbefristet vom ersten Tag an: Wir planen langfristig – in einem Markt, der stabil wächst.

  • Klarer Entwicklungspfad: Recruiter, Junior Consultant, Senior Consultant. Das Tempo bestimmst du.

  • Einarbeitung mit Struktur: Umfassendes Onboarding, Trainings zu Recruiting, Beratung und Vertrieb, dazu feste Feedbackrunden.

  • Ausstattung auf Niveau: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Hardware – mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.

  • Fitness auf unsere Kosten: Premium-Mitgliedschaft im Studio deiner Wahl.

  • Gut versorgt: Siebträgerkaffee von Julius Meinl, ausgesuchte Tees, flexibles Mittagsangebot über Meyer Menü.

  • Flache Hierarchie: Leistungsorientiert und kollegial, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

Der Ablauf

  1. Bewerben in zwei Minuten – Lebenslauf genügt, kein Anschreiben nötig.

  2. Telefonat zum Kennenlernen – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

  3. Persönliches Gespräch in unserem Büro in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.

Wenn du Recruiting nicht abarbeiten, sondern gestalten willst: Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Senior Prototyping Engineer (f/m/d) – Thermal Systems & Cooling Integration
jobs.description:
As a Senior Prototyping Engineer – Thermal Systems & Cooling Integration, you will become an integral part of our Prototyping team, supporting the development of our Reliant platform – a next-generation long-range eVTOL unmanned aerial system designed for demanding ISR and logistics missions. Reliant combines exceptional endurance, modularity, and operational flexibility to deliver mission-critical capabilities in the most challenging environments.

In this role, you will be responsible for the integration, development, and validation of thermal management and cooling systems for the aircraft. You will develop efficient cooling concepts for hybrid propulsion components, power electronics, avionics, and other heat-generating systems by optimizing airflow, aerodynamic cooling, and thermal integration. Working closely with mechanical, propulsion, and systems engineering teams, you will ensure reliable operation across demanding flight and environmental conditions.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Lead the integration and development of thermal management and cooling systems for UAVs.

  • Design and optimize cooling concepts for combustion engines, generators, power electronics, avionics, and other onboard systems.

  • Develop aerodynamic cooling solutions, including airflow management, ducting, air inlets and outlets, heat exchangers, and passive and active cooling concepts.

  • Define thermal system architectures balancing cooling performance, weight, packaging, reliability, and manufacturability.

  • Design, build, and commission prototype cooling test rigs and instrumentation for system validation.

  • Plan and execute thermal, environmental, endurance, and performance test campaigns.

  • Analyze thermal performance, airflow distribution, and system efficiency, implementing improvements based on test results.

  • Collaborate closely with propulsion, mechanical, structures, and systems engineering teams to optimize thermal integration within the aircraft.

  • Support simulation activities and correlate analytical models with physical test results where appropriate.

  • Prepare technical documentation, verification reports, and engineering recommendations.


What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Aeronautical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 5+ years of experience developing and integrating thermal management or cooling systems in aerospace, automotive, motorsport, industrial machinery, or similar industries.

  • Hands-on experience designing and integrating air-cooled systems, aerodynamic cooling solutions, or airflow management for engines, electronics, or other high-power systems.

  • Strong understanding of heat transfer, fluid dynamics, cooling system design, airflow management, and thermal testing.

  • Experience with cooling components such as heat exchangers, fans, ducting, air intakes, ventilation systems, and thermal insulation.

  • Experience designing and executing engineering validation and prototype test campaigns.

  • Familiarity with CAD tools (CATIA preferred); experience with CFD or thermal simulation tools is advantageous but not essential.

  • Experience with thermal instrumentation, sensors, and data acquisition systems.

  • Programming experience with Python, MATLAB, or similar data analysis tools is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

jobs.title: Mobile Lead
jobs.description:
Led et mobilteam som utfordrer tech-gigantene!


Jotta Group er en norsk teknologi-scaleup bak Jottacloud, Min Sky og white-label-skyløsninger for europeiske partnere som Telenor og Elkjøp. Siden 2008 har vi vokst til nesten to millioner direkte brukere og er i dag ett av få reelle europeiske alternativer i et marked dominert av globale teknologigiganter. Vi lagrer data i Norge under strenge norske og europeiske personvernregler, på vår egen infrastruktur i Stavanger, drevet av 100 % fornybar energi.

Med dagens geopolitiske realiteter er tryggheten vi lover mer relevant enn noensinne og mobilopplevelsen er avgjørende for at vi holder posisjonen og tar nye markedsandeler. Vi søker nå en Mobile Lead til å eie og videreutvikle den.

Hva du vil gjøre

Som Mobile Lead leder du ett samlet mobilteam med dedikerte iOS- og Android-utviklere, og rapporterer direkte til CTO. Du vil blant annet:

  • Eie teknisk retning og arkitektur for mobilplattformene, i tett samarbeid med seniorene på begge team

  • Ha ansvar for leveransekapasiteten – hva som bygges, og at det faktisk leveres

  • Drive videreutvikling av kjernefunksjoner som bilder, deling og filhåndtering

  • Sikre kvalitet i release-prosessen på begge plattformer

  • Bygge et team med sterk kultur og tydelig eierskap

  • Representere mobilperspektivet i strategiske diskusjoner og jobbe tett med produkt og design

  • Bidra til å forme hvordan vi jobber som produktselskap – vi er på god vei, men du får reell mulighet til å sette avtrykk

  • Bruke AI aktivt i eget arbeid og bidra til at teamet utnytter mulighetene, både i produktene og i arbeidsprosessene



Er dette deg?Ledererfaring

  • Du har reell ledererfaring med personalansvar og vet hva det innebærer å bygge kultur, følge opp folk og skape effektive team

  • Du er vant til å eie produkter fra problem til leveranse og motiveres av at millioner av mennesker faktisk bruker det vi bygger

  • Du tar eierskap og har selvtillit, men lite ego og lar andre skinne

Teknisk bakgrunn

  • Du har bakgrunn som mobilutvikler og kjenner plattformene godt nok til å forstå avveiningene teamet står i, stille de riktige spørsmålene og ta gode beslutninger

  • Appene våre er native – Swift på iOS og Kotlin på Android – og du er komfortabel nok i begge verdener til å lede på tvers

  • Du trenger ikke være den dypeste eksperten på hver plattform; vi har sterke seniorer på begge team som eier mye av den tekniske retningen, og du vet når du skal lene deg på dem

  • Du er trygg på moderne utviklingspraksis som CI/CD, testautomatisering og observability

Måten du jobber på

  • Du er AI-native/positiv og bruker det aktivt i hverdagen – og er genuint nysgjerrig på hvordan teamet kan få mer ut av det, både i det vi bygger og i hvordan vi jobber

  • Norsk er arbeidsspråket vårt, men du kommuniserer godt på engelsk

Ekstra pluss

  • Erfaring med mobilprodukter i stor skala

  • Kjennskap til sky, lagring eller infrastrukturdomenet

  • Bakgrunn med bilder, backup eller forbrukerrettede produkter



Hvorfor Jotta?

  • Fullt eierskap til mobilområdet i et selskap med nesten to millioner brukere og en lagringsplattform i rask vekst

  • Kort vei fra idé til lansert programvare, med direkte linje til CTO og resten av lederteamet

  • Et stabilt og lønnsomt selskap som har bygget stein for stein mot ett tydelig mål: å bli det europeiske alternativet

  • Hybrid arbeidshverdag fra sentrale kontorer i Oslo eller Trondheim

  • 7 + 3 % pensjon og 7 ekstra feriedager i tillegg til lovpålagt ferie



Vil du lede mobilopplevelsen til det europeiske alternativet?
Ta kontakt med Marte for en uforpliktende prat

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Jottacloud is a Norwegian cloud storage service for both private use and businesses. The service lets you securely copy, synchronize, save and share files from all of your devices. These files will be safely stored on environmentally friendly servers in Norway or in countries with equivalent or even more rigorous privacy laws. Firms based in the US might be forced to hand over their stored information to the authorities. No one will get access to the data stored with us. Jotta is the name of the company behind the service. Founded in 2008, today we are located in central Oslo and consist of twelve employees. The name “Jotta” is based on the “Yottabyte” which is one trillion Terabytes. The “cloud” is the term used to denote storing and sharing files on the internet.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Verden trenger mer og bedre mat — produsert med færre ressurser. Med en voksende verdensbefolkning, press på areal og vann, og stadig høyere krav til bærekraft, er behovet for smartere landbruk større enn noen gang. Det er nettopp dette vi i MIMIRO tar stolthet i å bidra med å løse.

Et teknologiselskap med dype røtter i norsk landbruk og en rik arv av data fra næringen. Vi samler og kobler data fra hele landbruksnæringen — fra jordet til fjøset — og omsetter dem til digitale verktøy, beslutningsstøtte og dokumentasjon som gjør hverdagen enklere og produksjonen bedre for bonden og aktørene i næringen.

Norsk landbruk fortjener teknologi på høyde med de beste industriene i verden — og det strekker vi oss for bygge gjennom et kompetent og tverrfaglig miljø på 30 ansatte som dekker hele spekteret — fra frontend, backend og DevOps til AI, data science og product management. Det er denne kompetansen som gjør at løsningene våre når 98% av norske melkebønder.

Vi er et nasjonalt selskap i vekst med ambisjoner om å gå internasjonalt. Med støtte fra solide eiere som TINE, Felleskjøpet, Gjensidige and NLR har vi et sterkt fundament i ryggen — og en klar retning fremover. Det er denne reisen du blir en del av.

Om rollen:

Som Customer Success Manager i MIMIRO tar du ansvar for hele kunderelasjonen på tvers av to segmenter: 7 000 norske bønder som bruker Eana i hverdagen, og industripartnere som kjøper strukturerte landbruksdata. Det som binder dem sammen er at behovene i begge segmenter koker ned til det samme — tilgang til riktige data og variabler, levert på riktig måte.

Du er MIMIROs ansikt utad mot begge kundesegmenter og har det overordnede ansvaret for at kundene lykkes — fra første onboarding til langsiktig verdi og vekst. Du jobber tett med produkt, teknologi og leveranse internt, og er bindeleddet som sørger for at kundeinnsikt faktisk brukes til å forbedre produktet og tjenestene.

Dette er ikke en formell lederrolle, men du er erfaren nok til å sette retning og heve kvaliteten på prosessene rundt deg. Du rapporterer til CCO og vil ha reell påvirkning fra start.

Hva du vil jobbe med:

Kommersielt eierskap og vekst

• Eie retention og renewal — holde churn lavt og sikre at kontrakter fornyes og utvides

• Drive upsell og cross-sell der det gir kundeverdi, med NRR som personlig styringsmål

• Identifisere og følge opp ekspansjonsmuligheter i partnersegmentet

• Rapportere på kommersielle KPIer og bidra aktivt i kommersielle diskusjoner med ledelsen

Kundehelse og risikoreduksjon

• Bygge og drifte health scoring — fange opp kunder i faresonen før de churner

• Etablere early warning systems basert på bruksmønstre og engasjementsdata

• Lede eskalering og recovery-prosesser når kunderelasjoner er under press

• Sikre proaktiv oppfølging fremfor reaktiv brannslukking

Onboarding og produktadopsjon

• Eie onboarding-prosessen for nye kunder i begge segmenter — strukturert og skalerbar

• Følge opp feature-adopsjon og sikre at kunder bruker Eana og dataleveranser til sin fulle verdi

• Lage målrettede tiltak for inaktive kunder eller segmenter som underutnytter plattformen

• Definere hva suksess ser ut som for ulike kundetyper, og måle mot det

Data, CRM og kundeprosesser

• Eie og drive CRM-systemet — god datakvalitet, segmentering og strukturert oppfølging

• Bygge digitale kundereiser og automatiserte flyter der det gir skala

• Sikre at kundeinnsikt samles systematisk og kanaliseres til produkt- og leveranseteamet

• Utvikle selvbetjeningsressurser, dokumentasjon og supportprosesser

Kommunikasjon og kundeinnsikt

• Bidra til ekstern kommunikasjon mot kunder og partnere — tydelig og tillitvekkende

• Samle brukerhistorier og innsikt som støtter markedsaktiviteter og produktstrategi

• Gjennomføre NPS- og CSAT-oppfølging med konkrete forbedringstiltak som resultat

Hva vi ser etter:

• 3–7 års erfaring fra customer success, account management, eller CX i en digital virksomhet

• Har hatt kommersielt eierskap tidligere — renewals, upsell eller NRR er kjente begreper

• Erfaring med CRM-systemer og bygging av strukturerte kundeprosesser

• Kjenner til hva gode digitale kundereiser ser ut som, og har forbedret dem i praksis

• Bruker AI aktivt som en naturlig del av arbeidshverdagen

• Erfaring med datadrevne produkter eller B2B SaaS er en klar fordel

• Bakgrunn innen kommunikasjon eller markedsføring er et pluss

• Nysgjerrighet på landbruk og agri-tech er viktig for oss — du er motivert for å forstå verdikjeden og utfordringene vi løser. Har du bakgrunn fra landbruk, matproduksjon eller tilgrensende industri er det et klart pluss, særlig for å forstå partnerne våre og avhengighetene i bransjen.

Hvem er du:

• Fremoverlent og initiativrik — du venter ikke på at ting skal skje, du setter dem i gang

• Genuint opptatt av at kundene dine lykkes, og tålmodig nok til å jobbe langsiktig med det

• Analytisk og nysgjerrig — du er komfortabel med å grave i data for å forstå hva kundene egentlig trenger

• Tydelig og tillitvekkende i kommunikasjonen, skriftlig og muntlig, overfor bønder og direktører

• Strukturert nok til å bygge prosesser, fleksibel nok til at de faktisk brukes i et ungt selskap

• Trives med å coache og løfte andre, uten å ha behov for formell tittel for å gjøre det

• Kommuniserer på både norsk og engelsk.

Hva forventer vi det første året?

Vi ønsker ikke å love bort en fullt definert rolle — nettopp fordi du skal være med å forme den. Men her er hva vi ser for oss:

Måned 1–3

Lær produktet, kundene og teamet å kjenne. Kartlegg eksisterende prosesser og identifiser de viktigste hullene.

Måned 4–6

Ta fullt eierskap til kunderelasjoner. Innfør eller forbedre health scoring og CRM-struktur.

Måned 6+

Ha en tydelig mening om hva som fungerer og hva som ikke gjør det — og ha begynt å fikse sistnevnte.

År 1

Synlig forbedring i NPS/CSAT, lav churn, og et partnersegment som opplever tydelig profesjonalisering. En klar plan om hvordan rollen driver NRR.

Hva vi tilbyr

• En rolle med reell samfunnsnytte — du bidrar til at norsk landbruk digitaliseres på riktig måte

• Et engasjert og profesjonelt fagmiljø med kolleger fra ulike bakgrunner

• Stor frihet til å forme rollen, prosessene og kundereisene

• Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling

• Tett samarbeid med produkt, teknologi og ledelse

• Et hyggelig og jordnært team

• Konkurransedyktige betingelser tilpasset erfaring og kompetanse

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer: Build technology that allows more time for care
jobs.description:
Technology is changing what good care can look like.

Used well, technology can help care professionals identify risks earlier, respond faster and provide care that is better adapted to each individual. It can improve collaboration between colleagues, create greater continuity in everyday work and give care teams more time to focus on the people who need them.

Sensio is a leading European care technology company. Through our software platform Sensio 365, our nurse call solution, and our ‘hero-product’ the RoomMate AI multisensor, we help care providers deliver safer, more personalized and more efficient care. RoomMate is developed and manufactured in Norway, and it is probably the most widely deployed sensor of its kind across elderly care anywhere in the world.

With the backing of Nordic Capital, a leading European healthcare and healthtech investor, we are investing actively in product development and expanding the impact of our technology across international markets.

We’re looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer

This role is dedicated to the continued development of RoomMate.

Developed and manufactured in Norway, RoomMate is a privacy-first safety sensor designed for digital supervision in care environments. By combining advanced sensing, image processing and algorithms, RoomMate helps care teams identify falls and other potentially dangerous situations.

As an embedded software engineer, you will work on the embedded software that makes RoomMate reliable in real-world care environments. You will work closely with hardware, product and engineering colleagues to improve the product’s performance, precision and robustness, and to develop new functionality as RoomMate continues to evolve.

This is a role for someone who wants to understand the product, the people who use it, the technical constraints and the real-world consequences of the decisions being made, not just receive a ticket, write the code and move on.

You will join a strong product and engineering environment where hardware and software are developed in-house. Your work can directly contribute to safer care, a better working day for care professionals and the continued development of care technology across Europe.

The role can be based at Sensio’s offices in Sandvika or Oslo, with occasional travel between the two locations. You will report to the RoomMate Dev Lead.

Your day-to-day

You will be part of the team developing and improving the embedded software behind RoomMate. Your daily work will include:

  • Developing and maintaining embedded software in C++ on Linux

  • Working closely with colleagues across hardware, product, design and engineering to shape the next generation of RoomMate

  • Taking ownership of complex technical challenges, from problem definition to working solutions

  • Contributing to product discovery and technical decision-making

  • Improving the quality, reliability, performance and maintainability of a product used in real care environments

  • Supporting a strong engineering culture through knowledge-sharing, technical discussions and mentoring

This is what we’re looking for

We are looking for an experienced embedded software engineer who combines strong technical depth with product understanding and ownership. If you’re the right candidate for the job, you probably are:

  • Very experienced with C++ and embedded software development in Linux environments, preferably using Yocto

  • Experienced within Hardware in the Loop testing

  • Someone with good judgement when balancing technical quality, product needs and practical constraints

  • A team player - you thrive in a team environment, sharing knowledge and growing together.

  • A product-oriented thinker - you think beyond code and understand how technology impacts the end user

  • Fluent in English

Bonus points if you have experience with one of the following

  • Communication technologies such as TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, mobile networks or Bluetooth

  • Hardware development or close collaboration with hardware teams

  • CI/CD pipelines and testing in embedded environments

  • Signal processing, machine learning or AI-related functionality

  • Products where reliability, privacy, safety or regulatory considerations matter

At Sensio, the way you work is just as important as your technical background. It is important that you are someone who takes initiative, ask good questions, share knowledge and care about the product beyond the codebase.

What Sensio can offer

At Sensio, you will work on technology with a strong purpose and a genuine user need. RoomMate is developed for real care environments, where reliability, precision and thoughtful engineering directly affect both the people receiving care and the professionals supporting them.

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will contribute to a product that can help prevent dangerous situations, support more personalized care and give care teams better insight in their daily work. This is where strong engineering becomes more than technical quality: it contributes to safety, dignity and more time for care.

What we can offer:

  • A central role in the continued development of RoomMate, Sensio’s hero product

  • The opportunity to build technology that supports care professionals, residents and their next of kin

  • A Norwegian product and technology environment with an established European presence

  • A strong, cross-functional team working across hardware, software, product and design

  • The opportunity to take ownership, influence technical direction and grow professionally

This is a role for someone who wants the technical complexity of embedded software, the ownership that comes with product development and the opportunity to build technology that matters. If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. Our technology is already installed in thousands of care homes and hospitals, helping staff prevent falls, save lives, and free up time for what really matters: people. We build everything from advanced safety sensors and cloud platforms to apps and data tools – all developed in-house by our 80+ product and tech specialists. What makes Sensio unique? - Impact with scale – our solutions improve everyday life for tens of thousands of residents and caregivers, and we’re just getting started. - A true growth journey – from Nordic frontrunner to European scale-up, we’re building the leading caretech platform of tomorrow. - Innovation at heart – our R&D teams shape the future of care technology with cutting-edge hardware, AI, and software. - People-first culture – we believe the best products come from teams that feel at home, have freedom to experiment, and share knowledge across borders. If you want to be part of a meaningful growth story – where tech meets one of society’s biggest challenges – join us. Let’s create more time for care.

jobs.title: Cafémedarbeider i Oslo
jobs.description:
GRØD er åpnet i Oslo og søker cafemedarbeidere

GRØD er et restaurant- og kafékonsept fra København som åpnet i Oslo i september 2024. Etter en helt fantastisk start søker vi nå flere ansatte til å hjelpe oss med å servere verdens beste grøt i Oslos fineste grøtbar i Markveien 67.

Siden vi åpnet vår første grøtbar i 2011 i København har vårt mål alltid vært å lage den perfekte grøt, og gi våre kunder en fantastisk opplevelse. Kvalitet, sunnhet og “fet energi” er alfa omega. Og nu skal vi få oslo til at elske grøt, ved at servere verdens beste havregrøt, congee, daal, risotto, juice, kaffe og smoothie bowls i vår nye freshe restaurant på Grünerløkka.

Vi søker ansatte i varierende  stillingsprosenter fra 0 - 100%. 

Det viktigste er for oss er, at du kjenner deg igjen i følgende beskrivelse:

  • Du har lyst til å lære – du er åpen for nye opplevelser og har lyst til å utvide dine ferdigheter

  • Teamplayer - du er klar med en hjelpende hånd til dine fantastiske kollegaer når det trengs

  • Matglede – du trives i et kjøkken, herunder matlaging anretning og oppvask

  • Servicemindet - du forstår hva som skal til for at gjestene går ut fra GRØD med et smil.

  • Positiv og imøtekommende - du forstår viktigheten av et godt smil og har en fet energi

  • Ansvarsbevisst og engasjert - du er glad i å jobbe, og dine kollegaer kan regne med deg

Vi tilbyr

  • En morsom arbeidsplass med muligheter for å utvikle seg og få nye vennskap

  • Et mangfoldig, ambisiøst og energisk team

  • En velfungerende organisasjon og ordnede forhold

  • Muligheten til å være med å jobbe i et helt nytt konsept hvor det vil kunne være mulighet for en karriere, om man ønsker.

Om dette er noe du vil være med på, håper vi å se din søknad. Samtaler holdes fortløpende.

Vi gleder oss til å få deg med på laget!

GRØD

GRØD verdsetter mangfoldighet og inkludering. Vi oppmuntrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke stillingen uavhengig av kjønn, alder, etnisk bakgrunn, religion, funksjonshemming eller seksuell orientering. Vi mener at ulike perspektiver styrker teamet vårt.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

GRØD is a café and restaurant concept that opened in Nørrebro, Copenhagen in 2011, with a nerdy focus on everything related to "grød", including porridge, smoothie bowls, daal, congee, risotto and bowls. Most countries have a unique "porridge"-culture that explores different ingredients, grains and spices. And when it's made right, it tastes absolutely fantastic – and it’s naturally healthy and sustainable. We also highly value community among our colleagues and our guests, and love working with people who understand that their energy has a big impact on their surroundings. GRØD has restaurants in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Oslo, as well as a series of retail products available in the most major supermarket brands.

jobs.title: Data Engineer: Build the data foundation for the future of care
jobs.description:
Technology is changing what good care can look like.

Used well, technology can help care professionals identify risks earlier, respond faster and provide care that is better adapted to each individual. It can improve collaboration between colleagues, create greater continuity in everyday work and give care teams more time to focus on the people who need them.

Sensio is a leading European care technology company. Through our software platform Sensio 365, our nurse call solution, and our ‘hero-product’ the RoomMate AI multisensor, we help care providers deliver safer, more personalized and more efficient care. RoomMate is developed and manufactured in Norway, and it is probably the most widely deployed sensor of its kind across elderly care anywhere in the world.

With the backing of Nordic Capital, a leading European healthcare and healthtech investor, we are investing actively in product development and expanding the impact of our technology across international markets.

We’re looking for a data engineer

This role sits in our data platform team and will work across our product, engineering and AI teams. Your responsibility will be to turn data from sensors, applications, and external systems into structured, reliable datasets that can be used across Sensio’s products.

In Sensio 365, we have a large and growing range of real-time signals. For example, our RoomMate sensor can register activity patterns, movement, presence, and noise in a resident’s room. Additionally, other Sensio devices, third party devices, and system integrations all contribute alarm and event data.

When all this data is processed, structured and combined over time, they can provide much more value for our customers than they do as individual datapoints. This is what enables products such as Sensio Insight to identify patterns, present meaningful information and help care providers better understand resident activity and what enable continuous improvement of the functionality and accuracy of our AI-sensor Roommate.

As a data engineer, you will build the processors, datasets and platform services that make this possible. You may receive data through an API, a Kafka message or an existing dataset, and your job will be to determine how it should be interpreted, transformed and stored so that it becomes reliable and useful downstream.

At Sensio, you shouldn’t expect to always receive your tasks as fully defined technical specifications. You will work in collaboration with product managers, machine learning engineers and other developers to understand the problem, define the right data structure and decide which processing is required.

This is a role for someone who is more interested in understanding the problem than reaching for a predetermined solution. You will help build a platform that supports an increasing number of sensors, data formats and use cases as our ecosystem continues to grow.

We are looking for someone who understands that good data engineering is what allows teams to build better models, better products and better decisions.

This role will be placed at Sensio’s office in Oslo. You will report to the Dev Lead for Data Platform.

Your day-to-day

You will contribute to the continued development of Sensio’s data platform and the data services that support products such as RoomMate, Sensio Insight and Sensio 365 more broadly. Your daily work will include:

  • Building data pipelines, processors and services in Python, C# and .NET

  • Receiving data from APIs, Kafka and existing datasets

  • Turning sensor, alarm and activity data into reliable, structured datasets

  • Working with PostgreSQL and large data volumes

  • Collaborating closely with product managers, ML engineers and developers to define the right solutions

  • Improving platform reliability, scalability and secure data handling

This is what we’re looking for

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer with strong technical judgement, high standards for data reliability and an understanding of how data supports modern product and ML development. If you’re the right candidate for the job, you probably have:

  • Strong experience with data engineering, backend development or data-heavy platform services

  • Strong C# and .NET skills

  • Experience with PostgreSQL and working with large data volumes

  • Strong understanding of data modelling, data structures and dataset design

  • Experience with data integrations, APIs, Kafka or other event-driven architectures

  • Familiarity with common data and machine learning tools such as Spark, MLflow and PyTorch

Your job is to make sure the data is reliable, structured, accessible, traceable and handled responsibly, so that the teams building models and products can move faster and make better decisions.

Bonus points if you have experience with one or more of the following:

  • FastAPI, dbt, Alembic or similar tools for building and maintaining data services

  • Multi-modal data, sensor data, image data, telemetry or data from edge devices

  • Kubernetes or cloud-based platform environments

  • Sensor data, IoT or real-time systems

  • Products where reliability, privacy, safety or regulatory considerations matter

What Sensio can offer

At Sensio, you will work on technology with a clear purpose and a genuine user need. RoomMate is developed for real care environments, where reliability, precision and thoughtful engineering directly affect both the people receiving care and the professionals supporting them.

As a Data Engineer at Sensio, your work will help create the foundation for smarter and more reliable care technology. Better data infrastructure can mean better models, better product decisions, better testing and more confidence in the technology used by care teams every day.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Production Suite
jobs.description:
About Six Robotics

At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our 70+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users.

We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. Getting in is hard, and you’ll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits and always be sharpening your blade, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field.

About The Role

We are setting up a new team to build our Production Suite: the software product that gets our autonomy platform onto new drone hardware. This is not about assembling the physical drone. It is about everything that has to happen in software once the hardware is built, so a finished drone leaves production running on our stack.

As we move toward supporting production volumes in the thousands, installing our software on a new platform needs to become a high quality workflow someone runs at the production site, not something that pulls on engineering capacity per unit. Production Suite is how we get there.

It ships alongside each new release of our autonomy stack and wraps installation, configuration, acceptance testing, and sign-off into a guided flow.

The work is less about deep architecture and more about getting a lot of moving parts to work together cleanly: software packaging, deployment to edge devices, test automation, Linux plumbing, and an operator experience reliable enough that a non-engineer at a production site can run it on their own.

We are looking for several engineers to join this team early. As one of the first in, you will help shape what we build and how we build it. You will have a broad responsibility from low-level flashing and test orchestration up to the interface the production operator actually interacts with.

What You Will Do

  • Build the Production Suite: a software package that ships to a production site and takes a drone from factory-fresh hardware to a unit running our autonomy stack and passing acceptance

  • Design and implement the tooling that flashes our software onto new drone platforms, configures it, runs factory acceptance tests, and reports results back to Operations

  • Work across the stack as needed: Linux command line, Python scripting, Docker and Kubernetes, SSH and remote execution, web APIs, data formats, basic hooks and integrations

  • Reuse and adapt parts of our existing end-to-end test suite so factory acceptance tests share a foundation with how we test in engineering

  • Make the whole thing usable for production operators: clear enough that the workflow is mostly pressing next, red or green, with no hidden steps

  • Work closely with Operations, Test Automation, Hardware Enablement, and the teams building the autonomy stack itself to keep integration reliable end to end

Why This Role Matters

Production Suite is one of the pieces of work where getting it wrong directly caps how much of our core product reaches the field. If we cannot scale production, we cannot scale the company. This team sits on the critical path for delivering volume, and the people we hire into this role will have an outsized effect on whether we hit it.

What we are looking for

We are open to varieties of seniority in this team. Generally, we are looking for a broad, practical senior engineer. Someone who has built this kind of system before, or something close to it, and knows what good looks like when hardware, software, and a factory floor have to work together.

You are not scared of the mix. You move between Python, a Dockerfile, a Kubernetes manifest, an SSH session, and a JSON-to-YAML conversion without losing the thread.

You are pragmatic. You care more about shipping something that works than about the purest architecture.

We believe the right candidate brings

  • Several years of experience as a software engineer, ideally at companies that ship physical products (hardware, robotics, consumer electronics, networking, industrial devices)

  • Comfort on the Linux command line

  • Ability to move around a modern tooling landscape (containers, orchestration, CI/CD, remote execution, scripting) without needing deep expertise in any one of them. If you have not used Docker or Kubernetes heavily but can pick them up where needed, that works for us

  • Exposure to deploying software onto devices or edge hardware, not only to servers or the cloud

  • A tooling mindset: you notice manual work, you automate what you do twice, you think in pipelines and feedback loops

  • A strong drive to solve problems and find a way through, even when the path is not obvious and the spec is not clean. This matters more to us than any specific tool on your CV

  • Ability to own problems from end to end and work across team boundaries

  • Clear communication in English, written and spoken

It is an advantage if you have:

  • Worked on production, provisioning, or manufacturing tooling at a hardware company before

  • Experience with Python in an infrastructure or tooling context (this will be a large part of the day-to-day, but we do not require it up front)

  • Background in edge deployment, factory acceptance testing, or device lifecycle management

  • Exposure to operator-facing GUI or workflow tools

  • Exposure to safety-critical, defence, or regulated environments

  • We care more about range and judgement than about a specific stack. If you come from Go, Rust, or something else entirely but have built this kind of system well, we want to talk to you.

Why You Should Join

At Six Robotics, we're not just building software - we're redefining how unmanned systems operate in the real world. If you're driven by meaningful problems, technical depth, and the chance to shape something from the ground up, you'll find your place here.

  • Work on problems that matter

    Our technology helps unlock smarter, safer, and more adaptable UAV operations in defense and industry, solving real challenges with direct, tangible impact.

  • Lead the shift in a hardware-dominated space

    We're bringing modern AI, autonomy, and scalable software into a field that's long relied on rigid, pre-programmed systems, to change how UAVs are designed, deployed, and managed.

  • Build from zero, shape the future

    Join early and help define the core systems, tools, and culture of a company that’s still being built - where your ideas, code, and decisions will have a lasting influence.

  • Work with purpose, supported by great benefits
    You'll be part of a mission-driven team that values clarity, integrity, and collaboration, offering competitive pay, equity potential, strong insurance and pension plans, and ongoing learning opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process

  • Screening interview with one of our recruiters to get to know you better (30 min)

  • Meet & Greet with someone from the team to learn more about us (60 min)

  • Take-home case assignment, to be solved in your own time, followed by a live coding session and an in-depth interview on the case and the specifics of the role (90 min)

  • Final interview with our CTO and Head of People (45 min)

Reference check followed by an offer if everything goes well.
We consider applications continuously, so don't hold off with applying if this looks interesting.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
At Six Robotics, we are committed to creating a workplace built on respect, integrity, and collaboration. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we believe that diversity within our team strengthens both our work and our culture. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and help us build technology that makes a real impact.

Security Clearance Requirement

All employees at Six Robotics are required to undergo a security clearance due to our close collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces. While prior clearance is not necessary, the clearance process will be initiated as part of onboarding.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We exist to strengthen defence, protect nations, and deter conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. Our mission is to multiply operational capabilities, accelerate the transition to robotic warfare, and give NATO and our allies a decisive advantage in the new era of unmanned operations. We overcome the limits of current systems with collaborative swarm autonomy, enabling unmanned systems to act as one. Our software lets drones collaborate, adapt, and execute missions as a team, allowing a single operator to control an army of robots, accelerate decisions, and multiply combat effectiveness.

jobs.title: Dev Lead RoomMate: Lead the technology behind smarter, safer care

Sensio is a leading European care technology company. Through our software platform Sensio 365, our nurse call solution, and our ‘hero-product’ the RoomMate AI multisensor, we help care providers deliver safer, more personalized and more efficient care. RoomMate is developed and manufactured in Norway, and it is probably the most widely deployed sensor of its kind across elderly care anywhere in the world.

With the backing of Nordic Capital, a leading European healthcare and healthtech investor, we are investing actively in product development and expanding the impact of our technology across international markets.

We’re looking for a dev lead for RoomMate

This role will be leading the team and technical development of RoomMate. Today, it helps reduce falls and gives care teams better insight without relying on wearables or constant in-person monitoring.

As Dev Lead for RoomMate, you will take responsibility for the technical direction, quality and delivery of the product. You will lead a team of eight people whom you are responsible for managing day-to-day, and will collaborate closely with other Dev Leads, product, ML, hardware and engineering colleagues to make sure the team is moving in the right direction, at the right pace and with the right level of quality. As a dev lead for RoomMate you will be a part of our technical leadership group, consisting of other dev leads, product managers and our CPTO. On a day-to-day-basis, you will collaborate closely with our product manager, working together to make decisions regarding direction, development and priorities.

The right person combines deep technical understanding with the perspective to lead people, set priorities and affect longer-term strategic direction. You are comfortable stepping out of the code while staying close enough to make credible technical judgments. We are looking for someone who can understand complex embedded software and hardware-related challenges, and support strong specialists to make good decisions.

You should be able to lead discussions about embedded Linux, C++, sensors, hardware constraints, product quality and machine learning on the edge. You should also be able to translate those constraints into clear priorities, trade-offs and direction for people who do not necessarily speak “circuit board” fluently.

The role can be based at Sensio’s offices in Oslo city centre, or in Sandvika, and will involve close collaboration across teams.

Your day-to-day

You will lead the RoomMate development team and take responsibility for technical direction, quality, priorities and delivery. Your daily work will include:

  • Leading, supporting and developing a team of around eight engineers and specialist

  • Setting technical direction and helping the team make good architectural and product decisions

  • Driving quality, progress and delivery across embedded software, hardware-related development and product improvements

  • Working closely with other Dev Leads, product, design and engineering colleagues to deliver on Sensio’s value proposition

  • Sparring on complex technical challenges, including embedded Linux, C++, sensors, edge ML and hardware constraints

  • Contributing hands-on when needed, while spending most of your time on technical leadership, coordination, quality and team development

This is what we’re looking for

We are looking for a technically strong Dev Lead with deep embedded software experience from products in operation. If you’re the right candidate for the job, you probably have:

  • Strong experience with embedded software development, preferably from a product environment

  • Solid C++ and Linux or embedded Linux competence

  • Experience with software and hardware products in operation, where reliability, quality and maintainability matter

  • Experience with technical leadership, architecture or team responsibility in complex software/hardware environments

  • The ability to lead strong technical people, create direction, handle disagreement and ensure that decisions are followed up

You do not need to be the most hands-on developer in the team, but you need to be technically close enough to understand the complexity, challenge assumptions and support good technical decisions. The main value you bring is not writing the most code. It is creating direction, progress and quality for the team and the product.

Bonus points if you have experience with one or more of the following:

  • Embedded Linux build systems, preferably Yocto

  • IoT, sensors, computer vision, optics, time-of-flight technology or similar sensor-driven products

  • Machine learning on the edge, data aggregation or resource-constrained hardwar

  • Industries such as medtech, automotive, telecom, energy, industrial technology, robotics or similar

  • Roles such as Tech Lead, Dev Lead, Engineering Manager, Staff Engineer or Principal Engineer with leadership responsibility

  • Products where safety, privacy, reliability or regulatory considerations matter

What Sensio can offer

At Sensio, you will work on technology with a clear purpose and a genuine user need. RoomMate is developed for real care environments, where reliability, precision and thoughtful engineering directly affect both the people receiving care and the professionals supporting them.

As Dev Lead for RoomMate, you will have a central role in shaping one of Sensio’s most important products. You will work at the intersection of embedded software, sensors, hardware, machine learning and product development, in a role where technical decisions have real-world impact.

This is the kind of leadership role where good engineering becomes more than good engineering. It becomes safety, dignity and more time for care.

  • The opportunity to build technology that supports healthcare professionals, residents, patients and next-of-kin

  • A strong, cross-functional team working across hardware, software, product and design

Unfamiliar tech stacks don't slow you down. You treat the rest of engineering as your end users, and value nothing higher.

You drive complex technical work forward independently, from design through to production-quality, maintainable solutions, knowing when to involve stakeholders and when to pull in domain experts.

You bring

  • Strong software engineering defaults and a developer-experience mindset, naturally drawn to ideas like pit of success and least astonishment.

Why You Should Join

At Six Robotics, we're not just building software - we're redefining how unmanned systems operate in the real world. If you're driven by meaningful problems, technical depth, and the chance to shape something from the ground up, you'll find your place here.

jobs.title: Are you an engineer with a passion for coffee?
jobs.description:
Are you an engineer with a passion for coffee? Help us design and build the future of roasting technology.

ROEST is revolutionizing the coffee industry with advanced roasting technology designed and built in Norway. Our team of passionate coffee experts, engineers, and designers work together to create innovative solutions that empower roasters worldwide. jobs.title: ML Engineer – Computer Vision: Build smarter, safer care technology
jobs.description:
Technology is changing what good care can look like.

Used well, technology can help care professionals identify risks earlier, respond faster and provide care that is better adapted to each individual. It can improve collaboration between colleagues, create greater continuity in everyday work and give care teams more time to focus on the people who need them.

Sensio is a leading European care technology company. Through our software platform Sensio 365, our nurse call solution, and our ‘hero-product’ the RoomMate AI multisensor, we help care providers deliver safer, more personalized and more efficient care. RoomMate is developed and manufactured in Norway, and it is probably the most widely deployed sensor of its kind across elderly care anywhere in the world.

With the backing of Nordic Capital, a leading European healthcare and healthtech investor, we are investing actively in product development and expanding the impact of our technology across international markets.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer

This role sits at the core of Sensio’s sensor-driven care technology, and is placed within our new AI team. You will work with machine learning models that run on embedded devices, close to the hardware, in products that need to perform reliably in real care environments.

Sensio’s technology uses advanced sensors, algorithms and embedded systems to support digital supervision and detect potentially dangerous situations.

Sensio’s technology generates a growing range of real-time signals, such as falls, noise and activity in a resident’s room. Other products and integrations contribute alarm data, events data and data from care environments both inside and outside of Sensio’s own ecosystem.

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will work mainly on training and evaluating Computer vision models. The models will make the best possible use of the hardware available, balancing performance, precision, robustness, memory, power consumption and deployment constraints.

We are looking for someone who understands the full journey from data and training to validation, deployment, hardware performance and continuous improvement.

You will join a strong product and engineering environment where hardware, software, data and machine learning work closely together. Your work can directly affect the safety of residents, the working day of healthcare professionals and the future of care technology.

Your day-to-day

You will be an instrumental part of the team developing, improving and deploying machine learning models for Sensio’s sensor-driven care technology. Your daily work will include:

  • Training, validating and improving computer vision models

  • Optimizing models for embedded devices and resource-constrained hardware, including performance, memory use and power consumption

  • Working with sensor data, including depth, time-of-flight or similar data sources, to improve model precision and robustness

  • Exporting, testing and preparing models for deployment

  • Building systems for continuous improvement, experiment tracking, model evaluation and feedback loops

  • Collaborating closely with embedded, software, product and data science colleagues to ensure that models work reliably in real-world care environments

This is what we’re looking for

We are looking for a machine learning engineer with strong experience in computer vision and model development for embedded or resource-constrained environments. This is a senior role that requires strong technical depth and the ability to work independently with complex machine learning problems, whether that expertise comes from industry, research or a combination of both. If you’re the right candidate for the job, you probably have:

  • A master’s degree or PhD in machine learning, computer science, robotics, signal processing or a related field

  • Solid experience with computer vision

  • Experience developing, training, validating and optimizing ML models for embedded devices or resource-constrained hardware

  • Strong Python skills and experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch

  • Experience working close to hardware, preferrably with sensors, depth cameras, time-of-flight data, robotics, drones, automotive systems or similar

  • Understanding of inference on edge hardware

This job does not require that your background is within care or healthcare technology, but you do need to understand what it means to build models that have to work reliably outside of a controlled lab environment.

Bonus points if you have experience with one or more of the following:

  • Time-of-flight cameras, depth sensors, spectrum data or sensor fusion

  • Embedded Linux, C++ or working closely with firmware or embedded software teams

  • Model profiling, memory optimization or low-power ML deployment

  • Hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated validation or continuous model evaluation

  • MLOps, experiment tracking, dataset versioning or model lifecycle tools such as MLflow

  • Safety-critical, privacy-sensitive or regulated products where reliability matters

At Sensio, the way you work is just as important as your technical background. We are looking for someone who is independent, curious and quality-conscious. Someone who can go deep technically but also collaborates well with people across disciplines. Someone who asks good questions, takes ownership and wants to build systems that improve over time.

What Sensio can offer

At Sensio, you get to work on technology with a clear purpose and a very real user need. RoomMate is not built for a slide deck, a demo room or a theoretical future. It is built for real care environments, with real people, alarms, staff shortages and real-life consequences for those who receive care, and those who provide it.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Sensio, your work will help make sensor-driven care technology more precise, reliable and useful. Better models can mean better detection, fewer unnecessary interruptions, faster response and more confidence for the care teams using the technology every day.

This is the kind of machine learning where good engineering becomes more than good engineering. It becomes safety, dignity and more time for care.

What we can offer:

  • A central role in building and shaping Sensio’s AI capabilities, which will have a real-life effect on the future of care technology

  • The opportunity to build technology that supports healthcare professionals, residents, patients and next-of-kin

  • A Norwegian product and technology environment with international ambitions

  • A strong, cross-functional team working across hardware, software, product and design

  • Room to take ownership, influence technical direction and grow professionally

This is a role for someone who wants the complexity of machine learning, the constraints of embedded technology and the meaning of working on products that matter in everyday life.

If you want to build models that leave the lab and help shape the future of care technology, we would like to hear from you.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. Our technology is already installed in thousands of care homes and hospitals, helping staff prevent falls, save lives, and free up time for what really matters: people. We build everything from advanced safety sensors and cloud platforms to apps and data tools – all developed in-house by our 80+ product and tech specialists. What makes Sensio unique? - Impact with scale – our solutions improve everyday life for tens of thousands of residents and caregivers, and we’re just getting started. - A true growth journey – from Nordic frontrunner to European scale-up, we’re building the leading caretech platform of tomorrow. - Innovation at heart – our R&D teams shape the future of care technology with cutting-edge hardware, AI, and software. - People-first culture – we believe the best products come from teams that feel at home, have freedom to experiment, and share knowledge across borders. If you want to be part of a meaningful growth story – where tech meets one of society’s biggest challenges – join us. Let’s create more time for care.

You will lead the AI transformation across the full pipeline: from data collection and processing, to model development, MLOps, performance tracking and delivery to the teams implementing AI on embedded hardware.

The AI team will operate in an embedded model, with your AI-specialists assigned to the relevant product teams based on the AI roadmap and current priorities. As AI Lead, you will set the shared technical direction and work closely with the different Dev Leads to align AI development with each product’s architecture, roadmap and delivery.

That is where your job comes in.

As an AI lead you will scale Sensios work on AI across edge and server. A key part of the work is embedded AI on the RoomMate device: making models work locally, on sensors and devices with real hardware constraints. It is a unique challenge to make AI work reliably on a device on the wall, with limited memory, different hardware capabilities, privacy requirements and real-time use cases.

This is a role with Technical responsibility for the development, deployment, and continuous improvement of Sensio’s AI and machine learning solutions, both on embedded hardware and in server-based services.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role with formal people responsibility. Your role will be to scale our foundation, set direction, build capability and make sure Sensio’s AI work becomes scalable, responsible and useful in real care environments – and deeply integrated across our total offering.

While customer-facing AI products will remain the clear priority, you will also work with Internal IT, infrastructure and HR leadership to accelerate the adoption of AI across Sensio. This includes helping redesign processes, tools and ways of working to enable a broader transformation of the company’s operating model.

Your day-to-day

You will lead Sensio’s AI transformation and take responsibility for direction, quality and progress across AI initiatives. You’ll report directly to Sensio’s CPTO, and collaborate closely with Dev Leads and enterprise IT. Your daily work will include:

  • Leading and developing a team working across ML, AI transition and software/hardware implementation

  • Setting technical direction for AI across data, model development, MLOps, validation, deployment and performance tracking

  • Driving embedded AI initiatives, including models that need to run locally on resource-constrained sensors and devices

  • Working closely with data, annotation, ML, embedded, product and engineering teams to build reliable AI workflows from data to hardware

  • Improving robustness, explainability, privacy and scalability across Sensio’s AI systems

  • Helping establish internal principles, standards and ways of working for responsible and effective use of AI

This is what we’re looking for

We are looking for a technically strong AI Lead with deep machine learning competence, strong academic grounding and the ability to lead both people and transformation. If you’re the right candidate for the job, you probably have:

  • Strong experience with machine learning, computer vision or embedded AI, preferably from products that operate in real-world environments

  • Advanced academic training in machine learning, computer science, robotics, signal processing, applied mathematics or a related discipline, normally at master’s or PhD level, or equivalent depth demonstrated through relevant industrial research and development

  • Experience across several parts of the ML lifecycle, such as data preparation, model development, validation, deployment, MLOps and performance monitoring

  • Understanding of edge AI, hardware constraints, model optimization, quantization or deployment to resource-constrained devices

  • The ability to lead strong technical people, create direction, handle complexity and build confidence in a fast-moving environment

You do not need to have done everything Sensio is trying to build. Very few people have. But you do need to understand the full technical landscape well enough to make good decisions, ask the right questions and lead specialists across the pipeline.

Bonus points if you have experience with one or more of the following:

  • Time-of-flight sensors, IR sensors, depth data, computer vision, sensor fusion or signal-based AI

  • Embedded Linux, C++, Pytorch or similar frameworks and tools

  • Fleet-wide deployment, model monitoring, continuous model evaluation or industrial scalability of AI systems

  • Privacy-preserving AI, anonymization, GDPR, access control, security or explainability

  • AI in medtech, welfare technology, automotive, robotics, drones, industrial technology or other safety-critical environments

What Sensio can offer

At Sensio, you will work on technology with a clear purpose and a genuine user need. Our solutions are developed for real care environments, where reliability, precision and thoughtful engineering directly affect both the people receiving care and the professionals supporting them.

As AI Lead at Sensio, you will get a rare opportunity to work broadly across modern AI in a rich and complex product environment. Few environments can offer the same combination of real-time data, meaningful use cases, hardware constraints and societal importance.

jobs.title: Power System Delivery Engineer - Kognitwin Grid
jobs.description:
About Falkor

We build industrial intelligence software for heavy-asset sectors. As a KONGSBERG company backed by over 200 years of heritage, Falkor helps the energy, chemicals, utilities and other industrial sectors operate with absolute clarity, confidence, and control.

Our AI-enabled platform connects people, systems, and workflows—expanding human capability by turning complex data into real-time, actionable decisions.

We help leading organisations improve safety, efficiency and performance while redefining how heavy assets are designed and operated.

About the Position

We're looking for an experienced Power System Delivery Engineer to join our Power & Utilities team and play a key role in scaling Kognitwin Grid. Kognitwin Grid helps transmission and distribution utilities better understand, model and operate increasingly complex energy networks. As electrification accelerates and grid operators face new challenges, digital technologies are becoming critical to enabling smarter planning and operational decision-making.

This role sits at the intersection of power systems engineering, customer delivery and digital transformation. You will lead customer projects from proof-of-concept through operational deployment, working closely with utilities, engineers, data specialists and product teams to ensure our solutions deliver meaningful value for customers.

This is an opportunity to combine deep domain expertise with project leadership while helping shape the future of grid digitalisation.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead Customer Delivery

  • Lead delivery of Kognitwin Grid projects from project initiation through operational rollout.

  • Manage scope, schedules, risks, stakeholders and project governance activities.

  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across software engineering, data engineering and power systems experts.

  • Ensure successful execution of customer commitments and business outcomes.

Provide Power Systems Expertise

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for transmission and distribution utility customers.

  • Apply expertise in grid planning and operations including load flow analysis, contingency analysis, hosting capacity studies and network modelling.

  • Validate and assure quality of grid models built from customer source systems.

  • Support customers in applying digital technologies to operational and planning challenges.

Understand Customer Challenges

  • Work closely with engineering, planning and operational teams to understand customer use cases and business needs.

  • Facilitate workshops and requirements-gathering sessions.

  • Translate customer challenges into practical technical solutions.

  • Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders.

Collaborate Across Product and Engineering Teams

  • Work with product and engineering teams to ensure customer requirements are understood and effectively addressed.

  • Provide customer feedback and market insights that help improve the product.

  • Support identification and evaluation of new use cases and future opportunities.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of customer delivery approaches.

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have Experience

  • MSc or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems or a related discipline.

  • Experience working within power system planning, operations or grid engineering.

  • Experience working with utilities, TSOs, DSOs, consultancies or energy technology providers.

  • Knowledge of power system modelling and simulation tools such as PowerFactory, PSS®E, PandaPower, PSCAD or equivalent.

  • Experience leading technical projects involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Fluent English language skills.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • Experience supporting grid digitalisation, advanced analytics or operational technology initiatives.

  • Experience working with digital twin platforms, grid software solutions or ADMS/DERMS technologies.

  • Exposure to product organisations, requirements management or software delivery environments.

  • Familiarity with Azure, APIs or modern data integration approaches.

  • Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or equivalent).

  • Additional European language capability, including Norwegian.

Why Join Falkor?

You'll be joining a company helping to redefine how utilities and industrial organisations operate through industrial intelligence.

At Falkor, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Help accelerate the energy transition through digital innovation.

  • Work with some of the world's leading utilities and power system operators.

  • Solve complex technical challenges with real-world impact.

  • Collaborate with experts across engineering, software, product and industry domains.

  • Influence the future direction of a growing product offering.

  • Develop your expertise within a company that combines industrial heritage with advanced digital technology.

What We Offer

  • A key role within a high-growth business area.

  • Exposure to leading utilities and critical energy infrastructure.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

  • Flexible working arrangements.

  • Professional development and learning opportunities.

  • An inclusive and collaborative international environment.

  • The opportunity to help shape the future of grid digitalisation.

Ready to Apply?

If you're excited about combining power systems expertise, customer engagement and digital innovation to help modernise the electricity grid, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV and tell us about a project where you helped solve a complex grid planning, operational or digital transformation challenge.
