jobs.title: Assistant manager GRØD Oslo
jobs.description:
GRØD søker en ny Assistant Store Manager til Oslo

GRØD har eksistert i 14 år og har i dag 10 grøtbarer i Danmark og 1 i Norge. Siden den første åpningen i 2011 har vi minnet gjestene våre på hvor utrolig godt grøt kan være, og vist hvorfor den gamle grøttradisjonen er verdt å ta vare på.


Om jobben

Som Assistant Store Manager har du ansvar for å støtte Store Manager i en av våre grøtbarer og det tilhørende teamet. Du skal bidra til at grøtbaren alltid står skarpt, at maten smaker fantastisk, og at teamet på 10–15 medarbeidere trives, samarbeider og spiller hverandre gode.

Det er derfor viktig at du kan bidra til å motivere, lede og skape mening for teamet ditt.

I GRØD brenner vi for det vi gjør, og vi forventer det samme av våre kolleger. Det er mange forskjellige oppgaver, og du må derfor forvente at det tar tid og engasjement før du virkelig føler at du mestrer jobben.

Til gjengjeld får du muligheten til å jobbe i en virksomhet som ønsker å skape et sterkt fellesskap, en morsom hverdag og en grunnleggende følelse av mening. Vi er også en arbeidsplass som legger stor vekt på at man hele tiden utvikler seg og blir dyktigere.

Sammen med Store Manager skal du være med på å sikre en god hverdag i vår lille, men travle butikk.


Dine primære arbeidsoppgaver

  • Lage deilig grøt og gi god service til gjestene våre

  • Bidra til å ha kontroll på økonomi, vareforbruk og lønnskostnader

  • Sikre rene, hyggelige og innbydende omgivelser for gjestene våre

  • Sikre godt vedlikehold av grøtbaren og driftsmidlene

  • Bidra aktivt til fellesskapet og den gode stemningen i teamet


Om deg

Du vil lykkes i rollen dersom du tar eierskap, er nysgjerrig på å lære og samtidig er flink til å lære bort til andre.

Du trives med å ha mange baller i luften, og du forstår viktigheten av å sette tonen og bidra til en sunn og positiv arbeidskultur.


Vi forventer at:

  • Du liker å bruke tid på kjøkkenet og å gi god service til gjestene

  • Du trives i et ungt team bestående av 10–15 motiverte medarbeidere

  • Du er strukturert og evner å organisere og holde oversikt

  • Du klarer å holde hodet kaldt i travle situasjoner og har gjennomslagskraft

  • Du er motiverende og anerkjennende, og har en diplomatisk tilnærming til andre mennesker

  • Du kommuniserer tydelig og har en imøtekommende utstråling

  • Du evner å jobbe effektivt både i perioder med høyt og lavt tempo


Vi tilbyr deg

  • En attraktiv og sosial arbeidsplass

  • Varierte arbeidstider fra tidlig morgen til sen kveld, både hverdager og helger

  • En spennende og variert arbeidshverdag

  • Muligheten til å lede og utvikle et ungt og energisk team

  • Ansettelse på timelønnede vilkår


Om GRØD

GRØD åpnet dørene for første gang i et lite kjellerlokale i Jægersborggade i København i 2011. Siden den gang har vi vokst til 10 grøtbarer i Danmark og 1 – snart 2 – grøtbarer i Oslo.

Kvalitet og bærekraft står sentralt i alt vi gjør. Målet vårt er å være en del av den plantebaserte revolusjonen og vise hele verden at grøt er så mye mer enn kjedelig, klissete havregrøt.

Vi jobber i små butikker hvor kvalitet, samarbeid og struktur er avgjørende for at vi skal kunne lage den perfekte grøten, gi gjestene våre den helt riktige opplevelsen og samtidig ha den best mulige arbeidshverdagen.

Vi verdsetter fellesskap, ærlighet og mennesker med masse energi!

Vi gjør vårt beste for å legge til rette for fellesskap, og arrangerer blant annet løpeklubb og andre sosiale aktiviteter.


Interessert?

Hvis dette høres interessant ut, håper vi å motta søknaden din. Vi gjennomfører intervjuer fortløpende.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

GRØD

Om arbeidsgiveren:

GRØD is a café and restaurant concept that opened in Nørrebro, Copenhagen in 2011, with a nerdy focus on everything related to "grød", including porridge, smoothie bowls, daal, congee, risotto and bowls. Most countries have a unique "porridge"-culture that explores different ingredients, grains and spices. And when it's made right, it tastes absolutely fantastic – and it’s naturally healthy and sustainable. We also highly value community among our colleagues and our guests, and love working with people who understand that their energy has a big impact on their surroundings. GRØD has restaurants in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Oslo, as well as a series of retail products available in the most major supermarket brands.

jobs.title: Executive Communications Specialist
jobs.description:
Based at our Fornebu office. This is primarily an office-based role, requiring regular in-person collaboration with the CEO, leadership team, and key stakeholders.

About Falkor

We build industrial intelligence software for heavy-asset sectors. As a KONGSBERG company backed by over 200 years of heritage, Falkor helps the energy, chemicals, utilities and other industrial sectors operate with absolute clarity, confidence, and control.

Our AI-enabled platform connects people, systems, and workflows, expanding human capability by turning complex data into real-time, actionable decisions. We help leading organizations improve safety, efficiency and performance while redefining how heavy assets are designed and operated.

Role Purpose

The Executive Communications Specialist partners closely with the CEO to deliver clear, engaging, and consistent communications across Falkor. Acting as an extension of the CEO, the role translates complex business, technology, and industry topics into compelling communications for employees, customers, partners, industry stakeholders, and the wider market.

The role combines executive communications, internal communications, and communication coordination, helping ensure key messages are delivered effectively across the organisation and externally.

What You'll Do

Executive Communications

  • Partner with the CEO to develop presentations, speeches, talking points, briefing materials, and key messages.

  • Write content on behalf of the CEO, including LinkedIn posts, articles, internal communications, video scripts, and external thought leadership content.

  • Translate complex business, technology, and industry topics into clear, engaging, and accessible communications.

  • Support the CEO with day-to-day communication priorities, announcements, and strategic messaging.

  • Help strengthen the CEO's profile through consistent thought leadership and communication activities.

Internal Communications

  • Plan and coordinate company-wide communications, including All Hands meetings, Town Halls, leadership updates, and key announcements.

  • Develop communications that improve employee understanding of company strategy, priorities, and organisational changes.

  • Manage and maintain internal communication channels, including the company intranet and leadership communication materials.

  • Partner with leaders across the business to communicate important initiatives and business updates.

  • Help ensure a consistent tone of voice and messaging across internal communications.

External Communications & Industry Visibility

  • Draft and coordinate press releases, external announcements, customer communications, and communication materials.

  • Prepare key messages, briefing documents, and supporting materials for interviews, events, conferences, and speaking engagements.

  • Support industry award submissions, conference abstracts, biographies, and speaker applications.

  • Identify opportunities to enhance Falkor's and the CEO's visibility across industry, customer, and partner communities.

Communication Coordination & Planning

  • Coordinate communication activities across teams, ensuring stakeholders are aligned, informed, and engaged.

  • Research industry, business, and technology developments and convert insights into clear executive summaries.

  • Support cross-functional initiatives that require communication, alignment, and stakeholder engagement.

  • Ensure communications are delivered accurately, professionally, and at the appropriate time.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Business, Marketing, or a related discipline.

  • Approximately 5+ years of experience in communications, executive communications, corporate communications, public relations, or a related field.

  • Experience supporting senior leaders or executives with communication activities.

  • Experience within a corporate environment is essential.

  • Excellent written and verbal English, with exceptional editing and proofreading skills.

  • Strong presentation development skills, including PowerPoint.

  • Ability to simplify complex topics into clear, engaging, and impactful communications.

  • Strong organisational, stakeholder management, and coordination skills.

  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in technology, software, industrial technology, or related sectors is advantageous.

Preferred Experience

  • Executive communications, executive branding, or thought leadership.

  • Internal communications and employee engagement initiatives.

  • Media relations and public relations activities.

  • Social media content creation, particularly LinkedIn.

  • Conference speaking programmes, award submissions, and industry visibility initiatives.

Success in the Role

Success will be measured by:

  • High-quality communication materials that effectively support the CEO and leadership team.

  • Clear, consistent, and engaging internal communications that improve employee understanding and alignment.

  • Increased visibility and thought leadership presence for both the CEO and Falkor.

  • Effective coordination and delivery of communication initiatives across multiple stakeholders.

  • Complex topics translated into simple, compelling, and actionable communications.

  • Trusted partnership with the CEO and leadership team.

  • Consistent messaging across internal and external communication channels.

Personal Qualities

  • Exceptional writer and communicator.

  • Collaborative and relationship-oriented.

  • Highly organised and structured.

  • Proactive and self-motivated.

  • Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

  • Professional, discreet, and trusted with sensitive information.

  • Commercially aware and able to think strategically.

  • Curious about business, technology, and industry trends.

  • Brings positive energy and pragmatism.

Why Join Falkor?

You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.

At Falkor, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact.

  • Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains.

  • Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation.

  • Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally.

  • Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries.

We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work.

Ready to Apply?

If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today with your resume.

Agency Notice

Falkor occasionally partners with selected recruitment agencies for specific hiring requirements. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions and will not be responsible for associated fees unless terms have been agreed in advance through our Procurement team.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Kongsberg Digital, our mission is to transform the world’s most complex and asset-intensive industries through world-leading, AI-powered digital twin technology. As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. With domain expertise baked into every line of code and a high-calibre team united by a clear mission, we’re not just keeping pace with change—we’re setting the standard. As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact.

jobs.title: Creative Technologist
jobs.description:
Superside is seeking a curious, multidisciplinary Creative Technologist to join our team.  Shifted from a traditional node-based specialist, this role focuses on someone who uses emerging technology to solve creative briefings and generate innovative outputs. You will bridge the gap between tech and creativity—experimenting with new AI platforms, testing tools, and pushing the boundaries of what is possible in creative workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Tech-First Creative Problem Solving: Analyze creative briefs and leverage existing or emerging technology (especially generative AI tools) to formulate solutions and deliver high-quality creative outputs.

  • Rapid Prototyping & Tool Experimentation: Actively test, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI tools and platforms into studio workflows.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the creative and technical teams to translate project needs into innovative solutions.

  • Continuous Learning: Adapt quickly to new methodologies and internal studio standards through ongoing hands-on training.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Mindset Over Mastery: A strong problem-solving mindset with a demonstrated history of using technology to tackle creative challenges. (Advanced node-based proficiency, e.g., ComfyUI, is a plus but can be trained if the core tech-creative mindset is present).

  • Generative AI Fluency: Deep engagement with the generative AI space. Active user or ambassador of platforms such as Runway, Luma/Dream Machine, Midjourney, Magnific, Krea, Flora, Figma Weave, or similar tools.

  • Background & Industry Experience: Experience in tech-focused creative environments, startups, or AI innovation labs (rather than traditional advertising agencies).

  • Public/Portfolio Presence: A strong portfolio or public footprint (e.g., LinkedIn posts, personal projects) demonstrating active experimentation with new tech and AI tools.


Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

High performance, low ego.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.


About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension 

of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance. 

Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com


Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Superside revolutionizes the global design industry by building new tech and data science-driven processes that enable distributed teams to work together much more efficiently and robust. We deliver high-velocity on-demand design to enterprises, with a data-driven and meritocratic mindset unlike any other platform or service. Superside is pioneering the future of remote work with a tech-enabled platform that creates super efficiencies and advantages workers by way of fostering community and greater income predictability with flexible work and stable wages. Our mission is to shape the global labor market; by having a fair and transparent labor platform that is great for both remote workers and enterprise customers. We currently have more than 100 creatives spanning six continents, 58 countries, and 19 timezones, and we work mainly with major US-based brands, including Tiffany & Co, Amazon, Cisco, L’Oreal and others. We have hub offices in Oslo, Toronto and Cape Town but are essentially based nowhere. We are remote-first with team members spread across the world. Superside was founded in late 2015 and became the first Norwegian company to join the Y Combinator accelerator in Palo Alto, California. We have since received funding from reputable Silicon Valley investors Freestyle Venture, High Alpha, Slack Fund, Sam Altman, Alliance Venture, and others. We're always-on and chase the sun to deliver the moon!

jobs.title: Part-time Driver Larvik
jobs.description:
Join us as a driver on weekends in Larvik!

At Oda, we come to work every day to create affordable grocery services that make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.

As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and the Delivery Team Leaders on-site. You’ll deliver groceries and packages to our customers in the area. We believe you'll enjoy working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and as part of a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. It would also be best if you enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not just driving.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

  • Maintain efficiency and quality by loading and unloading goods, handling customers, and following routines and processes.

  • Ensuring Customer service at the highest level.

  • Be responsible for simple maintenance of the car fleet, such as changing light bulbs, topping up liquids, and keeping the cars clean and presentable at all times.

  • Training new drivers on the road.

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Driving license (Class B) with a minimum of 2 years' driving experience.

  • Speaking English is required, and familiarity with Norwegian or another Nordic language is a plus.


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Are active and like it, as this is a physically demanding job

  • Like working independently and with a team

  • Have a good work ethic

  • Are service-oriented and solution-oriented.

  • Have a genuine desire to succeed and make customers happy

  • Responsible and prioritizes safe behaviour in traffic


What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.


Practical informationℹ️

  • Application deadline: Apply before 30.09. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once we find the right candidates, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Starting date: As soon as possible

  • Location: Rødbølveien 16, 3270 Larvik

  • Working hours: Part-time 20% position with work every other weekend, Saturday 05:30-13:30 and Sunday 13:30-21:30


At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. As soon as you submit an application for this position, you will be invited via email to a chat-based interview. Therefore, be careful to enter your correct email address so that the invitation reaches the right person🤖

We can’t wait to hear from you🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist- Spain
jobs.description:
Sobre nosotros

Nofence ha creado la primera solución de cercado virtual del mundo para ganado. La tecnología consiste en un collar con energía solar que se comunica con una aplicación a través de la red celular. Mediante la aplicación, los ganaderos pueden configurar nuevas zonas de pastoreo en segundos. El ganado puede pastar durante más tiempo y en más zonas, siempre pudiendo controlar su ubicación. Esto se traduce en mayor rentabilidad, más tiempo libre para los ganaderos y un mejor bienestar animal.

Con más de 3000 clientes en Noruega, Suecia, Reino Unido, España, Irlanda y Estados Unidos, estamos ampliando nuestro equipo para crecer en España.

Nuestro equipo de soporte busca un candidato bilingüe (español/inglés) para reforzar nuestro equipo. ¡Únete a nosotros en este viaje para revolucionar la ganadería y crear una vida mejor para ganaderos y animales!

Sobre el puesto

El puesto implica el seguimiento diario de clientes y la gestión de casos de soporte. Formarás parte integral de un equipo comprometido con un enfoque centrado en el cliente. Buscamos a una persona organizada y entusiasta para unirse a nuestro equipo y brindar un excelente servicio al cliente.

Para establecer buenas relaciones con los clientes, necesitamos comprender sus necesidades y guiarlos para que aprovechen al máximo nuestro producto. Se valorará positivamente la experiencia previa trabajando con agricultores y ganaderos.

Buscamos a una persona organizada con una actitud flexible en todos los aspectos del puesto. El candidato ideal es proactivo, enérgico y trabajador, preferiblemente con experiencia en el sector agrícola/ganadero.

Como parte de nuestro equipo, tendrás la oportunidad de crecer junto con la empresa, ya que las oportunidades de desarrollo son ilimitadas tanto para nuestro producto como para nuestros empleados.

Título: Asesor/a de Soporte al Cliente

Estado: Jornada completa. 40 horas semanales

Supervisor: Responsable de España

Ubicación: España (preferiblemente cerca de Vitoria-Gasteiz)

Responsabilidades principales

Las principales responsabilidades de este puesto serán:

  • Responder a las consultas de nuestros clientes por teléfono, correo electrónico y creación de tickets.

  • Mantener un contacto estrecho con los clientes y garantizar un alto nivel de satisfacción.

  • Colaborar con otros departamentos y equipos dentro de Nofence.

  • Documentar y actualizar los registros y casos de los clientes en nuestro sistema CRM.

  • Remitir los problemas complejos a nuestro departamento de Producto e Ingeniería.

  • Contribuir a la recopilación de estadísticas sobre el rendimiento de nuestros productos.

  • Garantizar el intercambio de conocimientos e información entre los equipos de soporte central y local.

En la fase actual de crecimiento de nuestro equipo, necesitamos a alguien adaptable y dispuesto a contribuir con tareas no relacionadas con el soporte, como:

  • Contribuir con proyectos de toda la organización.

  • Mejorar la experiencia del cliente mediante soporte proactivo: ayudar al cliente a adquirir conocimientos y encontrar soluciones a través de nuestras herramientas y canales de información.

  • Contribuir al desarrollo del equipo de soporte y a la configuración de nuestra estructura.

Sobre ti

Buscamos a alguien con lo siguiente:

  • Título universitario o similar en un campo relevante para el puesto (agricultura/ganadería) o experiencia práctica en una explotación.

  • Experiencia como consultor de soporte o en un puesto similar en una empresa o sector tecnológico.

  • Capacidad para solucionar problemas de hardware y software utilizando diversas herramientas y métodos.

  • Gran interés en nuestro producto y capacidad para adquirir conocimientos sobre nuestra tecnología.

  • Buenas habilidades informáticas y experiencia con soluciones informáticas.

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita.

  • Dominio del español (oral y escrito) y conocimientos básicos de inglés.

  • Se valorará la pasión por resolver problemas técnicos complejos, pero no es un requisito indispensable.

Buscamos a alguien que:

  • Tenga iniciativa, trabaje de forma independiente y priorice las tareas más importantes.

  • Apasionado/a por el servicio al cliente en general, con gran capacidad para identificar desafíos y ofrecer soluciones.

  • Independiente y proactivo/a.

  • Eficiente y con facilidad para trabajar en equipo.

  • Un/a jugador/a de equipo con vocación de servicio.

  • Gran atención al detalle y un sólido compromiso con la calidad.

  • Un/a jugador/a de equipo que colabora eficazmente, comparte conocimientos, experiencia e información, y apoya a sus compañeros en la consecución de los objetivos del equipo.

¿Qué podemos ofrecer?

Como empresa en sus inicios, nuestra forma de trabajar está en constante evolución, y tendrás la oportunidad de influir en cómo hacemos las cosas. Nos apasiona el desarrollo de productos, el bienestar animal, el bienestar de los ganaderos y la agricultura sostenible. Como parte de nuestro equipo, formarás parte de una empresa dinámica con grandes ambiciones de crecimiento internacional.

¡Creemos firmemente que nuestra tecnología de pastoreo puede ser el mayor avance tecnológico en la agricultura desde el tractor!

Acerca de Nofence

La gestión del ganado siempre ha sido un desafío. La humanidad ha intentado de todo, desde el pastoreo con perros hasta el cercado con alambre, cercas eléctricas y de madera, pero estas soluciones son costosas y requieren mucho tiempo, además de entrar en conflicto con la fauna local.

Hasta ahora.

Lo que comenzó como un pequeño grupo de agricultores e ingenieros con una gran idea se ha convertido en Nofence: la primera solución de vallado virtual para ganado del mundo. ¿Tienes curiosidad por saber cómo funciona? Descubre más aquí.

Acerca del equipo

En Nofence, no somos un trabajo de oficina convencional. Somos una empresa dinámica en crecimiento, donde la dedicación y la innovación son la norma, ofreciendo grandes oportunidades para tu desarrollo personal y profesional.

¡Creemos firmemente que nuestra tecnología de pastoreo es el mayor avance tecnológico en la ganadería desde el tractor!

Forma parte de un equipo que siempre mira hacia el futuro, donde tus ideas y creatividad no solo son bienvenidas, sino esenciales para nuestro éxito mutuo.

Acerca de la solicitud

¿Estás listo?

Evaluaremos a los candidatos de forma continua. Si tienes alguna pregunta sobre Nofence o sobre la solicitud, no dudes en contactarnos.






About us

Nofence has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. The technology consists of a solar-powered collar that communicates with an app over the cellular network. Through the app, farmers can set up a new grazing area in seconds, and the long days of installing and moving fences are officially over! Livestock can graze longer and in more areas, and the farmer will always have visibility of their location. This means better profitability and more free time for farmers as well as improved animal welfare.

With a strong foundation of 3,000+ customers in Norway, Sweden, the UK, Spain, Ireland and the US we are now expanding our team to grow in Spain.

Our support team is now looking for an Spanish/English speaking candidate to strengthen our team. Join us on the journey to revolutionize agriculture and create a better everyday life for farmers and animals!

About the role

The position will involve daily follow-up with customers and support cases. You will become an integral part of a dedicated team with a customer centric approach. We are looking for a structured and enthusiastic team member who is eager to provide excellent customer service.

To create good customer relations we need to be able to understand the customers needs and guide them through how to best utilize our product. Previous experience of working with farmers would be a great advantage.

We are looking for a structured candidate with a flexible approach to all aspects of the role. The right candidate is self-motivated, energetic, and hardworking, preferably with a background from agriculture. As a part of our team you will have the opportunity to grow together with the company, as the opportunities for development are endless both for our product and our employees!

Title: Customer Support Advisor

Status: Full-time position. 40-hrs a week

Supervisor: Head of Spain

Location: Spain (preferably closer to Vitoria-Gasteiz)


Main Responsibilities

The main responsibilities for this role will be:

  • Responding to inquiries from our customers via phone, email and ticketing system,

  • Maintaining close customer contact and securing a high level of customer satisfaction.

  • Collaborating across departments and other teams within Nofence.

  • Documenting and updating customer records and cases in our CRM system.

  • Escalating complex or unresolved issues to our Product and Engineering department.

  • Contributing in collecting statistics on the performance of our products.

  • Ensuring knowledge and information sharing between the central and local support teams.

In the current phase of growing our team we will need someone who is adaptable and willing to contribute to non-support related tasks like;

  • Contributing to projects across the organization.

  • Improving the customer journey through proactive support - helping the customer gain competence and finding solutions through our tools and information channels.

  • Contributing to developing the Support team and shaping our structure.


About you

We are looking for someone who has the following:

  • A degree or equivalent in a field relevant to the position (agriculture/livestock) or practical on-farm experience.

  • Experience as a support consultant or similar role in a tech company or industry.

  • Ability to troubleshoot hardware and software issues using various tools and methods.

  • Keen interest in our product and ability to gain competence in our technology.

  • Good IT skills and experience with ICT solutions.

  • Strong communication skills both orally and in writing.

  • Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Spanish and basic English.

  • Passion for resolving complex technical issues is preferred, but not a requirement.

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Eager to show initiative, works independently and prioritises the most important tasks first.

  • Passionate for customer service in general, and has an eye for discovering challenges and providing solutions.

  • Independent and self-driven.

  • Efficient and enjoys structure.

  • A team player with a heart for the greater good.

  • High attention to detail and a solid commitment to quality.

  • A team player that cooperate well with others, share knowledge, experience and information, and support other team members in the pursuit of team goals.


What can we offer?

As a company still in our early stages, our way of working is continuously evolving, and you will have the opportunity to make an impact on how we do things. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, farmer welfare and sustainable agriculture. As our colleague you will be part of an exciting company with enormous ambitions for international growth. We genuinely believe our grazing technology can be the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!


About Nofence

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. Curious about how it works? Find out more here.


About the team

At Nofence, we are not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We are a dynamic scale-up, where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, farmer welfare and sustainable agriculture. We genuinely believe our grazing technology is the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!

Be part of a team that’s always looking forward, where your ideas and creativity are not only welcomed but also essential to our mutual success!

About the Application

Are you ready to change pasture?

We will evaluate candidates continuously. If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vår beiteteknologi skal bidra til at mer av verdens arealressurser kan utnyttes til bærekraftig matproduksjon.En stor andel beitedyr lever mesteparten av livet innendørs og spiser mye kraftfor. Målsettingen til Nofence er å få beitedyra ut på beite, på en trygg og god måte, slik at de kan ha det godt og selv finne den maten de er skapt for å spise.Vi vil at beitedyr skal få muligheten til å ta i bruk sitt naturlige miljø. Det er god dyrevelferd og det vil frigjøre store arealer som kan brukes til å dyrke menneskemat i stedet for soya i kraftforproduksjon.Vår teknologi gir dyra denne muligheten.

jobs.title: Tour guides for Oslo - Part time freelance
jobs.description:
Tour Guide – Oslo

Part-time freelance | Small Groups

Do people describe you as a storyteller? Are you the friend who always ends up explaining the history, recommending the hidden café, or connecting the dots? Do you love Oslo — not just the postcard version, but the layers beneath it?

Then keep reading.


About Amitylux

Amitylux is a multi-award-winning boutique travel company creating high-touch, personal guided experiences across the Nordics and the UK. We focus on small groups, meaningful conversations, and experiences that feel natural rather than scripted. Our tours are relaxed, human, and built around connection. We value calm, confident leadership. We value thoughtful storytelling that adapts to the group. We value presence, awareness, and reading the room. Our guests come from all over the world — from curious leisure travellers to corporate and VIP groups. What they all appreciate is authenticity, quality, and a genuine sense of welcome rather than being processed.

You Might Be a Great Fit If You:

  • Can turn strangers into friends within a few hours

  • Feel comfortable leading while staying warm and approachable

  • Have lived in Oslo long enough to truly understand it

  • Plan to stay and grow here

  • Speak fluent English (additional languages are a strong plus)

  • Enjoy walking and being outdoors

  • Understand that guiding is both performance and hospitality

This is not about memorising dates. It’s about creating a feeling people remember.


What You’ll Experience With Us

  • A supportive, high-standard team culture

  • Autonomy and trust

  • The chance to meet people from around the world

  • The opportunity to grow your leadership and storytelling skills

  • Being part of a brand that cares deeply about guest experience

We take pride in what we do — and we look for people who feel the same.

Join us on this journey — and help shape meaningful travel experiences in Oslo. 


Application

We review candidates continuously and close once we find the right match.

Please note: Applications are only accepted via our hiring platform on The Hub. We are unable to review applications sent by email or other channels.

Important: Your application must include a short personal video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a great fit for Amitylux. Applications without a video will not be considered.

(The Hub allows you to record directly. Pre-recorded files can be added as a link or file.)


IMPORTANT! To be part of the hiring process, please apply through our hiring platform in The Hub.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Amitylux is a multi-award-winning sightseeing tour agency, private experience organizer, and boutique Travel Management Company (TMC). We operate across the Northern cities— including Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki, and Tallinn - as well as in London and Edinburgh in the UK. While these cities are at the heart of our operations, our services extend across each country, offering unique experiences in beloved landmarks and remarkable local treasures. As a premier provider of luxury travel experiences, Amitylux offers tailor-made tours, concierge services, and comprehensive travel management solutions for both leisure and corporate clients. Our team specializes in crafting bespoke itineraries and handling every detail with precision, ensuring unforgettable journeys filled with luxury, comfort, and personalized attention. Whether you're seeking an exclusive private tour or seamless travel logistics for a group or corporate retreat, Amitylux is here to deliver - with heart, precision, and passion. We live it. You'll love it.

jobs.title: Content Specialist | Denmark
jobs.description:
🇳🇴 Jobbet er et 1-årigt vikariat i Oslo, så du skal enten bo her eller have lyst til at flytte hertil. Der er mulighed for fastansættelse, hvis vi er et godt match.

Brug din danske skrivelyst i en driftig norsk virksomhed. Vi søger en Content Specialist, der er grundig, initiativrig og velbevandret i det danske sprog.

Alle kan – med lidt hjælp fra deres bedste AI-ven – skrive en velformuleret tekst med korrekt kommasætning.

Færre kan skrive fængende, så læserne bliver hængende.

Få kan skrive engagerende og vedkommende.

Vi søger en Content Specialist, der holder af og er velbevandret i det danske sprog. En skribent, der kan researche, redigere, reformulere og rulle gedigent godt indhold ud.

Vi bruger AI som værktøj, men det er dig og din sproglige sans, vi ansætter.


Hvem er du?

  • Du taler og skriver flydende, fejlfrit dansk.

  • Du er grundig og detaljeorienteret

  • Du er dygtig til at researche, har en veludviklet kritisk sans og ikke stoler blindt på din bedste AI-ven

  • Du kan tilegne dig store mængder viden og sammenfatte det på en letlæselig måde

  • Du har gode kommunikationsevner og trives med løbende at modtage og give respektfuld og konstruktiv feedback

  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og tager ejerskab over dine opgaver

  • Du er nysgerrig og sætter pris på at lære nye ting

Det er en bonus – men ikke påkrævet – hvis du har erfaring med:

  • Begreber som CMS, SEO, GEO, konvertering, AB-test osv.

  • Valg af billeder og formatering af artikler

  • Photoshop, Figma, Canva o.l.

  • Indholdsproduktion til sociale medier

  • Udvikling af artikler og/eller indhold til digitale tjenester


Hvem er vi?

Nettbureau er en norsk virksomhed, som har over 15 års erfaring med at udvikle online tilbuds- og sammenligningstjenester. Vi er cirka 100 ansatte, der driver lige så mange digitale tjenester i 16 lande.

De fleste arbejder fra vores Oslo-kontor på Tøyen, men vi har også kontor i Skien og Stockholm – derudover har vi en håndfuld kollegaer, som arbejder remote fra bl.a. Aarhus og Amsterdam.

Vi har tradition for at ansætte mennesker frem for uddannelser, og vi er derfor en broget blanding af folk med forskellige faglige baggrunde – alt fra litteraturvidenskabere og historikere til ingeniører, IT-folk og læger.

Du bliver først og fremmest en del af det danske team, og dine nærmeste kollegaer bliver en håndfuld danskere med forskellige faglige baggrunde.

Vi driver og udvikler digitale tjenester, som gør livet lidt nemmere for helt almindelige forbrugere. Hovedsageligt sammenlignings- og tilbudstjenester, eksempelvis Ladeboks.dk, Varmepumpe.dk, Flytte.dk og Ejendomsmægler.dk.

Vi har været Gazellevirksomhed 10 år i træk og er blevet udpeget som en af de hurtigst voksende virksomheder i Europa af The Financial Times.

Når vi ikke er travlt optaget af at udvikle digitale tjenester, lægger vi stor vægt på det sociale miljø.

For dem, som har tid og lyst, arrangerer vi forskellige sociale aktiviteter; en årlig kick-off, spilleaftener, lønningspils osv.

Vi har også en bogklub, filmklub, skak-entusiaster, strikkedamer og ivrige bordtennisspillere.

📖 Lær os bedre at kende på Nettbureau.com og tag et kig i vores medarbejderhåndbog.


Hvad bliver dine primære arbejdsopgaver?

Velskrevet og grundigt researchet indhold er en vigtig del af alle vores tjenester – og her kommer du ind i billedet. Dine primære arbejdsopgaver kommer til at være, at:

  • Skrive informativt indhold om emner, du mest sandsynligt ikke ved noget om på forhånd, fx varmepumper, ladebokse eller eltariffer

  • Vedligeholde og opdatere indhold på nuværende tjenester

  • Flytte en del af vores indhold til vores nye CMS og kvalitetssikre nuværende indhold

  • Udvikle indhold som rangerer i søgemaskiner og driver konverteringer

  • Oversætte indhold fra norsk, svensk og engelsk til dansk

  • Gennemse og korrekturlæse andres arbejde – løbende feedback er centralt for vores team, og du skal være komfortabel med både at give og få den


Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

  • Et trygt og godt arbejdsmiljø med ambitiøse og sociale kollegaer

  • Plads til at vokse professionelt og udvikle dine kompetencer i forskellige retninger

  • Mulighed for at udforske forskellige discipliner inden for indholdsproduktion

  • Fleksible arbejdstider i en rummelig og fladt struktureret virksomhed

  • Indflydelse på udviklingen af nye såvel som etablerede tjenester

  • Ansvar og en masse læring i en spændende branche

  • Oveni din løn får du ekstra midler til fx fitness-medlemskab og personlig udvikling

  • Frit valg mellem Mac/PC, og vi dækker internet og telefon

  • Frihed under ansvar


Sådan søger du

Send os en motiveret ansøgning og dit CV. Vedlæg også gerne noget, du har skrevet tidligere og er stolt af. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

NB: Vi modtager kun ansøgninger via vores karriereportal – ikke på e-mail eller LinkedIn.

  • Ansøgningsfrist: Søndag d. 23. august, 2026

  • Ansættelsesform: Fuldtid, 1-årigt barselsvikariat

  • Arbejdssted: Oslo, Norge

  • Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nettbureau builds online platforms that help people and businesses. For over a decade, we’ve connected users with great deals and suppliers with new customers in over 10 countries through lead generation. Our goal is to give users great deals to compare so they can make informed choices, while helping our suppliers to attract new customers. With recognition by the Financial Times in their list of “Europe’s Long-term Growth Champions” for 2025 and 2026, we’re focusing on sustainability and constantly improving every aspect of our services for our users, businesses and our team. Every year, we connect millions of users with our partners through bespoke technology designed to benefit both parties. Almost everything we do is built in-house, and we invest heavily in technology. We're a technology company, after all.

jobs.title: Vergroot je impact in het onderwijs: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager - Nederland

Heb jij een achtergrond in de onderwijssector en de ambitie om jouw impact te vergroten over honderden scholen en onderwijsinstanties? Ben je gepassioneerd om onderwijsprofessionals te helpen schoolverzuim aan te pakken met behulp van technologie? No Isolation is op zoek naar een Customer Success Manager met jouw ervaring om ons team te versterken.

We winnen gestaag terrein in Nederland. Steeds meer scholen, gemeenten en onderwijsinstanties zetten de AV1-robot in. Daarom zoeken we iemand die het Nederlandse onderwijssysteem van binnenuit kent en zorgt voor een succesvolle acceptatie en inzet van onze technologie. Dit is onze allereerste rol van dit type in Nederland.

Veel van onze teamleden in europa hebben zelf een achtergrond in het onderwijs of bij onderwijs autoriteiten. Onze Director of Customer Success, Simone, is een bevoegd docent met bijna 30 jaar ervaring, variërend van functies als senior docent, leerkracht speciaal onderwijs en schoolleider tot hoofd van een onderwijsteam bij een lokale overheid. De wereld waar jij vandaan komt, hoef je ons dus niet meer uit te leggen.


Over ons

Bij No Isolation zijn we een winstgevende, Scandinavische EdTech scale-up van 65 medewerkers met activiteiten in heel Europa. Wij helpen onderwijsprofessionals om elk kind te laten leren en erbij te laten horen.

Onze AV1-robot wordt ingezet in meer dan 19 landen. Ruim 5.000 robots ondersteunen scholen bij het verbeteren van de aanwezigheid, de sociale betrokkenheid en de continuïteit van het onderwijs voor kinderen die niet fysiek aanwezig kunnen zijn. Het wordt keer op keer omschreven als levensveranderend: AV1 overbrugt de kloof tussen de leerling en de klas, waardoor zowel het onderwijs continuïteit als het essentiële gevoel van erbij horen wordt hersteld.

We zijn groot genoeg om een bewezen oplossing en een solide financiële basis te bieden, maar nog klein genoeg zodat elke nieuwe collega direct een zichtbare impact heeft op onze volgende groeifase.


Waarom deze rol ertoe doet:

✅ Help onderwijsprofessionals een van de grootste uitdagingen in het huidige onderwijs aan te pakken.

✅ Maak een blijvende impact voor kinderen die niet naar school kunnen.

✅ Sluit je aan bij een organisatie waar jouw werk gewaardeerd wordt, jouw stem telt en jouw welzijn prioriteit heeft.

✅ Help ons om ons Customer Success-proces aan te passen aan de Nederlandse markt.


De kans: Customer Success Manager

Dit is meer dan zomaar een baan. Dit is een kans om een partnerschap aan te gaan met onderwijsprofessionals, scholen, gemeenten en onderwijsinstanties (zoals Samenwerkingsverbanden, schoolbesturen, stichtingen en gemeenten) door heel Nederland om schoolverzuim aan te pakken; een van de grootste uitdagingen in het onderwijs van vandaag. Door hen te helpen bij de implementatie van AV1, zorg je ervoor dat afwezige leerlingen verbonden blijven met de lesstof en de klas én ondersteun je hun succesvolle terugkeer naar het lokaal.

Wereldwijd hebben we onderwijsprofessionals al geholpen om meer dan 15.000 leerlingen terug naar school te begeleiden. In deze rol bouw jij die impact in Nederland verder uit. In de praktijk betekent dit dat je:

  • Duurzame partnerschappen opbouwen met scholen, gemeenten en onderwijsinstanties, waarbij je een gewaardeerd adviseur bent op het gebied van schoolverzuim en klanten helpt om op lange termijn succesvol te zijn met AV1.

  • Onboarding- en implementatieprojecten leiden, succesfactoren definiëren en zorgen dat klanten de maximale waarde uit AV1 halen.

  • De expert op het gebied van AV1 wordt: je adviseert over best practices, verandermanagement en hoe scholen de inzet en impact van de robot kunnen maximaliseren.

  • Nauw samenwerkt met onze Accountmanagers om onderwijsleiders en besluitvormers te betrekken, kansen te identificeren om AV1 breder uit te rollen (binnen scholen, besturen, gemeenten en regio's) en strategische klantgesprekken te ondersteunen.

  • Geloofwaardigheid, inzicht en empathie meebrengen in elk gesprek, waarmee je onderwijsprofessionals helpt om blijvende impact te maken én het bereik van AV1 in Nederland vergroot.

Met jouw achtergrond in het onderwijs zorg je ervoor dat AV1 niet zomaar een technologisch hulpmiddel is, maar een waardevol instrument voor inclusie binnen het Nederlandse onderwijsstelsel. Jouw praktijkinzichten; wat werkt wel, waar lopen scholen tegenaan en waar beweegt het Nederlandse onderwijs naartoe, helpen ons om onze ondersteuning aan scholen continu te verbeteren en mee te bewegen met het veranderende onderwijslandschap.


Wat jij meebrengt: Ervaring & vaardigheden

Heb jij minimaal 10 jaar ervaring in de onderwijssector, bij voorkeur (deels) in een leidinggevende rol en ben je benieuwd hoe je jouw expertise kunt inzetten buiten het traditionele klaslokaal? Dan is dit de kans voor jou.

Je brengt geloofwaardigheid, empathie en structuur mee in elk gesprek en neemt graag de regie. Waarschijnlijk herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Achtergrond in het onderwijs: Ervaring in het onderwijs, schoolleiding, advisering, inclusie of onderwijsontwikkeling, bij voorkeur in een senior rol (bijv. als directeur/schoolleider, rector, onderwijskundig leider, beleidsadviseur onderwijs, afdelingsleider, consulent leerplicht of vergelijkbaar).

  • Kennis van het onderwijssysteem: Grondige kennis van de werking en dynamiek binnen het Nederlandse onderwijssysteem, in het bijzonder van Samenwerkingsverbanden, schoolbesturen, stichtingen en gemeenten.

  • Bestuurlijke ervaring: Ervaring met samenwerken met scholen, gemeenten of onderwijs autoriteiten op leidinggevend/bestuurlijk niveau.

  • Veelzijdigheid: In staat om moeiteloos te schakelen tussen pedagogische en administratieve/bestuurlijke contexten.

  • Taalvaardigheid: Uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands (moedertaal of C1/C2-niveau) en een goede beheersing van het Engels in woord en geschrift.

  • Mentaliteit: Een proactieve, oplossingsgerichte instelling en een oprechte passie voor inclusief onderwijs.


Wat wij bieden:

  • Impact buiten het klaslokaal: Je blijft werkzaam in het onderwijs en geeft vorm aan hoe kinderen leren en erbij horen, maar dan vanuit een nieuw perspectief én op grotere schaal dan bij een enkele school.

  • Pioniersrol: De eerste functie in zijn soort in Nederland, waarin jij direct invloed hebt op onze aanpak richting onderwijsinstanties en scholen bij het bestrijden van schoolverzuim.

  • Geen bureaucratie: Minder papierwerk, meer tijd voor daadwerkelijke impact in de onderwijssector.

  • Missiegedreven Scandinavische cultuur: We zetten ons vol overgave in voor onze missie. We leggen de lat hoog en ondersteunen elkaar met oprechte betrokkenheid. Je komt terecht in een warm team dat je de ruimte geeft om het beste uit jezelf te halen.

  • Een team van onderwijsexperts: Je rapporteert aan onze Director of Customer Success, Simone (een ervaren schoolleider), en maakt deel uit van een ervaren Customer Success-team met een diepe onderwijsachtergrond. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's op onze kantoren in Oslo, München en Londen.

  • Alle middelen om te slagen: Wij rusten je goed uit. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Sales-, Marketing- en Product Teams, zodat je altijd beschikt over de juiste materialen en ondersteuning voor de scholen.

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een schaalbare organisatie: Als scale-up zijn we continu in beweging. Dit biedt jou de kans om nieuwe uitdagingen op te pakken, je rol verder vorm te geven en écht impact te maken terwijl we groeien.

  • Flexibiliteit met respect voor jouw ervaring: Mogelijkheid tot hybride/thuiswerken voor een duurzame werk-privébalans, met flexibele werktijden rondom onze kerntijden (10:00-15:00 uur).

  • Aantrekkelijke extra's: Een bonusregeling, vergoeding voor mobiele telefoon en internetabonnement, regelmatige gezellige team evenementen en een jaarlijks bedrijfsuitje.

Elke samenwerking die je opbouwt en elke implementatie die je leidt, helpt scholen om de impact van schoolverzuim te verminderen. Via AV1 zorg je ervoor dat meer kinderen verbonden blijven met het onderwijs en hun klasgenoten, én ondersteun je hun succesvolle terugkeer naar school.


Locatie & praktische zaken

Locatie: Woonachtig in Nederland.

De functie is grotendeels remote (thuiswerken), maar omvat regelmatig reizen naar klanten en partners door het hele land.

Wij verwelkomen alle gekwalificeerde kandidaten. Omdat wij momenteel geen visa of werkvergunningen kunnen sponsoren, kunnen we alleen kandidaten in behandeling nemen die al het wettelijke recht hebben om in Nederland te werken zonder sponsoring van de werkgever.


Hoe te solliciteren

Wil jij je ervaring in de onderwijssector op een nieuwe manier inzetten; een manier waarop jouw inzicht scholen helpt om échte inclusie te omarmen? Dit is jouw kans om voorop te lopen, en we horen heel graag van je.


Klik op 'Apply' en upload je CV in het Engels.


Je mag optioneel een korte video in het Engels toevoegen aan je sollicitatie, een mooie manier om naast je CV iets van je persoonlijkheid te laten zien.


🎥 Bekijk hier hoe AV1 inclusie in het onderwijs transformeert: vimeo.com/1098745115

🌍 Ontdek onze missie en verhalen over onze impact op: noisolation.com


Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

jobs.title: Growth VP - Sitecom
jobs.description:
About Falkor

We build industrial intelligence software for heavy-asset sectors. As a KONGSBERG company backed by over 200 years of heritage, Falkor helps the energy, chemicals, utilities and other industrial sectors operate with absolute clarity, confidence, and control.

Our AI-enabled platform connects people, systems, and workflows—expanding human capability by turning complex data into real-time, actionable decisions.

We help leading organisations improve safety, efficiency and performance while redefining how heavy assets are designed and operated.


About SiteCom

SiteCom is Falkor’s real-time operational intelligence platform for drilling and well operations. The team develops software and data-driven solutions that bring together real-time and historical operational data, analytics, workflows, domain expertise, and AI capabilities into a single operational environment. By helping energy operators monitor operations, identify risks, improve decision-making, and optimise performance across wells and assets, the SiteCom team plays a key role in delivering safer, more efficient, and more data-informed operations for customers around the world.


What You'll Do

We are looking for a Vice President, SiteCom Growth to lead the commercial growth of SiteCom, Falkor's real-time operational intelligence platform for drilling and well operations.

Reporting to the SVP SiteCom, you will be responsible for driving global revenue growth, expanding our customer footprint, and strengthening SiteCom's position as a leading solution for drilling, wells, and operational performance.

You will lead a global team of commercial professionals while working closely with Product, Marketing, Delivery, and Customer Success to translate market opportunities into sustainable business growth. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on commercial execution and is ideal for a leader who enjoys developing teams, building customer relationships, and personally driving high-value opportunities to closure.

As a key member of Falkor's commercial leadership team, you will play an important role in shaping the future growth of SiteCom and accelerating digital transformation across the energy industry.


Your Mission

Build and lead a high-performing commercial organisation that accelerates SiteCom's growth by helping customers improve drilling and well operations through data, analytics, and operational intelligence.


Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a global team of commercial professionals.

  • Create a high-performance culture focused on customer value, accountability, and commercial excellence.

  • Coach and support team members throughout the sales cycle, helping develop both commercial and industry capability.

  • Establish clear objectives, performance measures, and growth plans for the team.

Revenue Growth & Business Development

  • Own SiteCom's global revenue growth strategy and commercial performance.

  • Drive new customer acquisition, account expansion, and long-term customer value creation.

  • Personally lead strategic sales opportunities and executive-level customer engagements.

  • Build and strengthen relationships with key stakeholders across operators, service companies, and industry partners.

  • Develop repeatable go-to-market approaches that support scalable growth across regions and customer segments.

Industry & Market Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to customers by bringing deep understanding of drilling, wells, and operational workflows.

  • Identify market trends, customer challenges, and emerging opportunities that can influence product and commercial strategy.

  • Represent Falkor and SiteCom at industry events, conferences, and customer engagements.

  • Contribute to the development of SiteCom's market positioning and growth strategy.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product and Delivery teams to ensure customer needs are reflected in product priorities and solution development.

  • Work with Marketing to increase market awareness, generate pipeline, and strengthen customer engagement.

  • Ensure commercial commitments align with successful customer outcomes and long-term partnerships.

  • Contribute to forecasting, business planning, and overall revenue management activities.


What We're Looking For

We are seeking an experienced commercial leader who combines deep industry knowledge with a proven ability to drive software and technology sales growth.

You will likely bring:

  • Significant leadership experience in commercial, sales, business development, or growth roles within the energy industry.

  • Strong domain expertise in drilling, wells, well operations, or related operational disciplines.

  • A proven track record of delivering revenue growth and winning complex enterprise opportunities.

  • Experience leading and developing commercial teams across international markets.

  • Strong understanding of software, digital solutions, SaaS, or operational technology platforms.

  • The ability to engage credibly with both technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

  • A hands-on approach and willingness to actively participate in strategic sales opportunities when required.


You are equally comfortable defining commercial strategy and executing it. You enjoy building teams, developing customer relationships, and helping customers solve complex operational challenges.


Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to lead the commercial growth of one of Falkor's key strategic product lines and help shape the future of digital operations within the energy industry.


You will:

  • Lead the global growth agenda for SiteCom.

  • Manage and develop an international commercial team.

  • Work alongside industry experts, product leaders, and technology specialists.

  • Help customers improve drilling and well performance through data, analytics, and operational intelligence.

  • Play a key role in Falkor's continued growth and international expansion.


If you are passionate about commercial leadership, operational excellence, and helping customers transform how they manage drilling and well operations, we'd love to hear from you.


Diversity & Inclusion

At Falkor, we celebrate diversity and strive for inclusivity. We strongly believe that different perspectives and backgrounds drive innovation and contribute to our success. We actively promote a culture of inclusiveness that values and respects every individual, providing equal opportunities for all our employees. Together, we will create a workplace where every game-changing employee can shine and seize equal opportunities.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Kongsberg Digital, our mission is to transform the world’s most complex and asset-intensive industries through world-leading, AI-powered digital twin technology. As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact.

jobs.title: Content Specialist Intern | France
jobs.description:
Mets ta plume au service d'une scale-up scandinave en pleine croissance

Tu es étudiant en dernière année de master en communication ou journalisme et tu es à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études où tes textes auront un impact ? Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement international, au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance, tout en développant tes compétences en rédaction web et SEO ?

Nettbureau recherche un stagiaire pour soutenir le marché francophone de contenu et de texte, de janvier à juin 2027 à Oslo.

À propos de Nettbureau

Nettbureau aide chaque année des millions d’utilisateurs à faire des choix éclairés grâce à nos services de comparaison qui les mettent en relation avec des prestataires fiables. Aujourd’hui, nous gérons plus de 100 services dans 16 différents pays européens.

Notre équipe est composée de plus de 90 collègues basés principalement à Oslo. L’équipe francophone est composée de 5 personnes qui travaillent pour nos marques en France, en Belgique et en Suisse.

📖 Pour en savoir plus sur nous, rendez-vous sur Nettbureau.com.

À propos du rôle

Nettbureau est présente en France depuis 2022, principalement dans le secteur des énergies renouvelables, et développe depuis peu des sites en Belgique et en Suisse. En tant que stagiaire en rédaction de contenu, tu contribueras directement au développement de nos services sur ces marchés.

Tes missions principales :

  • Rédiger et publier des contenus de qualité (articles, landing pages, formulaires) pensés pour répondre aux besoins de nos utilisateurs et générer des conversions.

  • Mener des recherches de mots-clés pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités de contenu et repérer ce que nos utilisateurs cherchent vraiment.

  • Optimiser la visibilité de nos contenus aujourd’hui et demain : le SEO reste essentiel, mais nos contenus doivent aussi être compris et cités par les IA génératives (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini, Perplexity…).

  • Collaborer avec les équipes marketing, produit et commerciale pour ajuster la structure et les messages de nos contenus en fonction de ce qui engage et convertit réellement.

Ce que nous offrons :

  • Une expérience internationale dans une entreprise technologique en pleine croissance.

  • Un accompagnement par une équipe expérimentée qui te donnera rapidement de l’autonomie.

  • Une gratification de stage, à hauteur de 200 NOK/heure.

  • Un stage au centre d’Oslo, dans des bureaux modernes, et avec une cantine proposant de délicieux repas en partie pris en charge par l'entreprise.

  • Une ambiance de travail conviviale : kick off à l’étranger en janvier, tournois de ping-pong, afterworks réguliers…

  • Le choix entre un Mac ou un PC pour travailler.

Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu es en dernière année de master en communication, journalisme, marketing ou domaine connexe.

  • Le français est ta langue maternelle, et tu écris avec précision, clarté et une vraie sensibilité pour le lecteur. Tu sais expliquer simplement des sujets parfois techniques.

  • Tu es rigoureux, curieux et tu sais distinguer une source fiable d’une source douteuse.

  • Tu es à l’aise en anglais pour échanger avec le reste des collègues à Oslo.

Intéressé par le stage ?

N’hésite pas à postuler, nous avons hâte de découvrir ta candidature !

Merci de nous faire parvenir ton CV, une lettre de motivation et un exemple d’écrit dont tu es fier (article, mémoire, projet universitaire…).

  • Période de stage : janvier à juin 2027

  • Lieu : Oslo, Norvège

  • Type de contrat : stage conventionné

  • Volume horaire : 35 heures par semaine

  • Date limite de candidature : 20 septembre 2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nettbureau builds online platforms that help people and businesses. For over a decade, we’ve connected users with great deals and suppliers with new customers in over 10 countries through lead generation. Our goal is to give users great deals to compare so they can make informed choices, while helping our suppliers to attract new customers. With recognition by the Financial Times in their list of “Europe’s Long-term Growth Champions” for 2025 and 2026, we’re focusing on sustainability and constantly improving every aspect of our services for our users, businesses and our team.
