jobs.title: Part-time Driver
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Part-Time Drivers to join Oda!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store, and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and every opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistics challenges, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Report directly to our Driver Operating Managers and Team Leaders at your site as an essential part of our dedicated delivery team.

  • Be a Customer Hero: You’ll be on the road bringing groceries and smiles directly to our customers, ensuring a top-notch "Oda experience" at every doorstep.

  • Keep the wheels turning: You’ll handle loading and unloading with speed and care, ensuring every box arrives in perfect condition.

  • Own your ride: You’ll take pride in your van, keeping it clean, presentable, and ready for the road.

  • Pay it forward: You’ll help onboard and train new colleagues, sharing your best tips and tricks from the road.

  • Make us better: We value your brain as much as your driving! You’ll contribute your ideas to help us improve our routines and ways of working.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • A valid driving license (Class B). You’ve had your license for at least 2 years and feel confident and safe behind the wheel.

  • Good communication skills: Comfortable in speaking and writing English. If you also know Norwegian or another Nordic language, that’s a big plus!

What would be nice to have 💡

  • Enjoy being active and thrive in a physically demanding job

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • A strong work ethic and a "can-do" mindset

  • Service-minded and always looking for the best solutions

  • A genuine desire to make our customers happy

  • Responsible and always prioritize safety in traffic


What we offer 🚀

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Part-Time Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


Practical information

  • Application deadline: Apply before 23. september 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidates are found. We encourage you to apply as early as possible

  • Start date: As soon as possible

  • Position: Part-time 20%, Saturday and Sunday, every other weekend.

  • We hire for both morning and evening shifts. Please specify which shift you are interested in when applying.

  • Working hours:

    • Morning shift: 05:45-13:45 or 06.00-14:00

    • Evening shift: 13:00-21:00

  • Location: Drammensveien 189, 3420 Lierskogen


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

We can’t wait to hear from you🧡


To ensure a fair and efficient process for everyone, we use Hubert, our virtual assistant, to help us with the first selection🤖 Keep an eye on your inbox – shortly after applying, you’ll receive an email with an invite to a chat-based interview. Just make sure your email address is correct so the invite finds its way to you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: CEO
jobs.description:
CEO, Seidr Technologies

Seidr builds software that turns months of manual site selection for energy-intensive industrial projects into hours of automated analysis. This is solving a significant bottleneck in a rapidly growing market. We have a signed, paying pilot customer and a growing pipeline across Power-to-X and data center developers in the Nordics and Germany. Read more about what we do on our company profile.


The role

We're looking for a CEO to lead Seidr forward and be the face of the company to investors, customers and partners. You'll own recruiting and team-building together with our venture studio REspire and our CTO Aman, and take on the full range of responsibilities that come with leading an early-stage startup.

Aman leads product and engineering, and we'll be growing the tech team further over time. Your main day-to-day focus will be commercial: direct, outbound sales to developers of energy-intensive projects, alongside shaping the business model and pricing as we move from pilot to scale.


What we're looking for

Above all, someone who wants to build a startup and understands what that actually takes: grit, resourcefulness, and the ability to move fast with limited resources. Previous startup experience is a strong signal of this, but not the only way to show it.

You should have solid experience in business development and B2B sales. Experience from data center development, or development of other power-intensive industry (Power-to-X, renewables, heavy industry), is a strong plus.


Location & setup

We'd prefer someone based in Norway who can work from our office in Asker, but we're open to strong candidates based elsewhere. We're also open to starting part-time and ramping up as the company grows.


A note on stage and risk

This is a pre-seed startup, not a conventional job. Until we close funding, which you'll be directly involved in raising, there is no fixed salary. We're open to pragmatic solutions along the way, such as a part-time period, but you should go into this with your eyes open and a genuine appetite for that kind of risk.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Seidr builds software that turns months of manual site selection and early-phase engineering work into hours of automated analysis, for developers of energy-intensive industrial projects: Power-to-X, data centers, and other power-hungry industries across Europe. Today, finding and qualifying a site for one of these projects takes 6-18 months and can cost millions, because the work is done manually, spreadsheet by spreadsheet, consultant by consultant, one candidate site at a time. Critical blockers, such as insufficient grid capacity or zoning conflicts, often surface only after months of work, when changing course is expensive. Seidr automates this. Our platform screens candidate sites in parallel against dozens of criteria, including grid capacity, current and future zoning, and environmental risk, and returns a ranked, decision-ready shortlist in hours instead of months. The underlying logic is built on real industrial project experience, not generic AI. We already have a signed, paying pilot customer and a growing pipeline of Power-to-X and data center developers across the Nordics and Germany. Backed by a venture studio, we are now looking for a CEO to take Seidr from pilot to scale, and to grow the platform from site selection into the full early-phase planning stack for energy-intensive projects.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Six Robotics

At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible.

From our base in Oslo, our team of 90+ engineers, researchers, and defence specialists develops our autonomy and swarm platform, used by both government and industry. Working closely with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI) and end users, we move quickly from ideas to field deployment, solving problems where software meets the real world.

The challenges we work on don't come with existing playbooks. They demand deep technical thinking, close collaboration across disciplines, and the ability to learn quickly as both the technology and the company evolve.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. If you're excited about building systems that matter and growing alongside talented people that push boundaries every day, you'll find no better place to deliver real-world impact.

About The Role

Six Robotics is scaling its commercial engine to match the scale of our ambitions. We are looking for a high-impact Strategic Account Executive to turn qualified opportunities into strategically important customer wins across an expanding international footprint. This is a senior role for a seller who thrives on complex pursuits, takes personal ownership of the outcome, and knows how to bring the right people together to get a deal over the line.

Working alongside our Business Developer and leadership team, you will own a portfolio of high-priority opportunities from qualification through contract signature and expansion. You will create the capture strategy, build trust with decision-makers and end users, and mobilise colleagues across product, engineering, delivery, security, and leadership to meet customer needs and remove obstacles. You will be accountable for progressing your pipeline and closing against a clear quarterly operating cadence, while understanding that the most meaningful defence programmes require patience, credibility, and sustained engagement.

This is a land-and-expand role, not a role where you hand an opportunity off once the initial contract is signed. You will lead the commercial process to close: shaping the value case, managing stakeholders, navigating procurement, building internal alignment, maintaining momentum through negotiation and signature - and remain the primary commercial owner of the relationship. You will deepen customer trust, identify follow-on opportunities, and help turn successful deployments into larger, longer-term partnerships.

As an early sales hire, you will help establish the pursuit practices, account-growth approach, and commercial operating model that enable Six Robotics to scale. We expect strong personal ownership of strategic deal outcomes from day one, while formal sales processes, quotas, and incentive structures are developed as the function matures.

Success after six months looks like a well-qualified, accurately forecast pipeline of strategic pursuits; clear account and stakeholder plans for priority deals; and demonstrable momentum toward signed contracts. You will have earned the confidence of customers and colleagues alike as the person who moves critical opportunities forward.

What You Will Do

  • Own a defined portfolio of strategic accounts, programmes, and opportunities, and build a clear, actionable pipeline around them

  • Lead the full sales cycle from qualified opportunity and discovery through value definition, proposal, negotiation, contracting, close, and expansion

  • Build and execute capture plans for priority deals, including account strategy, stakeholder mapping, decision process, competitive position, and clear next steps

  • Mobilise and lead cross-functional capture teams, drawing in the right technical, product, delivery, security, and leadership resources at the right time

  • Develop trusted relationships with decision-makers, procurement stakeholders, end users, and relevant partners - from operators to senior defence leadership

  • Navigate defence procurement processes, tenders, and partner ecosystems while maintaining commercial discipline and deal momentum

  • Maintain accurate pipeline and opportunity reporting; communicate risks, decisions, and resource needs clearly to leadership

  • Represent Six Robotics in high-value customer meetings, demonstrations, industry events, and negotiations

  • Help build the repeatable sales practices and internal collaboration model needed to scale a world-class commercial organisation

What we are looking for

We believe the right candidate brings

We're looking for a commercially rigorous, mission-driven seller who has repeatedly carried a quota and personally closed complex deals. You combine the urgency and ownership of a high-performing enterprise seller with the patience and judgement required in defence. You know that closing is a team sport: you take responsibility for creating momentum, bringing the right internal people into the pursuit, and doing the extra work required to land the deal.

You are comfortable operating in an environment where processes are still being built. Rather than waiting for a stage gate or a hand-off, you create clarity, make sound decisions, and move the pursuit forward. You are energised by time with customers and partners, and should expect to travel frequently - up to 50%+ during peak periods - to build the relationships that matter.

Must-have qualifications:

  • 5-10 years of successful B2B, enterprise, or strategic sales experience, including multiple years carrying a new-business quota and closing complex deals

  • Demonstrable track record of winning material contracts through a disciplined sales process - not solely generating leads, managing partners, or supporting bids

  • Experience selling into defence, national security, aerospace, or another complex regulated environment

  • Ability to lead multi-stakeholder pursuits involving senior customer executives, technical users, procurement, legal, and delivery teams

  • Strong commercial judgement, including qualification, deal strategy, forecasting, negotiation, and contract close

  • An established network in relevant defence circles, or the ability to build trusted senior relationships quickly


The Persona we are looking for:

  • Intrinsically motivated, resilient, and accountable; you take ownership of deal outcomes and find a way through obstacles

  • A proactive deal leader who can influence without authority and coordinate diverse internal teams around a shared commercial outcome

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to impose structure, pace, and focus on complex, evolving pursuits

  • Credible and composed with both operational end users and senior decision-makers

  • Motivated to join a fast-paced scale-up, take ownership of strategically important accounts, and build something from an early stage

Nice to have:

  • A background in the military, including officer training or equivalent, is a strong plus

  • Experience with NATO, Nordic, or major European defence markets and procurement environments

  • Experience selling autonomy, robotics, software, AI, or other technically sophisticated capabilities

  • An academic background is not a requirement, but may be beneficial. In this industry, experience, judgement, and credibility outweigh formal education

Personal fit matters just as much as the CV. We're looking for a specific type of person. Someone with the right instincts, credibility, and presence to operate in this environment, so personal suitability will weigh heavily in our assessment.

Why You Should Join

Build at the edge of what's possible: You'll work on problems the industry hasn't solved yet, alongside people who are pushing the boundaries of autonomy, AI, and robotics.

Grow as fast as the company: We believe that chance favours those in motion. The role you're hired into is just the starting point. As Six Robotics evolves, so will your scope, your responsibilities, and your opportunities. Deliver results, and you'll be building and leading your own team.

Work with exceptional people: Surround yourself with people who raise your own standards. You'll join a team of ambitious engineers and operators who care deeply about the quality of their work. Expectations are high, but so is the willingness to help each other improve.

Ship work that matters: The things you sell don't stay in a demo environment. They get deployed, tested, and used where reliability and performance genuinely matter.

Supported by great benefits: Alongside meaningful work, we offer competitive compensation, equity potential, strong pension and insurance plans, gadget budgets, modern equipment, panoramic offices, and the flexibility you need to do your best work.

Our Recruitment Process

We want hiring to be transparent and respectful of your time. We aim to move with momentum while making thoughtful hiring decisions - because every new team member matters.

Our process typically includes:

  • Initial phone screening (30 min): A conversation about your background, motivation, and the role.

  • First interview (45 min): Meet the hiring team, learn more about Six Robotics, and discuss your experience.

  • Second interview (60-90 min): A deeper discussion on your sales approach, typically including a case presentation.

  • Final interview (45 min): Meet members of our leadership team to align expectations and answer any remaining questions.

Reference checks are conducted before an offer is finalized. We review applications continuously, so don't leave us hanging. Send us your application today!

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Six Robotics, we are committed to creating a workplace built on respect, integrity, and collaboration. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we believe that diversity within our team strengthens both our work and our culture. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and help us build technology that makes a real impact.

Security Clearance Requirement

All employees at Six Robotics must be eligible for security clearance. Some roles might require a high level of clearance, depending on the nature of the work. If you are hired, we'll guide you through any required authorization or clearance process as part of your onboarding. Previous authorization or clearance is not required, but all candidates must be eligible to obtain the necessary approvals if required for their role.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We exist to strengthen defence, protect nations, and deter conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. Our mission is to multiply operational capabilities, accelerate the transition to robotic warfare, and give NATO and our allies a decisive advantage in the new era of unmanned operations. We overcome the limits of current systems with collaborative swarm autonomy, enabling unmanned systems to act as one. Our software lets drones collaborate, adapt, and execute missions as a team, allowing a single operator to control an army of robots, accelerate decisions, and multiply combat effectiveness.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Industrial Operations
jobs.description:
Help Shape the Future of Industrial Operations

At Falkor, we develop software solutions that help some of the world's most complex industrial organizations operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably.

Our Digital Twin platform, Falkor, connects data, systems, processes, and people to provide a unified operational view of industrial assets and operations. Customers across Energy, Process Industries, Manufacturing, Maritime, and Infrastructure use our technology to improve decision-making, increase efficiency, and drive operational excellence.

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to drive the strategy, roadmap, and growth of our Industrial Operations solutions within the Industrial Work Surface (IWS) team.

The Opportunity

As Product Manager – Industrial Operations, you will work at the intersection of technology, industrial operations, and customer needs.

Industrial Operations is the day-to-day execution and optimization of industrial facilities such as offshore platforms, refineries, power plants, manufacturing sites, and process industries. It involves monitoring performance, managing production, coordinating operational activities, responding to deviations, and making decisions that maximize safety, reliability, efficiency, and output.

For Falkor's Industrial Work Surface, Industrial Operations typically includes:

  • Performance monitoring

  • Production optimization

  • Operator workflows

  • Shift handovers and reporting

  • Operational task execution

  • Alarm and event management

  • Decision support

  • Digital work processes

  • AI-assisted operational insights

You will collaborate closely with customers, engineers, designers, and domain experts to develop solutions that help industrial organizations improve operational performance, streamline workflows, increase visibility, and make better decisions.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of Digital Twin and Industrial AI solutions while delivering products used by leading industrial companies worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Industrial Operations solutions.

  • Engage directly with customers to understand operational challenges and identify opportunities for innovation.

  • Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and priorities.

  • Work closely with engineering, design, and domain teams to deliver high-quality software products.

  • Lead product discovery, validation, and continuous improvement activities.

  • Analyze customer feedback, market trends, and product performance data to guide decision-making.

  • Support go-to-market initiatives, customer engagements, and product launches.

  • Ensure products deliver measurable customer value and outstanding user experiences.

QualificationsRequired

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or similar product leadership roles.

  • Proven track record of delivering successful B2B software products from concept through launch and growth.

  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Experience working in Agile product development environments.

  • Ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and technical considerations.

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related field.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Preferred

  • MSc or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

  • Experience within Energy, Oil & Gas, Renewables, Manufacturing, Chemicals, or Process Industries.

  • Experience with Digital Twins, Industrial IoT, Asset Performance Management, Operational Technology (OT), MES, or industrial software platforms.

  • Experience applying analytics, AI, or data-driven decision-support technologies in industrial environments.

Who You Are

  • Passionate about building products that solve real-world customer problems.

  • Customer-focused and comfortable working directly with users and stakeholders.

  • Curious, analytical, and driven by measurable outcomes.

  • Able to simplify complex challenges and translate them into practical product solutions.

  • Collaborative and comfortable working across multidisciplinary teams.

Why Join Falkor?

  • Shape the next generation of Digital Twin and Industrial AI solutions.

  • Build products used by leading industrial companies around the world.

  • Work on meaningful challenges that improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability.

  • Join a highly skilled, international, and collaborative team.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Flexible hybrid working model.

  • Modern offices located in Lysaker, Norway.

  • Excellent opportunities for professional growth and development.

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about product management, industrial technology, and delivering solutions that make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Falkor is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute.

At Kongsberg Digital, our mission is to transform the world’s most complex and asset-intensive industries through world-leading, AI-powered digital twin technology. As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. With domain expertise baked into every line of code and a high-calibre team united by a clear mission, we’re not just keeping pace with change—we’re setting the standard. As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Developer
jobs.description:
Full-Stack Software Developer

Oslo preferred | Remote possible for exceptional candidates | Full-time | Start as soon as possible

Perlo is building project intelligence for property developers.

Real estate development teams still run some of their most important processes across Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, meetings and disconnected systems. Perlo brings that work into one place and helps project teams understand where they are, what requires attention and what they should do next.

We're a small, fast-moving team and are looking for a Full-Stack Software Developer who can take real ownership of the product.

This is not a role where you'll receive perfectly specified Jira tickets and implement them one by one.

You'll often get a problem, user need or desired outcome and be expected to understand it, propose a solution and ship it.

What you'll work on

You'll work across the Perlo product, including:

  • Building new product functionality from idea to production

  • Improving existing workflows and user experience

  • Working with project data, dashboards, reporting and AI-powered functionality

  • Designing database changes and backend logic

  • Building responsive interfaces in React / Next.js

  • Deploying and monitoring what you build

  • Fixing bugs and making pragmatic technical decisions

  • Using AI development tools extensively to move fast

Our current stack includes:

Next.js, React, TypeScript / JavaScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, TanStack, Tailwind CSS, Git, Git worktrees, Vercel and Claude Code.

You don't need to have worked professionally with every technology in the stack. We care much more about whether you can understand an existing codebase, solve problems and ship.

Who we're looking for

The most important thing is that you're autonomous.

You should be comfortable receiving direction like:

“Customers need a better way to understand what's changing across their projects.”

…and then working out what needs to happen technically to solve it.

You'll work closely with our CEO and the rest of the team, so you need to be able to translate non-technical product and business requirements into good technical solutions.

You are probably a good fit if you:

  • Can independently take a feature from problem → solution → production

  • Are comfortable making decisions when requirements aren't perfect

  • Ask good questions instead of waiting for detailed specifications

  • Are proactive and communicate clearly

  • Have solid JavaScript / TypeScript and web development fundamentals

  • Understand databases and relational data

  • Are comfortable working in an existing codebase

  • Use AI coding tools effectively rather than treating them as autocomplete

  • Care about shipping useful software, not engineering for engineering's sake

Experience with our exact stack is a bonus, not a requirement.

Location

We are based in Oslo, and we'd ideally like someone who can work with us in person at least some of the time.

That said, we are open to remote candidates if you're exceptionally strong, highly autonomous and a great fit for the way we work.

Why Perlo

We're still a small company, which means your work will have a very visible impact.

You'll get:

  • Significant ownership over a real production product

  • Direct access to customers and the problems we're solving

  • The ability to influence product and technical decisions

  • Very little bureaucracy

  • An AI-native development workflow

  • The opportunity to help shape the technical foundation of a growing B2B SaaS company

If you're the kind of developer who likes being given responsibility rather than tickets, we'd like to hear from you.

How to apply

Send us:

  1. A short introduction

  2. Your CV or LinkedIn

  3. Your GitHub, portfolio or something you've built, if you have one

  4. A few sentences about a product or feature you've built where you had significant ownership

We care much more about what you can do than writing a perfect application.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Perlo is building project intelligence for property developers. We help real estate development teams replace fragmented workflows across Excel, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint with one platform for project delivery, reporting and proactive decision-making. Perlo gives teams a clearer view of where projects stand, what requires attention, and what they should do next.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Advancing Corrosion Science Through AI and High-Throughput Experimentation
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. Joining a newly formed research group will further provide you with the opportunity to become part of a growing team and contribute to an exciting new environment with plenty of new research opportunities.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

Corrosion represents a major economic burden, costing modern economies roughly 4% of their annual GDP. In Norway, this loss is estimated to be twice the total profits of the entire agricultural sector. Despite this importance, corrosion research remains dominated by case-specific studies and expert-driven intuition. This project aims to close that gap by generating, extracting and measuring corrosion data into a unified knowledge base. On the digital side, the project will employ natural language processing and AI-driven data extraction to automatically harvest corrosion data from the scientific literature. On the experimental side, it will design and refine electrochemical setups for rapid screening of corrosion rates. Given an existing interest for the university, the work will focus particularly on the electrochemical corrosion of alloys relevant to carbon capture and storage applications.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework as described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the newly formed research group of Corrosion and Corrosion Protection
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences, workshops and discussions

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in mechanical and industrial engineering, chemical engineering, chemistry, and materials science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Sound interest in either materials science, electrochemistry or the use of artificial intelligence in an engineering context
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Good analytical and computational capabilities, through course information or thesis deliverables in the application
  • Skilled in either computational modelling or experimentation, paired with the willingness to work on both

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Be friendly and open-minded
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Michael Auinger, e-mail: michael.auinger@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 14.10.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.


Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering

We educate graduates who can create new products, operate and maintain products, and manage projects. The Department has a variety of bachelor’s and master’s degree programmes. We conduct wide-ranging research in fields such as technology, energy, product quality and development, and productivity. The Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering is one of eight departments in the Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Sjukepleiar/spesialsjukepleiar
jobs.employer: HELSE MØRE OG ROMSDAL HF ÅLESUND SJUKEHUS - SOMATIKK
jobs.description:
Er du sjukepleiaren som vil gjere ein forskjell for pasientar med nyresjukdom?

Dialyseavdelinga ved Ålesund sjukehus har ledig 100 % fast stilling, og vi ønskjer å styrkje vårt dyktige fagmiljø med ein engasjert sjukepleiar/spesialsjukepleiar.
Hos oss får du arbeide tett med pasientar med både kronisk og akutt nyresjukdom i eit spesialisert fagfelt der relasjonsbygging, fagleg utvikling og tverrfagleg samarbeid står sentralt. Vi er stolte av å ha eit sterkt fagmiljø med pasienten i sentrum, og vi legg til rette for opplæring og kompetanseutvikling.

Dialyseavdelinga i Ålesund tilbyr behandling og oppfølging til pasientar med nyresjukdom. I tilknyting til avdelinga finn du:

  • Peritonealdialyseeining
  • Satellittdialysestasjon ved Volda sjukehus
  • Nyrepoliklinikk
  • Nyreskule

Vi er ei dagavdeling som for tida har drift seks dagar i veka, frå måndag til laurdag. Stillinga inneber for tida:

  • Arbeid kvar tredje helg
  • Opptil 2 kveldsvakter i veka
  • Telefonberedskap/heimevakt etter oppsett turnus

Kvifor velje oss?
Hos oss blir du ein del av eit inkluderande og fagleg sterkt arbeidsmiljø der vi støttar kvarandre og arbeider saman for å gi best mogleg behandling og oppfølging til pasientane våre. Du får varierte arbeidsdagar, spennande faglege utfordringar og gode moglegheiter for utvikling innan nyresjukepleie.

Interne omrokkeringar kan også føre til andre ledige stillingar eller vikariat.

Vi håpar nettopp du vil bli ein del av vårt flotte dialyseteam!

Har du spørsmål om stillinga, er du velkomen til å ta kontakt.
Vi ber om at attestar og vitnemål blir skanna og lasta opp som vedlegg til søknaden/CV-en din.


Arbeidsoppgåver

Hos oss får du ein variert arbeidskvardag der du kombinerer avansert medisinsk behandling med tett pasientoppfølging. Du blir ein del av eit kompetent og inkluderande fagmiljø som er opptekne av utvikling, kvalitet og samarbeid.

  • Utøve heilskapleg sjukepleie til pasientar med kronisk og akutt nyresjukdom.
  • Kartlegge, observere, iverksetje tiltak og følgje opp pasientane gjennom heile behandlingsforløpet.
  • Gi dialysebehandling og bidra til trygg og kvalitetsmessig god pasientoppfølging.
  • Delta aktivt i tverrfagleg samarbeid rundt pasientane.
  • Følgje opp medisinske ordinasjonar og behandlingstiltak.
  • Observere og handtere akutte situasjonar, samt iverksetje nødvendige tiltak ved behov.
  • Bidra til undervisning, rettleiing og motivasjon slik at pasientane kan meistre eigen sjukdom og behandling best mogleg.
  • Samarbeide med kommunale tenester og andre relevante samarbeidspartnarar for å sikre gode pasientforløp.
  • Delta i fagutvikling, kvalitetsarbeid og kontinuerleg forbetringsarbeid i avdelinga.
  • Bidra til eit godt arbeidsmiljø og vere ein aktiv pådrivar for utvikling, endring og fornying.
Kvalifikasjonar

Manglar du erfaring frå dialyse, men har interesse for fagfeltet og ønskje om å utvikle deg innan nyresjukepleie? Då oppmodar vi deg likevel til å søkje. Vi legg til rette for god opplæring og fagleg utvikling.

  • Norsk autorisasjon som sjukepleiar.
  • Erfaring frå arbeid med pasientar med kroniske nyresjukdommar er ønskjeleg.
  • Erfaring frå dialysebehandling og/eller vidareutdanning innan dialysesjukepleie vil bli vektlagt.
  • God digital kompetanse og kjennskap til elektroniske dokumentasjonssystem.
  • Erfaring med Helseplattformen er ønskjeleg.
  • Gode norskkunnskapar, både munnleg og skriftleg.
Personlege eigenskapar

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er positiv, engasjert og tek initiativ i arbeidskvardagen.
  • Bidreg til eit godt arbeidsmiljø gjennom samarbeid, respekt og godt humør.
  • Har svært gode kommunikasjonsevner, både munnleg og skriftleg.
  • Er fleksibel, løysingsorientert og trivst i ein variert arbeidskvardag.
  • Har fagleg interesse og ønskjer å utvikle kompetansen din innan nyresjukepleie.
  • Er trygg i møte med medisinsk teknisk utstyr og har gode digitale ferdigheiter.
  • Har pasienten i fokus og arbeider for å skape tryggleik, meistring og kvalitet i behandlinga.
  • Kan arbeide både sjølvstendig og i tett samarbeid med kollegaer og andre faggrupper.
  • Evnar å handtere endringar og bidra aktivt til utvikling og forbetring.

Personleg eignaheit vil bli vektlagt

Vi tilbyr
  • Eit solid og utviklande fagmiljø med høg kompetanse innan nyresjukepleie og dialysebehandling.
  • Eit tett og godt tverrfagleg samarbeid med fokus på kvalitet i pasientbehandlinga.
  • Ein inkluderande arbeidsplass med engasjerte kollegaer og godt humør.
  • Ein arbeidskvardag prega av fagleg utvikling, læring og spennande utfordringar.
  • Gunstig turnus med helsefremjande vaktordning.
  • Fokus på trivsel, nærvær og eit godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Løn i samsvar med gjeldande overeinskomstar.
  • Medlemskap i offentleg pensjonsordning og gode forsikringsordningar.
  • God opplæring og støtte frå erfarne kollegaer.
  • Moglegheiter for fagleg utvikling og kompetanseheving.

Hos oss blir du ein del av eit samansveisa team som kombinerer høg fagkompetanse med omsorg, samarbeid og arbeidsglede. Vi ønskjer at medarbeidarane våre skal trivast, utvikle seg og kjenne stoltheit over jobben dei gjer kvar dag.

Ålesund er kåra til den vakraste byen i Norge. Ålesund sin vakre Jugendstilarkitektur er viden kjent. Eit mangfald av tårn, spir og vakre utsmykkingar er som teken ut av eit eventyr. Byen og omlandet har eit særs rikt kultur- og konsertliv med nasjonale og internasjonale artistar. Du kan og oppleve eit mangfold av fjordar, øyar og fjell som ventar på å få begeistre deg. Les meir her!

KontaktinformasjonLise Grytten Blindheim, Seksjonsleiar, 70 10 63 15, Lise.Grytten@helse-mr.no
ArbeidsstadÅsehaugen 5
6017 Ålesund

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vil du gjere ein forskjell? Vi i Helse Møre og Romsdal (HMR) gir spesialisthelsetenester til alle innbyggjarane i fylket. Med våre omlag 6500 tilsette er vi ein skapande og nytenkande organisasjon som kvar dag står på for at pasientane skal få best mogleg helsetenester. Vi har ei leiande rolle innan forsking og utdanning, og har sterke fagmiljø knytt til teknisk drift, økonomi og HR. Akuttsjukehusa i HMR er i Volda, Ålesund, og på Hjelset i Molde kommune. I SNR Kristiansund vert det vidare eit breidt spesialisthelsetenestetilbod med poliklinikk, dagbehandling og dagkirurgi. I tillegg har vi behandlingsinstitusjonar innan psykisk helsevern og rusbehandling. Det vert lagt til rette for gode og inkluderande arbeidsmiljø prega av openheit og respekt. Vi vil at våre tilsette skal spegle mangfaldet i befolkninga. Difor oppmodar vi alle som er kvalifiserte til å søkje hos oss, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonshemming, nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn. Det same gjeld om du har hatt eit lengre opphald i arbeidslivet. Helse Møre og Romsdal er underlagt offentleglova. Vi arbeidar for meiroffentlegheit, og søkarlista til stillinga kan bli offentleggjort. Ein kan be om unntak frå offentleg søkarliste. Unntak skal grunngjevast frå søkar si side. Arbeidsgivar vil vurdere ei slik oppmoding, og søkar vert kontakta om oppmodinga ikkje vert tatt til følgje.


Uansett kva stilling du vert tilsett i, så skal vi bidra til at du får utvikle deg og kompetansen din. Bli med på laget! For meir informasjon om helseføretaket, sjå Helse Møre og Romsdal

jobs.title: Førsteamanuensis innen Regnskap og økonomistyring
jobs.employer: NORGES MILJØ- OG BIOVITENSKAPELIGE UNIVERSITET (NMBU) CAMPUS ÅS
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

NMBUs Handelshøyskole inviterer til søknader på en fast stilling som førsteamanuensis innen regnskap og økonomistyring.

Vi søker en kandidat med sterk akademisk kompetanse innen regnskap, virksomhetsstyring eller beslektede fagområder, og med interesse for å anvende forskningsbasert kunnskap i organisatoriske beslutningsprosesser, rapportering, styring og resultatoppfølging. Relevante fagområder kan blant annet være finansregnskap, driftsregnskap, virksomhetsstyring, selskapsrapportering, bærekraftsrapportering, revisjon, resultatmåling og forretningsanalyse.

Den som ansettes, forventes å bidra aktivt til forskning, undervisning og veiledning på bachelor-, master- og ph.d.-nivå. Stillingen innebærer ansvar for å utvikle og undervise i emner innen regnskap, virksomhetsstyring og beslektede fagområder, veilede studentoppgaver, publisere i anerkjente vitenskapelige tidsskrifter og bidra til eksternt finansierte forskningsprosjekter. 

Kandidaten forventes også å delta i den faglige utviklingen av Handelshøyskolens studieprogrammer, nettbaserte undervisningstilbud og forskningsmiljø.

Som en AACSB-akkreditert handelshøyskole tilbyr vi et dynamisk og tverrfaglig akademisk miljø med forskning og utdanning innen økonomi, bedriftsøkonomi, innovasjon, entreprenørskap og bioøkonomi. Vi søker en kollega som kan bidra til å styrke vår faglige profil innen regnskap og virksomhetsstyring og til å utvikle forskningsbasert utdanning. Den som ansettes, bør kunne bidra til å forberede studentene på å analysere, lede og utvikle organisasjoner i et samfunn i endring.


Arbeidsoppgaver

De viktigste arbeidsoppgavene i stillingen er å:

  • Drive forskning av høy kvalitet innen regnskap, økonomistyring eller beslektede fagområder, og publisere jevnlig i fagfellevurderte vitenskapelige tidsskrifter.
  • Undervise i og utvikle emner innen regnskap, virksomhetsstyring og beslektede fagområder på tvers av Handelshøyskolens studieprogrammer, inkludert relevante nettbaserte emner.
  • Veilede bachelor-, master- og ph.d.-studenter, herunder veilede oppgaver innen temaer knyttet til regnskap, rapportering, virksomhetsstyring, eierstyring og selskapsledelse samt forretningsanalyse.
  • Bidra til den videre utviklingen av Handelshøyskolens undervisnings- og forskningsmiljø innen regnskap, virksomhetsstyring og bedriftsøkonomi.
  • Søke om og bidra i eksternt finansierte forskningsprosjekter, inkludert tverrfaglige prosjekter som er relevante for NMBU sine faglige profil.
  • Samarbeide med næringslivet, offentlige virksomheter, profesjonelle organisasjoner og andre eksterne aktører.
  • Bidra til administrative oppgaver og andre fellesaktiviteter ved Handelshøyskolen sammen med kolleger og studenter.

Kompetanse

Alle kvalifikasjonene nedenfor er krav for stillingen, med mindre det er spesifisert at de anses som en fordel.

Kvalifikasjoner som kreves

Søkeren må ha:

  • Doktorgrad (ph.d.) innen regnskap, virksomhetsstyring, bedriftsøkonomi eller et nært beslektet fagområde som er relevant for stillingen, eller tilsvarende kompetanse dokumentert gjennom akademisk arbeid av samme omfang og kvalitet.
  • Dokumentert forskningskompetanse og publiseringer innen regnskap, virksomhetsstyring, bedriftsøkonomi eller andre relevante fagområder.
  • Utdanningsfaglig kompetanse i samsvar med NMBU sine krav til førsteamanuensis. Eventuell manglende utdanningsfaglig kompetanse må opparbeides innen to år etter ansettelse.
  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige kommunikasjonsevner på norsk eller et annet skandinavisk språk, samt på engelsk.

Kvalifikasjoner som anses som en fordel

  • Erfaring med empirisk og tverrfaglig forskning, samt eksternt finansierte forskningsprosjekter eller forskningssamarbeid.
  • Erfaring med utvikling av emner og studieprogrammer, studentaktiv læring, nettbasert undervisning og undervisning på tvers av studieprogrammer innen bedriftsøkonomi.
  • Erfaring med forskningsformidling og samarbeid med næringslivet, offentlige virksomheter, profesjonelle organisasjoner eller andre eksterne aktører.
  • Erfaring med akademisk administrasjon eller institusjonell utvikling.

Lønns- og tilsettingsvilkår og nærmere opplysninger

Stillingen er plassert i stillingskode 1011 Førsteamanuensis, med en årslønn på 720 000– 920 000 kroner, avhengig av kvalifikasjoner. For særlig godt kvalifiserte søkere kan høyere lønn vurderes. Det gis opprykk etter ansiennitet i stillingen og spesielt kvalifiserte søkere kan søke om professoropprykk etter 3 måneder i stillingen.

NMBU ønsker flere kvinner i faste vitenskapelige stillinger. Kvinner oppfordres derfor til å søke.

Interessert i å vite mer om stillingen? Vi forteller gjerne mer om livet på campus. Ta kontakt med prodekan Mette Wik, tlf. +47 959 19 287, e-post: mette.wik@nmbu.no.

Generell informasjon til søkere


Slik søker du:

Send søknaden elektronisk via lenken «Søk stillingen» øverst på denne siden. 

Søknadsfrist: 10. oktober 2026

Din CV må legges inn i Jobbnorges CV-skjema og ikke bare legges med som vedlegg. Dette for å kunne innfri forskrift til forvaltningsloven §15. 

Se denne siden for mer informasjon om hvordan du kan dokumentere dine kvalifikasjoner og skrive refleksjonsnotat.

Dokumenter som ikke kan sendes elektronisk sendes i tre eksemplarer med ordinær post merket 1101 Førsteamanuensis (26/07438) til NMBU, Fakultet for Handelshøyskolen, postboks 5003, NO-1432 Ås, innen 10.10.2026.

Dette skal med i søknaden:

  • Kort søknadstekst om din motivasjon
  • Refleksjonsnotat (3-6 sider) som omhandler dine refleksjoner omkring stillingens krav 1-5 (se utlysningstekst)
  • Akademisk CV, vitnemål og attester
  • Utfylt skjema for dokumentasjon av kompetanse, lenke til mal her.
  • Publikasjonsliste. Legg ved inntil 15 vitenskapelige arbeider som etter vurdering er sentrale i produksjonen. Dersom det i fellesarbeid er vanskelig å identifisere personlig innsats, må det legges ved en kort redegjørelse om din del av arbeidet.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at rapporten fra sakkyndig komite vil bli sendt til alle søkere.


Om Handelshøyskolen

Handelshøyskolen ved NMBU utdanner siviløkonomer, samfunnsøkonomer og masterkandidater i entreprenørskap og innovasjon, samt bioøkonomi. Fakultetet har også et eget PhD-program. Vi har ca. 800 bachelor- og masterstudenter, og ca. 40 doktorgradsstudenter. Det er omkring 2000 studenter på den nettbaserte årsenheten i bærekraftig økonomi og ledelse.

Handelshøyskolen har en betydelig forskningsaktivitet på en rekke temaområder, inkludert foretaksøkonomi, skatt, entreprenørskap og innovasjon, miljø, klima, energi, og filosofi. Handelshøyskolen har ca. 60 heltidsansatte og ligger på Campus Ås.

Handelshøyskolen fikk AACSB-akkreditering i 2025, et internasjonalt kvalitetsstempel som plasserer Handelshøyskolen NMBU blant verdens fremste handelshøyskoler.

For mer informasjon, se: www.nmbu.no/hh


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NMBU skal bidra til å sikre fremtidens livsgrunnlag gjennom fremragende forskning, utdanning, formidling og innovasjon. Vi har landets mest fornøyde universitetsstudenter, som får forskningsbasert utdanning i et unikt studentmiljø. Våre kandidater får med seg høy kompetanse på tverrfaglig samarbeid og er populære i arbeidsmarkedet.

NMBU har internasjonalt ledende forskningsmiljøer innen flere fag. Sammen med våre partnere i samfunns- og næringslivet bidrar vi til å løse noen av de største samfunnsutfordringene i vår tid. Vi satser på innovasjon, formidling og entreprenørskap fordi vi mener disse utfordringene best løses med felles innsats.

Vi mener at et godt arbeidsmiljø preges av mangfold. Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av kjønn, funksjonsevne, kulturell bakgrunn eller om du har vært utenfor arbeidslivet en periode. Vi vil legge arbeidsplassen til rette for personer med nedsatt funksjonsevne.

Nærmere opplysninger om NMBU finnes på www.nmbu.no

jobs.title: Vi søker Butikkmedarbeider, deltid til REMA 1000 Førde!
jobs.description:
Ønsker du en variert og aktiv deltidsjobb hvor du får skape gode handleopplevelser? 🤩

Hos oss handler det om mer enn å fylle hyllene. Vi leter etter deg som ønsker å være en viktig del av hverdagen til kundene våre – noen som møter dem med et smil, hjelper når de trenger det, og sørger for at butikken vår alltid føles som et hyggelig sted å handle.

Hva får du jobbe med? ✨

Som butikkmedarbeider får du en aktiv arbeidsdag der du bidrar med alt fra å fylle på varer og sitte i kassa til å ta imot leveranser og sørge for at butikken ser innbydende ut. Men det stopper ikke der. Du er også den som hilser kunden velkommen, gir dem en god avskjed, og tar initiativ til å hjelpe – enten det er å finne en vare, bytte noe de ikke var fornøyd med, eller gi anbefalinger med et smil.

Hvem ser vi etter? 🔍

Er på jakt etter deg som kan jobbe 4-5 dager i uken, men også skoleelever som kan jobbe 1-2 dager i uken. 

Vi ser etter deg som brenner for god service og trives i møte med mennesker. Du er den som får ting gjort, som liker et hektisk tempo, og som alltid har kunden i fokus. I tillegg:

  • Er du positiv og offensiv, og bidrar til engasjement og trivsel på jobb
  • Trives du med å jobbe både selvstendig og som en del av et team
  • Liker systemdrift og å følge rutiner, og har et øye for detaljer
  • Tar ansvar, er ærlig og til å stole på
  • Er god til å kommunisere i møte med kundene våre på en hyggelig og profesjonell måte
  • Har tempo og effektivitet
  • Har fylt 18 år

Hvorfor velge REMA 1000? 💙

I REMA 1000 er mulighetene mange for mennesker som tør å gi av seg selv, er positive og selvstendige. Hos oss er det plass til alle – mangfold gjør oss sterkere. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg og gleder oss til å ønske deg velkommen som en del av teamet vårt.

Hos oss får du:

  • En trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kollegaer
  • Muligheter for utvikling
  • Et miljø hvor du får støtten du trenger til å lykkes i rollen din
  • Variasjon og energi i hverdagen – ingen dager er helt like!

Les mer på oss på vår karriereside: https://www.rema.no/karriere/

Høres dette ut som jobben for deg? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg 👋

Om rekrutteringsprosessen: 

I våre rekrutteringsprosesser benytter vi oss av testverktøy for å kunne bli bedre kjent med deg. Aktuelle kandidater vil motta e-post med link til testene kort tid etter innsendt søknad. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

REMA 1000 er blant Norges største dagligvareaktør og en av landets sterkeste merkevarer. Siden 1979 har REMA 1000 jobbet for å kunne tilby kunder over hele landet et godt utvalg av dagligvarer til laveste pris, av høy kvalitet, produsert og solgt på en ansvarlig måte. Ved å ha hyggelige og dyktige mennesker med riktige holdninger og fokus på å jobbe med de rette tingene, har REMA 1000 lykkes med å skape en solid virksomhet som er lønnsom ikke bare for sine kjøpmenn og for bedriften - men også for kundene.
Ønsker du å lese mer om vårt arbeid med miljø og samfunnsansvar; https://www.rema.no/ansvar-i-rema-1000/

jobs.description:
Vi søker helsefagarbeider/ student helsefag til hjemmesykepleien på distrikt Bekkestua, både nyutdannede og deg som har lengre erfaring. Vi legger til rette for god opplæring, slik at du skal føle deg trygg i jobben din!

Vi har et sterkt fokus på kompetanseutvikling og kompetanseforskyvning, og du blir en del av et variert og tverrfaglig arbeidsmiljø.

Brukerne våre representerer et bredt spekter av alder og tjenestebehov. Dette gir varierte arbeidsdager, stor grad av selvstendighet og gode muligheter for faglig utvikling. Trygghet er viktig for oss – både for brukerne og for deg som ansatt – og et godt samarbeid på tvers av avdelingene er en naturlig del av arbeidshverdagen.

Arbeidsmiljøet hos oss beskrives som inkluderende, faglig engasjert og imøtekommende. Selv om hovedfokuset er på tjenestene og faget, legger vi også vekt på trivsel i arbeidshverdagen. Gjennom året arrangeres sosiale aktiviteter som bidrar til et hyggelig og godt arbeidsmiljø.

Vi holder til sentralt på Bekkestua, med god offentlig kommunikasjon (T-bane, buss). Mulighet for parkering av privat bil.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som

  • er faglig dyktig og har en nytenkende innstilling til velferdsteknologi og endring i tjenesten
  • er ansvarlig og løsningsorientert
  • evner å tenke tverrfaglig, kvalitetsbevisst, effektivt og strukturert
  • er utadvendt, reflektert og serviceorientert

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

Sammen skaper vi et godt og inkluderende samfunn for over 130 000 innbyggere, både i dag og i årene som kommer. Vi skaper rammer som bidrar til at de aller minste kan leke og lære og at de som trenger en hjelpende hånd får en hverdag preget av mestring, mening og verdighet. What you bring to the team:

  • You are interested in defense, unmanned systems and integrated customer solutions

  • You enjoy structuring complex topics and turning them into clear, actionable outputs

jobs.title: Vil du bli avlaster i Værøy Kommune
jobs.employer: PLEIE- OG OMSORGSTJENESTEN I VÆRØY HJEMMEBASERTE TJENESTER
jobs.description:
Værøy kommune søker trygge og omsorgsfulle personer som ønsker å gjøre en viktig forskjell for barn, unge eller voksne med særlige omsorgsbehov – og for familiene deres.
Som avlaster bidrar du til at foreldre og andre pårørende som står i særlig krevende omsorgsoppgaver, får nødvendig fritid og avlastning. Samtidig skal personen som mottar avlastning, oppleve trygghet, trivsel og meningsfulle aktiviteter.

Før oppstart må det legges fram gyldig politiattest. Dersom avlastningen skal foregå i avlasters eget hjem, kan det også bli stilt krav om politiattest fra andre medlemmer av husstanden som er over 18 år.

Send oss en kort søknad der du forteller litt om deg selv, hvorfor du ønsker å være avlaster, og hvilken erfaring eller kompetanse du har.
Vi oppfordrer også deg som ikke har formell helse- og sosialfaglig utdanning, til å søke. Det viktigste er at du er en trygg og omsorgsfull person som ønsker å gjøre en forskjell.

Værøy kommune planlegger å etablere en avlastningsbolig. Når tilbudet kommer i drift, kan det – dersom begge parter ønsker det – bli aktuelt med ansettelse på vilkår fastsatt i Hovedtariffavtalen.

Vil du vite mer?
Har du spørsmål om arbeidet eller ønsker en uforpliktende samtale, er du velkommen til å ta kontakt.

 


Hva innebærer oppdraget

Som avlaster skal du blant annet:

skape trygghet, forutsigbarhet og gode opplevelser, gi omsorg og praktisk hjelp ut fra den enkeltes behov, delta i aktiviteter hjemme og ute. Det kan være å følge opp måltider, legging og daglige rutiner, samarbeide godt med pårørende og kommunens ansatte og bidra til at pårørende får nødvendig hvile og tid til andre familiemedlemmer.

Vi søker personer som kan være avlaster i eget hjem. Arbeidet kan være på ettermiddager, kvelder, i helger eller som døgnavlastning.

KvalifikasjonerDet er vanligvis ikke krav om en bestemt utdanning men erfaring med barn, unge eller voksne med funksjonsnedsettelse, atferdsvansker eller andre særlige omsorgsbehov er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Du vil få nødvendig informasjon og opplæring.
Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.Hvem ser vi etterVi ser etter deg som er trygg, rolig og omsorgsfull. I tillegg er du ansvarsbevisst og til å stole på. Du har tålmodighet og evne til å møte ulike behov. Du kan arbeide selvstendig og samarbeider godt med andre.
Det er en forutsetting med gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig og har fylt 18 år.

Vi tilbyr
  • en meningsfull og variert jobb
  • nødvendig opplæring og veiledning
  • samarbeid med familie og kommunens fagpersoner
  • lønn og arbeidsvilkår etter gjeldende lov- og avtaleverk for avlastere gjelder SGS 1030
KontaktinformasjonIna Ulrichsen, Fagleder, 47 68 03 28, ina.ulrichsen@varoy.kommune.no
Heidi Rønning, Helse- og omsorgsleder, 90219759, heidi.ronning@varoy.kommune.no
