jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Learning Experiences Creator
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is where millions of people learn to build software - and our documentation and learning content are where they get going or give up. We're taking ownership of that experience, and we're looking for a Learning Experience Creator who can make it worthy of the product: someone who turns product knowledge into experiences people actually use - clear written docs, guided learning, short video, interactive experiences - findable at the moment of need, accurate every time, and genuinely enjoyable.

You're a learning-experience creator first. You understand how people actually learn a product - what they're trying to accomplish, where they get stuck, what format serves each moment - and you move fluidly between writing a crisp help article, designing a hands-on walkthrough, and producing a short video. Underneath it all, you're a storyteller: you know how to earn attention in the first few seconds, hold it against real-world attention spans, and make ideas stick - and sometimes make something people can't help but share. You're also a builder: unafraid to try new formats and experiment, you read the data and listen to customers, and you continually improve and evolve with speed as our product evolves. You'll turn complex things into simple, useful experiences, and you'll own how well they land.

The Mission: help every user - external customers and internal teams - self-serve to reach their creative and business goals, with content so good, so current, and so findable that they don't need to open a ticket. Success looks like real ticket deflection, faster activation, and high CSAT.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - New documentation and learning content. You'll populate our documentation and learning surfaces with new, accurate, plain-language content - help articles, answer-first FAQs, goal-based tutorials, and rebuilt getting-started paths - prioritized by real reader and ticket data, made at volume with the help of our AI- native content tools.

 - The content lifecycle. Content isn't done when it ships. You'll keep the library current through every product launch - freshness reviews, launch-day updates, retiring what's stale - so nothing published contradicts the product. Our pipeline flags what's drifting; you own making it right.

 - Learning experiences across formats. Written first where reading serves best - plus short-form video, microlearning, interactive courses, quick walkthroughs, GIFs, and in-product tips. You pick the format that fits the job, not the other way around, and you bring a storyteller's instinct for attention and memorability to every one - learning content competes with everything else on someone's screen, and yours wins. You keep pushing into new, innovative experiences as our tools grow.

 - A content calendar built for effectiveness. You plan what gets made and when - covering the topics customers most need help with, sequenced for maximum impact, so the library actually answers the questions people are asking.

 - Findability. You make sure content is easy to discover - titled, tagged, and structured so people (and the AI assistants that read our docs) find the right answer through search, at the moment of need. Great content nobody can find doesn't deflect anything, and this is yours to own.

 - Engagement and outcomes. You care whether it worked - reader feedback, findability, completion and watch-through, self-serve resolution, deflection, CSAT - and you tune the calendar and the craft based on what the data and customers tell you.

 - A recognizable voice. A consistent, human style across docs, learning, and video that makes every piece feel like part of one connected experience, whether someone reads a single article or completes a whole course.

 


HOW YOU'LL WORK WITH THE TEAM

This role is a force-multiplier - it makes the whole team's knowledge reach people. You won't work alone:

• With our Technical Customer Education Specialist for accuracy and depth - they bring the technical truth; you turn it into clear, findable content people trust and enjoy.

• With our Sr. Learning Experience Lead on what content is needed and what's working - they own the learning platform, journeys, and measurement; you read the same effectiveness data to steer the calendar.

• With our docs and product partners on launches - so new features ship with accurate, ready content on day one, not weeks later.

• With the hiring manager and the wider team to scale our content capability together, so the sum is greater than the parts.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A proven learning-content creator. A portfolio of documentation, tutorials, courses, or product education that people actually used and learned from - across at least two formats, with written content among them. You understand clarity, structure, and story, and you can prove it.

• A strong writer. You make complex or dry topics genuinely clear and engaging in plain language, with warmth and a point of view. Docs people want to read are your craft.

• A gifted storyteller, across media. You understand hooks, pacing, attention spans, and what makes content memorable - sometimes shareable, occasionally viral - and you apply that craft to written, video, and interactive work alike. It shows up in a doc's first sentence as much as a video's first five seconds.

• A capable short-form video creator. Video is one of your formats - you understand watchability and modern platform sensibilities, and you're comfortable producing (on or off camera) with AI-assisted workflows.

• A builder and experimenter. You try new formats and ideas, take calculated content risks, glean insights from data and customers, and continually improve - determining the right approach even when the problem is ambiguous.

• Fast to learn a product. You get up to speed quickly and can represent it accurately to newcomers - you don't need to be a developer, but you make technical things make sense.

• Outcome-minded. You define what success looks like for your work, and you care about real results (deflection, activation, self-serve success, CSAT), not just output.

• A strong thought partner. You share ideas openly, seek other perspectives, and collaborate well across a small, fast team.

 


BONUS

• Experience writing or maintaining developer or product documentation (docs-as-code, Markdown-based platforms) - and a feel for content lifecycle at scale.

• Hands-on with AI-native build or content tools (Replit) and modern editing/production workflows.

• Instructional design fundamentals - you know why a checklist beats a paragraph and when a video beats both.

• A feel for discoverability and search - how people (and AI assistants) find content and how to help them.

• Experience running a content channel, editorial calendar, or creator program with an audience - bonus points if something you made really took off.

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff, Sales
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Chief of Staff you'll be the strategic copilot to Notion's Global Head of Sales. You'll work directly with our Global Head of Sales on the complex problems and decisions that drive our sales engine.



You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy being at the center of global sales strategy. Whether that's preparing for board meetings, facilitating cross-functional alignment, or representing the sales organization with key stakeholders.



We're looking for someone who gets energized by revolutionary sales challenges like balancing self-serve and enterprise motions, transforming our business motions internally and externally with AI, and identifying new market opportunities. If you can seamlessly shift between analyzing business metrics, facilitating executive decision-making, and strong project management execution - this role is for you! We’re looking for someone who is low ego, high motor, excited to roll up their sleeves, and ready to make an impact!

 

This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Serve as the Global Head of Sales’ trusted partner. You'll help prepare for board meetings, facilitate executive decision-making, and represent the sales org with internal & external stakeholders.

 - Act as a strategic connector for the Sales organization. You'll use your cross-functional knowledge to identify trends, connect dots for stakeholders, and drive increased alignment between teams. This includes working across GTM teams as well as with close partners in EPD, Finance, People, and Legal.

 - Lead cross-functional projects. You'll run cross functional projects and forums to increase alignment for sales. This includes leading our sales organization planning and reporting.

 - Identify and drive forward global sales strategy. You’ll run analysis on the Notion business and opportunities to deepen customer deployments. Through this work you’ll identify opportunities and provide recommendations for the sales business as it continues to grow and scale. In some cases you’ll own the execution of the strategy too.

 - Drive our rhythm of business. You’ll play a key role in driving the weekly sales Leads meeting, spearheading quarterly Sales Lead offsites, and working closely with the Global Head of Sales on regular communications to the sales org.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years experience in senior sales or sales adjacent leadership roles

 - You have previously worked with, advised, and influenced senior executives

 - You seamlessly swap back and forth between strategic thinking and operational details

 - You’re extremely organized and strong in project management - experience leading initiatives from inception through execution

 - You dive deep into projects individually as well as know when to delegate and empower teammates

 - You’re a pace setter, you have previous success operating in fast paced B2B SaaS environments

 - You’re strong and comfortable with both written and verbal communications, a super power is making complex topics sound simple

 - You’re a self starter, you don’t ask for permission - you make it happen

 - You’re a problem solver who leverages first principles thinking and focuses on what’s best for Notion and our customers

 - You’ve started to adopt AI to help you spend more time on the work that matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Background in management consulting, strategy, or operations

 - Experience working in GTM or directly reporting to the C-suite

 - Experience driving initiatives that serve both PLG and Enterprise Sales motions

 - Familiar with using Notion as a product

 - AI power user
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $230,000 - $280,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

  • Svakodnevno provjeravanje podešenosti strojeva te izvršenje potrebnih podešavanja.

  • Popravak i remont linija obrade duhana, linija sjetve i otkupa duhana te popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svog djelokruga.
  • Redovno provjerava radno stanje opreme, radi tehnička podešavanja, obavještava Rukovoditelja održavanja o uočenim problemima.

  • Rastavljanje strojeva u slučaju potrebe, popravak i zamjena neispravnih komponenti strojeva.

  • Održava čistoću i urednost radnog okruženja.
  • Sudjeluje u pripremi akcija preventivnog održavanja.
  • Osigurava da su svi alati i materijali koji se koriste prikladni, sigurni i u skladu s relevantnim standardima i zahtjevima tvrtke.
  • Održavanje, popravci i zamjena mehaničkih komponenata i sklopova na opremi iz svogdjelokruga.
  • Po potrebi radi u drugim sektorima, sva područja obrade duhana (pakiranje, sušenje, biranje, ulaz, itd.), na sjetvi plitica, otkupu duhana.
  • Ostali zadaci u skladu s naravi i vrstom rada po nalogu neposredno nadređenog.
Uvjeti
  • Potrebna stručna sprema: SSS-srednja stručna sprema.
  • Zahtijevana struka: tehnička struke (elektro, strojarska).
  • Osnovno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu.
  • Osnovno znanje rada na računalu: Ms Office.
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
Prednosti
  • Sposobnost brze identifikacije i rješavanja problema.
  • Iskustvo u razumijevanju tehničke dokumentacije.
  • Izvrsna sposobnost vođenja evidencije.
  • Komunikacijske vještine.
  • Fleksibilnost i timski rad.
  • Sposobnost postavljanja prioriteta.
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo od dvije godine u struci ili na sličnim poslovima.
Nudimo benefite i pogodnosti:
  • Briga o zdravlju: dopunsko i dodatno zdravstveno osiguranje (sistematski i specijalistički pregledi i slično), osiguranje zaposlenika od nezgode (24/7), besplatno korištenje teretane.

  • Balans privatnog i poslovnog: plaćeni i neplaćeni dopust za razne osobne potrebe, slobodan radni dan povodom rođendana zaposlenika, razna online savjetovanja za zaposlenike i programi pomoći te savjetovanja za razne životne teme.

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for an experienced attorney to join our Commercial Counsel team. This senior role will help build and support Notion’s rapidly evolving Enterprise customer sales motions, bringing deep expertise in negotiating complex AI SaaS agreements with enterprise customers, as well as acting as an advisor and coach to our account teams and cross functional partners. Notion is scaling rapidly, and we need people who work well as a tight-knit team with a passion for driving revenue deals to conclusion. If you enjoy using your deep industry and technology transaction expertise to support revenue generating functions, this role is for you.


Our Commercial Legal team sits at the center of Notion’s growth. We simplify how customers contract with us, take clear and unambiguous positions on AI, privacy, and security, and drive revenue deals to a fast, predictable close. That means exercising real judgment and finding creative, pragmatic paths forward through complex customer requests and requirements.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 - Experience driving commercial transactions, SaaS, and enterprise B2B transactions

 - Strong negotiation skills, including ability to explain nuanced legal concepts to internal and external parties and tailor approach to the audience

 - Excellent drafting, written and verbal communication skills and ability to adapt legal requirements in balanced, creative and pragmatic ways to facilitate communication at all levels of the organization

 - Ability to directly interact and build meaningful relationships and trust with internal and external clients and leaders

 - Independent and strategic thought combined with excellent team player qualities and a willingness to take on additional responsibilities

Sie kennen den ungarischen Markt, sind gerne bei Kunden vor Ort und begeistern sich für technische Lösungen?

Dann übernehmen Sie den weiteren Ausbau unseres Vertriebsgebietes in Ungarn. Sie gewinnen neue Kunden, entwickeln bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen weiter und beraten Unternehmen zu unseren Dienstleistungen und Produkten. Dabei sind Sie im gesamten Land unterwegs und werden von einem erfahrenen Vertriebsteam in unserer Zentrale in Deutschland unterstützt.

Wir bieten Ihnen - ATTRAKTIV:

- Faire & leistungsgerechte Bezahlung mit Bonusregelung
- Moderne Arbeitsausstattung mit Notebook und Smartphone
- Ein erfahrenes Vertriebsteam in unserer Zentrale als Backoffice-Unterstützung
- Viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein familiäres Arbeitsumfeld

Ihre Aufgaben - SPANNEND:

Sie…

- … gewinnen neue Kunden und bauen langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen auf
- … betreuen und entwickeln Bestandskunden im gesamten Vertriebsgebiet
- … beraten Unternehmen zu unseren technischen Dienstleistungen und Lösungen
- … erkennen Marktpotenziale und erschließen neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
- … repräsentieren unser Unternehmen bei Kunden, Messen und Veranstaltungen

Ihre Qualifikationen - ÜBERZEUGEND:

- Ungarisch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Deutsch-, gerne auch Englischkenntnisse
- Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb oder Außendienst
- Freude an der Neukundengewinnung und dem Ausbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen
- Technisches Verständnis für erklärungsbedürftige Produkte oder Dienstleistungen
- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Ungarns

Darauf können Sie sich freuen - INFORMATIV:

- Intensive Einführungsphase in der Zentrale mit Abteilungsrotation & Tandembesuchen im Außendienst
- Spannende Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung
- Individuell abgestimmte Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Langfristige Perspektive in einem international erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen

Seit 1987 sind wir löwenstark am Markt – innovativ, familiär und zukunftsorientiert.

Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Hanau gehören wir zu den führenden Spezialisten für Reparatur, Verkauf und Service von CNC-, SPS- und Robotertechnik sowie Elektronik für erneuerbare Energien, Maritimer Elektronik sowie Elektronik in der Gebäudetechnik. Wir halten Maschinen am Laufen – weltweit.

Werden Sie Teil unseres #löwenstarkenteams und gestalten Sie den Ausbau unseres Vertriebs in Ungarn aktiv mit.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: CRM-Systeme, Vertrieb, Akquisition, Kundenberatung, -betreuung

jobs.title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the  opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 5+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Native level Japanese, business level English




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s  Global Recruiting Privacy Policy.  https://dev.notion.so/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: AI Agent Security Architect
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI Agent Security Architect to function as the primary technical

authority for Replit’s autonomous and AI agent security blueprint. In this critical role, you

will design, implement, and maintain the runtime defense systems, guardrail

frameworks, and sandboxing architectures that govern AI agents executing code,

invoking tools, and reasoning across our platform. You will be a key technical

contributor—leading high-impact AI security initiatives and bridging the gap between

non-deterministic AI behavior and rigorous cybersecurity controls for both engineering

and executive leadership.



What You'll Do

 - AI Agent Security Strategy & Technical Execution

 - AI Agent Security Blueprint: Define the long-term vision and architectural patterns for securing autonomous agent workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, multi-turn reasoning loops, and multi-agent coordination.

 - Runtime Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Architect and deploy dynamic input/output guardrail systems, semantic firewalls, and real-time intent verification filters to prevent goal hijacking, system prompt leaks, and indirect prompt injections.

 - Agent Execution & Tool Sandboxing: Partner with Infrastructure and AppSec teams to design secure, short-lived, micro-isolated environments (e.g., microVMs, WebAssembly, container sandboxes) where agents can dynamically execute code, run shell commands, and interact with host operating systems safely.

 - Agentic Threat Modeling & Red Teaming: Conduct specialized threat modeling against non-deterministic systems. Lead automated and manual AI red-teaming initiatives to uncover vulnerabilities in RAG context pipelines, vector stores, and tool-calling interfaces.

 - Identity, Delegation & Least Privilege: Architect fine-grained permission models and step-up Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) authorization patterns for agents acting on behalf of users—ensuring agents never exceed the delegated privileges of the end user or misuse API keys.

 - Context & Memory Boundary Security: Design strict data isolation and poisoning prevention controls for vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and long-term conversation memories across multi-tenant workloads.

 - Risk Management & Cross-Functional Enablement

 - Maintain the AI Security Source of Truth: Define, document, and maintain authoritative secure design patterns and SDKs for engineering teams building internal or customer-facing AI agent capabilities.

 - Contribution to Risk Register: Identify, quantify, and document non-deterministic and agentic security risks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, MITRE ATLAS), ensuring they are accurately represented in the Cybersecurity Risk Register.

 - Auditability & Observability: Design tamper-evident logging and telemetry standards for agent reasoning chains, tool execution history, and context assembly to support incident response, forensics, and GRC requirements.

 - Compliance & Sales Enablement: Partner with GRC to translate complex AI security controls into enterprise-ready audit documentation (e.g., ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act readiness) and support Sales on complex enterprise security inquiries regarding AI safety.

Required Skills & Experience

 - 6+ years of experience in security engineering or security architecture, with at least 2+ years dedicated specifically to AI/ML security, LLM application security, or securing agentic frameworks.

 - Deep understanding of agentic architectures and protocols (e.g., Model Context. Protocol (MCP), LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, ReAct frameworks, and vector database technologies).

 - Hands-on expertise with threat vectors unique to agentic AI: Indirect Prompt

 - Injection, Goal Hijacking, Tool Parameter Tampering, Data Poisoning, and Context Contamination.

 - Strong background in applying safety standards and risk frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, NIST AI RMF, and MITRE ATLAS.

 - Proficiency in Python, Go, or TypeScript/JavaScript with a proven track record of reviewing code and building functional security tooling or guardrails.

 - Experience authoring, maintaining, and evangelizing technical security architecture documentation.

 - Exceptional ability to communicate complex non-deterministic AI risks to both deep technical engineers and executive stakeholders.

 - Proven track record of contributing to an enterprise Cybersecurity Risk Register.

Bonus Qualifications

 - Experience designing runtime sandboxing and isolation technologies (e.g., Firecracker, gVisor, Docker, WebAssembly) for dynamic code execution environments.





Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

jobs.title: Legal Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Legal Operations Manager at Replit, you will be the central point of contact for legal requests across the company and the operational backbone of our contract lifecycle. You will triage and manage incoming legal requests, own contract management end to end, and support broader corporate compliance and data privacy work. Your meticulous attention to detail and proactive approach will keep legal operations running smoothly and reduce risk across the business.

Think of yourself as the air traffic controller of our legal universe — making sure every contract, request, and approval lands safely, on time, and in the right hands. Your meticulous attention to detail and proactive approach will not just keep Legal running smoothly — it will make the whole company move faster.

If you love building systems, closing loops, and being the person everyone turns to when they need to get something done right, this role was made for you.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL DO:



Legal Operations

 - Drive the Legal team's operational strategy, understand operational challenges, identify opportunities to improve systems and workflows

 - Implement, maintain, and optimize a best in class AI driven tech stack. Partner cross functionally with AI and GTM/marketing/partnerships teams to identify technologies, negotiate with vendors, and drive implementation.

 - Partner closely with Finance and Legal leadership to manage budget, forecasting, accruals, and track spend

 - Working closely with leadership, own planning cycles, OKRs, and data reporting and metrics

 - Manage outside counsel relationships, including new engagements, billing guidelines invoicing, and e-billing. Drive outside counsel management strategy with a focus on cost discipline and operational accountability

 - Build and maintain knowledge management platforms and learning and development programs that keep the team current and operating effectively.

 - Run the day-to-day operations of the Legal & team, driving efficiencies that enable the team to perform its best work (for example, manage vendors, contract signatures, attorney memberships, internal practice guidelines, expenses, team meetings).



Contract Lifecycle Management

 - Serve as the primary intake point for legal requests, triaging by urgency and complexity and routing to the right owner

 - Organize and consolidate incoming legal requests into a centralized tracking system

 - Handle baseline legal reviews and approvals directly, escalating complex or high-risk matters to legal counsel

 - Develop and maintain tooling and processes to track requests, contracts, and deadlines

 - Track responsible managers and renewal deadlines

 - Manage contract templates and organization (Vendor MSA, NDAs, offer letters)

 - Implement and maintain safeguards



Corporate and Compliance Matters

 - Assist in strategic corporate transactions, including due diligence and virtual data room building

 - Support post-closing integrations and follow-ups

 - Manage annual filings, updates, and deadline tracking

 - Prepare and update internal company policies

 - Prepare and update team trainings on legal issue spotting, privacy, governance, and HR

 - Track and implement updates to website and privacy policy terms

 - Organize and maintain general records

 - Prepare checklists and provide project support as needed



Data Privacy

 - Track data subject requests (deletions) and assist preparing transparency reporting

 - Organize and maintain data maps

 - Coordinate and track data protection impact assessments



Required Skills & Experience

 - Minimum of 5 years of proven legal administrative experience

 - Motivation to grow and expand knowledge base

 - Strong attention to detail and proofreading ability

 - Ability to prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously and work independently to complete tasks within given deadlines



Bonus Points

 - High growth startup experience

 - Experience building out lean legal teams to carry out corporate responsibilities

 



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

jobs.title: UNUTARNJI REVIZOR / UNUTARNJA REVIZORICA
jobs.description:
Gradonačelnik Grada Umaga – Umago, pročelnica Upravnog odjela za financije i proračun i pročelnica Upravnog odjela za imovinskopravne poslove na temelju članka 19. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi („Narodne novine“, broj 86/08., 61/11., 4/18., 112/19. i 17/25. – u nastavku teksta: ZSN), raspisuju JAVNI NATJEČAJ za prijam u službu na sljedeća radna mjesta:
  1. unutarnji revizor (1 izvršitelj - m/ž), na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obvezni probni rad u trajanju od tri mjeseca.
Posebni uvjeti za prijam u službu:
  • sveučilišni diplomski studij ili sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij ekonomske ili pravne struke,
  • stručno ovlaštenje ministra financija za obavljanje poslova unutarnje revizije u javnom sektoru,
  • najmanje pet godina radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, od čega najmanje tri godine na poslovima unutarnje revizije ili revizije,
  • položen državni ispit za II. razinu.
Posebni uvjet za prijam u službu za gore navedena radna mjesta je i poznavanje rada na računalu. Kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete za prijam u službu, propisane u članku 12. ZSN-a (punoljetnost, hrvatsko državljanstvo i zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prima). Za prijam u službu osobe koja je strani državljanin ili osobe bez državljanstva, pored ispunjavanja uvjeta propisanih posebnim zakonom, potrebno je prethodno odobrenje tijela državne uprave nadležnog za službeničke odnose. Za dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku potrebno je dostaviti ovjereni prijevod. Radnim iskustvom na odgovarajućim poslovima razumijeva se radno iskustvo (služba u upravnim tijelima jedinica lokalne ili područne /regionalne/ samouprave, državna služba, javna služba, radni odnos kod privatnog poslodavca, samostalno obavljanje profesionalne djelatnosti u skladu s posebnim propisima ili obavljanje poslova u međunarodnim organizacijama) ostvareno na poslovima odgovarajuće razine obrazovanja i struke, sukladno članku 13. ZSN-a. Natjecati se mogu i kandidati koji nemaju položen državni ispit propisane razine, uz obvezu da ga, ako zadovolje na probnom radu, polože u roku godine dana od dana početka rada u službi utvrđenog rješenjem o rasporedu na radno mjesto. Kandidati koji nemaju certifikat, uvjerenje, svjedodžbu ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu o poznavanju rada na računalu, a ispunjavaju ostale natječajne uvjete, mogu biti primljeni u službu i raspoređeni na radno mjesto pod uvjetom da u roku određenom Pravilnikom o unutarnjem redu gradske uprave („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 9/23., 13/23., 22/23., 5/24., 7/24., 11/24., 16/24., 17/24., 1/25., 7/25. i 7/26. – u nastavku teksta: Pravilnik) steknu odgovarajući certifikat, uvjerenje, svjedodžbu ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu. U službu ne može biti primljena osoba za čiji prijam postoje zapreke iz članka 15. i 16. ZSN-a. Kandidat koji ima pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti odgovarajuće isprave kao dokaz o statusu te druge dokaze sukladno posebnom zakonu kojim je uređeno to pravo, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, broj 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.), člankom 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“, broj 84/21. i 13/26), člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“, broj 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“, broj 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) i člankom 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina („Narodne novine“, broj 155/02., 47/10., 80/10. i 93/11.) dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Prilikom pozivanja na pravo prednosti kod prijma u službu prema posebnom zakonu, kada pravo prednosti ovisi o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod posljednjeg poslodavca (primjerice: da radni odnos nije prestao krivnjom radnika ili sporazumnim raskidom), potrebno je dostaviti preslik dokaza o načinu prestanka prethodnog radnog odnosa. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji i člankom 47. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Prijavi na natječaj potrebno je priložiti:
  • životopis
  • dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (presliku važeće osobne iskaznice, važeće putovnice, domovnice ili vojne iskaznice),
  • presliku diplome kojom se potvrđuje ispunjavanje uvjeta razine obrazovanja (stručne spreme) i struke određene ovim natječajem
  • elektronički zapis (u slučaju da je osiguranik podnio zahtjev u elektroničkom obliku preko korisničkih stranica Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje), odnosno potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje koju Zavod na osobno traženje osiguranika izdaje na šalterima područnih službi/ureda Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne starije od trideset dana, računajući od dana objave natječaja u Narodnim novinama),
  • običnu presliku dokaza o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima za cijeli period koji je kao uvjet naveden u javnom natječaju (rješenje o rasporedu, ugovor o radu ili uvjerenje poslodavca o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima koje mora sadržavati: vrstu poslova koju je obavljao, koja struka i stupanj stručne spreme je zahtijevan za njih i vremensko razdoblje u kojem je kandidat obavljao navedene poslove), za radna mjesta pod rednim brojem 1, 2 i 3,
  • ako je u elektroničkom zapisu ili potvrdi o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (stvarna/potrebna stručna sprema / vrsta i razina obrazovanja) evidentiran radni staž, potrebno je priložiti dokaz da je osoba bez radnog iskustva ili s radnim iskustvom kraćim od 12 mjeseci na odgovarajućim poslovima u traženom zvanju i struci, koji mora sadržavati podatke o vrsti poslova koje je osoba obavljala, s kojim zvanjem i strukom te u kojem razdoblju (rješenje, ugovor o radu, potvrda poslodavca ili druga isprava kojom to dokazuje), za radno mjesto pod rednim brojem 4,
  • presliku dokaza o položenom državnom ispitu propisane razine (ako kandidat ima položen državni ispit propisane razine),
  • presliku stručnog ovlaštenja ministra financija za obavljanje poslova unutarnje revizije u javnom sektoru (za radno mjesto unutarnji revizor),
  • presliku dokaza o poznavanju rada na računalu (certifikat o poznavanju rada na računalu koji se priznaje u zemljama Europske unije ili uvjerenje o osposobljenosti za Računalnog operatera poslovne primjene računala ili svjedodžbu odgovarajućeg razreda srednje škole ili iskaz ocjena sveučilišnog ili stručnog studija (visokoškolske ustanove) iz koje je vidljivo da je uspješno položen predmet informatike ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu ovlaštenog organizatora tečaja informatike iz koje je vidljivo da je uspješno završen tečaj informatike u čijem su nastavnom sadržaju obuhvaćene osnove rada na računalu i operacijski sustav Windows, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook-elektronička pošta i rad na internetu,
  • vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu kandidata da kod njega ne postoje zapreke za prijam u službu iz članka 15. i članka 16. ZSN-a (izjavu nije potrebno ovjeravati).
Ako kandidat uz prijavu priloži isprave u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (vjenčani list, rodni list i sl.). U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona, odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti mail-adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prijavljuje. Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Kandidati koji se istovremeno prijavljuju na više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako pojedino radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu sa svim traženim prilozima. Dopunu prijavi moguće je podnijeti zaključno do dana isteka natječajnog roka. Za ocjenu ispunjavaju li podnositelji prijave uvjete naznačene u natječaju, mjerodavan je posljednji dan roka za podnošenje prijava na natječaj (osim za prijam vježbenika, obzirom da kandidati ne smiju imati 12 ili više mjeseci radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, stoga taj uvjet ispunjava podnositelj prijave koji potrebno radno iskustvo nije imao barem prvog dana roka za podnošenje prijava na javni natječaj za prijam u službu vježbenika). Prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu izabrani kandidat pozvat će se da u primjerenom roku dostavi uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv njega ne vodi kazneni postupak i uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se prima te dostavi na uvid izvornike dokaza o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, čije su preslike priložene uz prijavu na javni natječaj. Nedostavljanje traženih isprava smatrat će se odustankom od prijma u službu. Troškove izdavanja uvjerenja o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti snosi Grad (osim u slučaju odustanka kandidata od prijma u službu). Nakon izbora kandidata, a prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu, provjerit će po službenoj dužnosti postoji li zapreka za prijam u službu zbog pravomoćne osuđivanosti izabranog kandidata za kazneno djelo iz članka 15. ZSN-a te zapreke iz članka 16. ZSNa. Uredna prijava je ona prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju, u obliku navedenom u natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i njena prijava neće biti razmatrana, te će joj o tome biti dostavljena pisana obavijest. Osoba nema pravo podnošenja pravnog lijeka protiv te obavijesti. Osoba koja je podnijela nepotpunu prijavu, neće biti pozvana na dopunu prijave. Za kandidate prijavljene na javni natječaj, koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja, bit će provedena prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj. Prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja podnose se u zatvorenim omotnicama na adresu: Grad Umag – Umago, Povjerenstvo za provedbu natječaja, Trg slobode 7, 52470 Umag, u roku od 15 dana od dana objave natječaja u „Narodnim novinama“, s obveznom naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ ZA PRIJAM (upisati naziv radnog mjesta na koji se kandidat prijavljuje) – NE OTVARAJ“. Prijave se mogu neposredno predati i u pisarnicu Grada Umaga – Umago, Trg slobode 7 (prizemlje). Rješenje o prijmu u službu izabranog kandidata dostavlja se javnom objavom na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga – Umago (www.umag.hr) najkasnije 60 dana od isteka roka za podnošenje prijava na javni natječaj, a dostava se smatra obavljenom istekom osmoga dana od dana javne objave navedenog rješenja. Opis poslova i podaci o plaći radnog mjesta koje se popunjava ovim natječajem, način obavljanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidata, područje provjere te pravni i drugi izvori za pripremanje kandidata za provjeru navedeni su na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga –Umago www.umag.hr (lokacija „Zapošljavanje“). III. PROVJERA ZNANJA I SPOSOBNOSTI KANDIDATA Za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj, koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete, provest će se prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti, sukladno članku 22. ZSN-a. Prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti kandidata obavlja se putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. Smatra se da je kandidat, koji nije pristupio prethodnoj provjeri znanja, povukao prijavu na javni natječaj. Pravila provjere znanja i sposobnosti Po dolasku na provjeru znanja, od kandidata će biti zatraženo predočenje odgovarajuće identifikacijske isprave radi utvrđivanja identiteta. Po utvrđivanju identiteta i svojstva kandidata, kandidatima će biti podijeljena pitanja. Za svaki dio provjere znanja kandidatima se dodjeljuju bodovi od 1 do 10. Intervju se provodi samo s kandidatima koji su ostvarili najmanje 50% bodova na pisanom testiranju. Smatra se da je kandidat zadovoljio ako je na intervjuu ostvario najmanje 5 bodova. Za vrijeme provjere znanja i sposobnosti nije dopušteno: - koristiti se bilo kakvom literaturom odnosno bilješkama, - koristiti mobitel ili druga komunikacijska sredstva, - napuštati prostoriju u kojoj se provjera odvija, - razgovarati s ostalim kandidatima niti na bilo koji način remetiti koncentraciju kandidata. Ukoliko pojedini kandidat prekrši naprijed navedena pravila bit će udaljen s provjere znanja, a njegov rezultat Povjerenstvo neće priznati niti ocjenjivati. Ai sensi dell'art. 19 della Legge sugli impiegati e sul personale tecnico nelle unità di autogoverno locale e territoriale (regionale) (Gazzetta Ufficiale, nn. 86/08, 61/11, 4/18, 112/19 e 17/25 – di seguito: LIPT), il Sindaco della Città di Umag – Umago, l’assessora alle finanze e al bilancio e l’assessora agli affari giuridico-patrimoniali indicono il seguente BANDO DI CONCORSO PUBBLICO per l’assunzione dei seguenti profili professionali:
  1. revisore interno (n. 1 posto, ambosessi), a tempo indeterminato, con periodo di prova obbligatorio di tre mesi.
Requisiti richiesti:
  • laurea magistrale, laurea a ciclo unico o diploma specialistico di secondo livello in economia o giurisprudenza,
  • abilitazione professionale del ministro delle finanze per lo svolgimento delle attività di revisione interna nel settore pubblico,
  • almeno cinque anni di esperienza lavorativa in mansioni corrispondenti, di cui almeno tre in ruoli di revisione o revisione interna,
  • superamento dell’esame di Stato di II livello.
Per tutti i suddetti posti di lavoro costituisce requisito specifico per l’assunzione in servizio il possesso delle competenze informatiche. I candidati devono altresì soddisfare i criteri generali per l'assunzione in servizio previsti dall'art. 12 della LIPT (maggiore età, cittadinanza croata e idoneità sanitaria per svolgere le mansioni del posto di lavoro per il quale il candidato viene assunto). I cittadini stranieri o apolidi possono essere assunti in servizio previa autorizzazione dell’autorità statale competente per i rapporti di pubblico impiego e previo adempimento delle formalità previste da leggi specifiche. La documentazione redatta in lingua straniera deve essere prodotta in traduzione giurata. Ai fini del presente Bando, per esperienza lavorativa in mansioni appropriate si intende l’esperienza maturata nell’ambito di attività lavorative — ivi comprese quelle svolte presso enti amministrativi delle unità di autogoverno locale o territoriale /regionale/, servizio pubblico, servizio statale, presso datori di lavoro privati, nell’ambito dell’esercizio autonomo di attività professionali conformemente a disposizioni normative speciali, ovvero presso organizzazioni internazionali – purché riferite a mansioni coerenti con il livello di istruzione richiesto e con il profilo professionale oggetto della selezione, ai sensi dell’articolo 13 della LIPT. Possono presentare candidatura anche i candidati che non abbiano ancora superato l’esame di Stato del livello prescritto, a condizione che lo sostengano con esito positivo entro un anno dalla data di inizio del servizio, come previsto dalla decisione relativa all’assegnazione del posto, e subordinatamente al superamento del periodo di prova. I candidati che non sono in possesso di certificati, attestati, pagelle o altri documenti comprovanti le competenze informatiche di base, ma che risultano essere in possesso degli altri requisiti richiesti, possono essere assunti a condizione che la relativa pagella, attestato, certificato o altro documento probatorio venga conseguito entro la scadenza prevista dal Regolamento sull’ordinamento interno dell’amministrazione civica (Bollettino Ufficiale della Città di Umag – Umago, nn. 9/23, 13/23, 22/23, 5/24, 7/24, 11/24, 16/24, 17/24, 1/25, 7/25 e 7/26 – di seguito: Regolamento). Non possono essere assunti candidati per i quali sussistono gli impedimenti previsti dagli artt. 15 e 16 della LIPT. I candidati che si avvalgono del diritto di precedenza sono tenuti a indicarlo presentando l'apposita documentazione probatoria e altri documenti previsti dalla rispettiva legge specifica, con diritto di precedenza rispetto agli altri candidati a parità di condizioni.
